The National Transportation Safety Board determines that the probable cause of this accident was the in-flight failure of the right engine and the pilots failure to adequately manage the airplanes performance after the engine failed. The right engine failure resulted from inadequate maintenance that was performed by Air Sunshines maintenance personnel.
cards.audioTextZh: 2003年7月13日，阳光航空的一架塞斯纳飞机在右发动机空中失效后，迫降在了大西洋中。九名乘客中有四人没有受伤，三名乘客和飞行员受了轻伤，一名成年乘客和一名儿童乘客在撤离飞机后死亡。这架飞机受到了严重损坏。这架飞机当时执飞的是从佛罗里达州好莱坞国际机场飞往MYAT的定期国际通勤客运航班。此次飞行时的气象条件为目视气象条件，且是按照目视飞行规则飞行计划执行的飞行任务。美国国家运输安全委员会认定，这起事故的可能原因是右发动机空中失效，以及发动机失效后飞行员未能妥善管理飞机的性能。右发动机的失效是由阳光航空公司的维修人员进行的不当维护导致的。

cards.audioText: On November 22, 2004, a Gulf-stream airlines aircraft struck a light pole and crashed about 3 miles southwest of Hobby Airport, Houston, Texas, while on an instrument landing system approach to runway 4. The two pilots and the flight attendant were killed, an individual in a vehicle near the airport received minor injuries, and the airplane was destroyed by impact forces. The airplane was being operated on an instrument flight rules flight plan. Instrument meteorological conditions (IMC) prevailed at the time of the accident. The accident flight was scheduled to depart from Dallas Airport. The flight crew planned to pick up former President George Bush and other passengers at Houston. The flight was scheduled to depart HOU about 0654. The flight departed Dallas Airport about 0530, the departure was delayed because of poor weather conditions at DAL. The captain was the flying pilot, and the first officer performed the non-flying pilot duties. Before flight the flight crew received ATIS information Quebec, which reported that the winds were calm, the visibility was low in fog, and the clouds were broken at 100 feet and overcast at 9, 000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 2004年11月22日，一架湾流航空飞机在对得克萨斯州休斯敦霍比机场4跑道实施仪表着陆系统进近时撞上灯杆，并在机场西南约3海里处坠毁。2名飞行员和1名乘务员遇难，机场附近一辆车内的1人受轻伤，飞机因撞击损毁。该机按仪表飞行规则飞行计划运行，事故发生时为仪表气象条件。事故航班原计划从达拉斯机场起飞，机组准备到休斯敦接前总统乔治·布什及其他乘客，计划约06时54分从HOU离场。航班约05时30分从达拉斯机场起飞；由于DAL天气恶劣，离场延误。机长担任操纵飞行员，副驾驶履行非操纵飞行员职责。飞行前，机组收到自动终端情报服务Quebec通播：静风，雾中能见度低，100英尺多云，9000英尺阴天。

cards.audioText: On March 23 1994 the aircraft named Glinka, after the father of Russian music, was flying from Moscow to Hong Kong. There were sixty-three passengers with twelve crew members on board. The aircraft crashed after a captain allowed his child to manipulate the controls of the plane. The pilot's 11 year old daughter and 16 year old son were taking turns in the pilot's seat. While the boy was flying, the captain inadvertently disengaged the autopilot linkage to the ailerons and put the airliner in a bank of 90 degrees which caused the nose to drop sharply. The co-pilot pulled back on the yoke to obtain level flight but the plane stalled. With his seat pulled all the way back, the co-pilot in the right hand seat could not properly control the aircraft. After several stalls and rapid pull-ups, the plane went into a spiral descent. In the end, the co-pilot initiated a pull-up and nearly regained a stable flight path but the aircraft struck the ground in an almost level attitude killing all 75 aboard.
cards.audioTextZh: 1994年3月23日，一架以俄罗斯音乐之父格林卡命名的飞机，正从莫斯科飞往香港。机上载有63名乘客和12名机组人员。这架飞机坠毁的原因是机长允许自己的孩子操控飞机。当时，这位飞行员11岁的女儿和16岁的儿子在轮流坐在飞行员座位上。当男孩在操作飞行时，机长无意间断开了自动驾驶仪与副翼的连接装置，使这架客机倾斜了90度，导致机头急剧下坠。副驾驶拉动操纵杆试图使飞机恢复水平飞行状态，但飞机却失速了。由于副驾驶右侧座位的座椅被拉到了最后面，他无法有效地操控飞机。在经历了几次失速和快速拉起机头的操作后，飞机进入了螺旋式下降状态。最后，副驾驶再次拉起机头，几乎恢复了稳定的飞行路径，但飞机几乎是以水平姿态撞击到了地面，机上75人全部遇难。

cards.audioText: On June 10 1990 there was a flight from Birmingham, England to Malaga, Spain, when the aircraft was flying at FL 173, a large section of windshield fell away from the aircraft. The decompression pulled the captain out from under his seatbelt. Despite trying to hold onto the yoke, the captain was sucked out into the opening. He was in an immediate danger. A steward in the cockpit was fortunately able to grab hold of his legs. Another steward was able to strap him into the vacant seat and aid in holding onto the captain's legs. The copilot wearing full restraints made an emergency landing at Southampton. The captain remained half way out of the aircraft for 15 minutes and suffered only frostbite and some fractures. Improper bolts used to replace the windshield two days earlier resulted in the accident.
cards.audioTextZh: 1990年6月10日，一架飞机执行从英国伯明翰飞往西班牙马拉加的航班。当飞机飞至FL173时，大块风挡玻璃从机体脱落。快速失压把机长从安全带下方拽出；尽管他试图抓住驾驶盘，仍被吸出风挡开口，立即陷入危险。幸运的是，驾驶舱内一名乘务员抓住了机长的双腿。另一名乘务员把自己固定在空座椅上，协助抓住机长双腿。全程系好安全带的副驾驶操纵飞机在南安普敦紧急着陆。机长有一半身体悬在飞机外长达15分钟，最终只受到冻伤和几处骨折。事故原因是两天前更换风挡玻璃时使用了不合适的螺栓。

cards.audioText: On August 14, 2005 at approximately 12:00 p.m local Greek time, a Boeing 737-300, crashed into rolling terrain northeast of Athens, Greece. The aircraft had departed Larnaka Airport, Cyprus, two hours and 57 minutes prior to the accident. According to the investigation, during climb-out as the aircraft passed 12, 000 feet, the cabin altitude warning horn sounded. The captain then began radio communications with his company maintenance base at Larnaka. The aircraft was on autopilot at the time and followed its FMCS inserted route. It subsequently entered the missed approach holding pattern. Two Air Force F-16 fighter aircraft intercepted the aircraft emergency call and one of the pilots noticed that the captain's seat was empty and the first officer's seat was occupied by an incapacitated person. Shortly thereafter, one person was seen to enter the cockpit wearing an oxygen mask. After 1 hour and 12 minutes in the holding pattern the left engine flamed out due to fuel starvation and 10 minutes later the right engine also flamed out. The cabin altitude warning horn subsequently stopped sounding after the aircraft later descended below 10, 000 feet during its final descent. Greek authorities suggested the failure of pressurization in the aircraft may have caused the crash when they ruled out a terrorist attack.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年8月14日，当地希腊时间大约中午12点，一架波音737-300型飞机坠毁在希腊雅典东北部的起伏地形中。在事故发生前两小时57分钟，这架飞机从塞浦路斯拉纳卡机场起飞。根据调查，在飞机爬升过程中，当高度超过12000英尺时，客舱高度警告喇叭响起。随后机长开始与位于拉纳卡的公司维修基地进行无线电通讯。当时飞机处于自动驾驶状态，并按照飞行管理计算机系统（FMCS）设定的航线飞行。随后，飞机进入了复飞等待航线。两架希腊空军的F-16战斗机接到了这架飞机的紧急呼叫并进行了拦截，其中一名飞行员注意到机长座位上空无一人，而副驾驶座位上坐着一名失去行动能力的人。不久之后，有人看到一个戴着氧气面罩的人进入了驾驶舱。在等待航线上飞行了1小时12分钟后，由于燃油耗尽，左发动机熄火，10分钟后，右发动机也熄火了。在飞机最后下降阶段高度降至10000英尺以下后，客舱高度警告喇叭随后停止了鸣响。希腊当局在排除了恐怖袭击的可能性后指出，飞机的增压系统故障可能是导致此次坠机事故的原因。

cards.audioText: The flight departed Peachtree Airport, moments later the pilot radioed that the airplane had a landing gear problem, and there was smoke in the cockpit. The pilot was instructed to enter visual traffic for Runway 2R.Once the airplane was in the traffic pattern, the controller told the pilot that it appeared that the landing gear was extended, and cleared the flight to land. As the airplane neared touchdown the controller told the pilot that the landing gear was not down and locked, and then instructed the pilot to go around. As the pilot maneuvered the airplane for a landing on runway 27, the pilot was again instructed to go around. Seconds later the aircraft touched down in a grassy area the approach ends of runways 2R. Examination of the airplane disclosed that the airplane had sustained extensive fire damage to the floor area beneath the pilot's seat. The examination revealed that a flex hydraulic fluid supply line was missing, and there had been electrical arcing in the immediate vicinity of the hot spot. The National Transportation Safety Board determines the probable cause(s) of this accident as follows: The failure of the flex hydraulic line and the chaffing of an electrical line under the pilot seat that resulted in an in-flight fire.
cards.audioTextZh: 这架航班从皮茨特里机场起飞，没过多久，飞行员通过无线电报告称飞机的起落架出现问题，并且驾驶舱内有烟雾。飞行员接到指令，进入2R跑道的目视起落航线。一旦飞机进入起落航线，管制员告诉飞行员，看起来起落架已经放下了，并批准该航班降落。当飞机接近着陆时，管制员又告诉飞行员，起落架没有放下并锁定，随后指示飞行员进行复飞。当飞行员操控飞机准备在27号跑道降落时，又一次接到了复飞指令。几秒钟后，飞机降落在了2R跑道进近端的一片草地上。对飞机进行检查后发现，飞机驾驶座下方的地板区域遭受了大面积火灾损坏。检查结果显示，一根柔性液压供油管不见了，而且在起火点附近存在电气电弧现象。美国国家运输安全委员会认定这起事故的可能原因如下：柔性液压管路故障，以及驾驶座下方的电线磨损，导致了飞行过程中起火。

cards.audioText: On 18 August 2006, a Boeing 747 aircraft, with a crew of 18 and 243 passengers departed Hong Kong, China, on a scheduled passenger service to Melbourne, Australia. While in cruise, one of the cabin crew notified the flight crew that there was a smell of fuel in the first class cabin. One of the pilots verified the fuel smell and then proceeded to inspect the engines from the cabin windows. A fluid trail was evident from the rear of the number-3 engine. During this time, it was noted by the other pilots that the number-3 engine had a higher than normal fuel flow. The flight crew conducted an in-flight shut down of the number-3 engine and diverted the aircraft to Darwin. A subsequent inspection of the number-3 engine revealed the fuel manifold return line had fractured, causing a fuel leak. The fuel line was replaced and the aircraft was returned to service. In 2005, the ATSB investigated two other fuel manifold return line fractures, from the same engine type, under similar circumstances.
cards.audioTextZh: 2006年8月18日，一架载有18名机组人员和243名乘客的波音747飞机从中国香港出发，执行飞往澳大利亚墨尔本的定期客运航班。在巡航过程中，一名客舱乘务员通知飞行机组，头等舱内有燃油味。一名飞行员确认了燃油味，然后从客舱窗户检查发动机。可以明显看到3号发动机后部有液体痕迹。在此期间，其他飞行员注意到3号发动机的燃油流量高于正常水平。飞行机组在飞行中关闭了3号发动机，并将飞机转向达尔文。随后对3号发动机的检查显示，燃油总管回油管路断裂，导致燃油泄漏。燃油管路被更换后，飞机恢复了服务。2005年，澳大利亚运输安全局（ATSB）曾对另外两起相同发动机型号在类似情况下发生的燃油总管回油管路断裂事件进行过调查。

cards.audioText: On 18 January 2005, a Beech aircraft sustained damage when its main landing gear collapsed during touchdown on runway 24 at Perth Airport, WA. The aircraft had earlier departed the aerodrome on a charter flight with one pilot and seven passengers on board. Shortly after takeoff, the pilot selected the landing gear up and subsequently observed that the red gear-in-transit warning light remained illuminated. An aerodrome controller noticed that the aircraft's landing gear did not retract and passed that information to the departures controller. The departures controller cleared the pilot to climb to 4, 000 ft and provided radar vectors to a suitable area where the pilot could complete troubleshooting of the aircraft systems. The pilot completed the checklist actions in an attempt to manually extend the landing gear. However, the green gear down indicator lights did not illuminate The pilot returned to Perth Airport and conducted a fly-past of the aerodrome control tower and maintenance facility at an altitude of about 500 ft. Engineer and air traffic control witnesses to that flypast indicated to the pilot that the landing gear appeared to be in the extended position. During the subsequent landing, the right main landing gear collapsed and retracted into the wheel well. The left main landing gear partially retracted into the wheel well and the nose gear remained extended. The right engine nacelle fuel tank was punctured, requiring removal of the remaining fuel in that tank prior to the aircraft's removal from the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年1月18日，一架比奇飞机在西澳大利亚州珀斯机场的24号跑道着陆时，主起落架坍塌，导致飞机受损。这架飞机早些时候从该机场起飞执行包机任务，机上有一名飞行员和七名乘客。起飞后不久，飞行员选择收起起落架，随后发现起落架转换状态红色警告灯一直亮着。一名机场管制员注意到飞机的起落架没有收起，并将这一信息传达给了离场管制员。离场管制员批准飞行员爬升至4000英尺，并通过雷达引导飞机前往一个合适的区域，以便飞行员能够对飞机系统进行故障排查。飞行员完成了检查单上的操作步骤，试图手动放下起落架。然而，起落架放下的绿色指示灯并未亮起。飞行员返回珀斯机场，以大约500英尺的高度从机场控制塔和维修设施上空低空飞过。目睹此次低空飞过的工程师和空中交通管制人员向飞行员表示，起落架看起来处于放下状态。在随后的着陆过程中，右主起落架坍塌并缩回到轮舱内。左主起落架部分缩回到轮舱内，前起落架则保持放下状态。右发动机短舱燃油箱被刺穿，在将飞机从跑道上移走之前，需要先将该油箱内剩余的燃油抽出。

cards.audioText: The Scott Aviation aircraft with two crew members and four passengers on board, took off from Montréal, Quebec, for a night instrument flight rules flight to Bromont, Quebec. Upon approaching Bromont, the co-pilot activated the lighting system and contacted the approach. The flight crew was advised that the runway edge lights were out of order. However, the approach lights and the visual approach slope indicator did turn on. The flight crew executed the approach, and the aircraft touched down at 300 feet to the left of Runway 05L and 1800 feet beyond the threshold. It continued on its course for a distance of approximately 1800 feet before coming to a stop in a ditch. The crew tried to stop the engines, but the left engine did not stop. The co-pilot entered the cabin to direct the evacuation. One of the passengers tried to open the emergency exit door, but was unsuccessful. All of the aircraft's occupants exited through the main entrance door. Both pilots and one passenger sustained serious injuries, and the three remaining passengers received minor injuries. The aircraft suffered major damage
cards.audioTextZh: 一架斯科特航空公司的飞机搭载着两名机组人员和四名乘客，从魁北克省的蒙特利尔起飞，执行一次夜间仪表飞行规则的航班，目的地是魁北克省的布罗蒙。在接近布罗蒙时，副驾驶启动了照明系统并联系了进近管制。机组人员被告知跑道边灯出现故障。不过，进近灯光和目视进近坡度指示系统（VASI）确实亮着。机组人员执行了进近程序，飞机在05L跑道左侧300英尺处、跑道入口外1800英尺的位置着陆。飞机继续沿着其航线飞行了大约1800英尺，最终停在了一条沟渠里。机组人员试图关闭发动机，但左发动机没有停下来。副驾驶进入客舱指挥撤离。其中一名乘客试图打开紧急出口门，但没有成功。机上所有人员都通过主入口门撤离了飞机。两名飞行员和一名乘客受了重伤，其余三名乘客受了轻伤。这架飞机遭受了严重损坏。

cards.audioText: A witness reported that he observed the aircraft taxi to the eastern end of the runway and commence the take-off roll but lost sight of the aircraft as it moved along the runway. The pilot stated that the take-off roll was from a rolling start with power being slowly applied until engine output stabilized. At about 90 kts indicated air speed, the pilot attempted to rotate the aircraft but encountered resistance to rearward movement of the control column. He decided to reject the takeoff because the aircraft speed at the time was below his nominated decision speed of 100 kts. The pilot reported that he then reduced the engine power to idle and applied maximum braking. The aircraft overran the runway, passed through the airport boundary fence, continued across a public road, and passed through another fence before coming to a stop 162 m beyond the end of the runway. An inspection of the runway revealed a skid mark from the aircraft's right tire, which commenced 65 m before the end of the runway. After the aircraft came to a stop, the pilot exited the aircraft via the crew door, assisted the passengers to evacuate the aircraft through the rear cabin door and marshalled them to an area away from the aircraft. A passenger then used a mobile phone to contact emergency services, who attended the scene soon after.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名目击者报告，他看到飞机滑行到跑道东端并开始起飞滑跑，但随着飞机沿跑道前进，他随后看不到飞机了。飞行员称，飞机以滚动方式开始起飞滑跑，并缓慢增加功率，直到发动机输出稳定。在指示空速约90节时，飞行员尝试抬前轮，但发现操纵杆向后移动时受到阻力。由于当时速度仍低于其设定的100节决断速度，他决定中断起飞。飞行员随后将发动机功率收至慢车，并实施最大刹车。飞机冲出跑道，穿过机场边界围栏，又越过一条公共道路并穿过另一道围栏，最终停在跑道末端外162米处。对跑道的检查发现了飞机右轮留下的刹车痕迹，该痕迹从距跑道末端65米处开始。飞机停下后，飞行员经机组舱门离开飞机，协助乘客从后客舱门撤离，并将他们引导至远离飞机的区域。一名乘客随后用手机联系应急服务部门，应急人员很快赶到现场。

cards.audioText: A Boeing 737-200 was scheduled to operate a regular public transport flight from Hobart to Sydney on 17 May 2005 departing at 0600 Eastern Standard Time with 6 crew members and 26 passengers. During the starting of the right engine, the aircraft dispatcher informed the flight crew that there was smoke and sparks shooting from the right engine and advised to get everyone off. The pilot in command called for an emergency evacuation without initiating the Passenger Evacuation Checklist. As a result, the wing flaps were not set to the extended position and the tail section of the aircraft was dark without emergency lighting while passengers were exiting the aircraft. The forward Door Right 1 escape slide fell to the ground un-inflated when the door was opened. A number of ground personnel ran to the front of the aircraft and helped 22 passengers off the forward Door Left 1 slide and directed them towards the terminal. Four passengers exited by the Door 2 slide at the rear of the aircraft and ran into the middle of the apron. The over-wing exits were not opened. The aircraft's dispatcher had not received any education in emergency communications with flight crew nor aircraft evacuations at the terminal. The reported smoke and sparks was a result of the right engine air turbine starter failing during the engine start sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年5月17日，一架波音737-200型飞机计划执飞从霍巴特飞往悉尼的定期公共运输航班，于东部标准时间06:00起飞，机上有6名机组人员和26名乘客。在启动右发动机时，飞机调度员告知机组人员，右发动机有烟雾和火花喷出，并建议让所有人撤离飞机。机长在未启动《乘客撤离检查单》程序的情况下，下令进行紧急撤离。结果，在乘客撤离飞机时，机翼襟翼没有设置到展开位置，飞机尾部一片漆黑，没有应急照明。当右侧1号前舱门打开时，该舱门的逃生滑梯未充气就掉到了地面。一些地面工作人员跑到飞机前部，帮助22名乘客从左侧1号前舱门的滑梯撤离，并引导他们前往候机楼。4名乘客从飞机后部的2号舱门滑梯撤离，然后跑到了停机坪中间。机翼上方的应急出口并未打开。飞机调度员没有接受过任何关于与机组人员进行紧急通信以及在机场候机楼进行飞机撤离相关的培训。所报告的烟雾和火花是由于右发动机空气涡轮起动机在发动机启动过程中发生故障导致的。

cards.audioText: The DC-10 aircraft was flying from Kingston to Toronto Airport. The aircraft departed Kingston at 1400 Eastern Standard Time with the first office designated as the pilot flying. During the initial climb following take-off, the first officer noted that abnormal forward pressure on the control column was required to keep the aircraft from pitching nose up. To counter the pitch-up, he trimmed the aircraft nose down. Thirty seconds after becoming airborne, the aircraft was 350 feet above ground level and the first officer had applied full nose-down trim. The amount of forward pressure on the control column continued to increase as the aircraft accelerated, and the first officer notified the captain of the control difficulties and requested his assistance in holding the control column forward. As the aircraft climbed, the captain declared an emergency, indicating that they were experiencing control difficulties and that the aircraft may have to land nearby. The flight crew leveled the aircraft at 4000 feet on the sea level and pulled the elevator pitch disconnect handle, isolating the left and right elevators. The captain's elevator control functioned normally after the disconnection, and he decided to continue the flight. The flight crew conducted a flapless landing at Toronto without further incident. When the aircraft was inspected after landing, the right-side elevator spring tab was jammed in the trailing-edge-down position.
cards.audioTextZh: 这架DC-10型飞机当时正从金斯敦飞往多伦多机场。飞机于东部标准时间14点从金斯敦起飞，由副驾驶担任操纵飞行员。在起飞后的初始爬升阶段，副驾驶注意到需要在操纵杆上施加异常的向前推力，才能防止飞机机头上扬。为了抵消机头的上仰，他将飞机的配平调整为机头向下。飞机起飞30秒后，高度达到了离地面350英尺，此时副驾驶已经将配平调至最大的机头向下位置。随着飞机加速，需要在操纵杆上施加的向前推力继续增大，副驾驶告知机长飞机操纵出现困难，并请求机长帮忙向前按住操纵杆。在飞机爬升过程中，机长宣布了紧急情况，表明他们遇到了操纵困难，飞机可能需要在附近降落。机组人员将飞机在海拔4000英尺高度保持平飞，并拉动了升降舵俯仰脱开手柄，使左右升降舵分离。脱开连接后，机长的升降舵控制功能恢复正常，于是他决定继续飞行。机组人员在没有放下襟翼的情况下在多伦多着陆，此后未再发生其他意外情况。飞机着陆后进行检查时发现，右侧升降舵的弹簧调整片卡在了后缘向下的位置。

cards.audioText: June 21, 2002 FAA reminds all pilots to be particularly alert in their own flight preparations as well as activities at their local airports. This week incident with the Cessna182, which is flying into restricted airspace in Washington, D.C. clearly indicates that flight preparation is more important than ever. The C-182 was intercepted by military aircraft after inadvertently straying into the restricted airspace while attempting to avoid bad weather. Before taking off, the pilots should contact FAA Flight Service to receive the latest information; know and understand all applicable NOTAMs, and know where the Temporary Flight Restrictions are. Also maintain high vigilance at local airports, report suspicious activities to local authorities, and take the time to secure the airplane before you leave. It is critical that pilots continue to use the highest levels of preparation, responsibility and judgment, and that they encourage others to do so as well.
cards.audioTextZh: 2002年6月21日，美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）提醒所有飞行员，在进行自身的飞行准备工作以及在当地机场的活动时要格外警惕。本周发生的塞斯纳182飞机事件清楚地表明，飞行准备工作比以往任何时候都更加重要。这架塞斯纳182飞机在试图避开恶劣天气时，因疏忽误入了华盛顿特区的限制空域，随后遭到了军用飞机的拦截。起飞前，飞行员应联系美国联邦航空管理局的飞行服务部门以获取最新信息；了解并熟知所有适用的航行通告（NOTAM），并且清楚临时飞行限制区域的位置。同时，在当地机场也要保持高度警惕，向当地有关部门报告可疑活动，并在离开前花时间妥善保管好飞机。至关重要的是，飞行员应继续以最高标准做好准备工作，履行职责并做出正确判断，并且也应鼓励其他人这样做。

cards.audioText: On May 25, 2002, a Boeing 747-200 aircraft performed the flight from Taiwan Chung Cheng airport to Hongkong international airport, carrying 206 passengers and 19 crew members on board. It broke up and crashed at an altitude of 34, 900 feet 23 miles northeast of Magong City in Penghu County, killing all those on board. It is the deadliest air disaster in Taiwan. After careful investigation, scientists found the full story of the crash. About 20 years ago, the plane landed heavily at Kai Tak Airport in Hong Kong and damaged the skin on its tail. After the damage to the tail, China Airlines only covered the area with a piece of aluminum plate similar to the damaged skin and painted it. Instead of replacing the whole skin in accordance with the maintenance guidelines issued by Boeing. This cause a buildup of metal fatigue in the area. For 22 years, maintenance crews had not noticed anything unusual. After the split, the aircraft experienced decompression disintegration. According to the fuselage recovered after the accident, the crack is at least 90.5 inches long, and studies have shown that the structure could collapse if the crack is more than 58 inches in the air.
cards.audioTextZh: 2002年5月25日，一架波音747-200型飞机执行从台湾中正机场飞往香港国际机场的航班任务，机上搭载着206名乘客和19名机组人员。这架飞机在澎湖县马公市东北方向23英里、高度34900英尺的空中解体坠毁，机上人员全部遇难。这是台湾地区最严重的空难事件。经过仔细调查，科学家们查明了此次坠机事件的全貌。大约20年前，这架飞机在香港启德机场重重着陆，导致机尾蒙皮受损。机尾受损后，中华航空公司只是用一块与受损蒙皮相似的铝板覆盖了受损区域并进行了喷漆处理，而没有按照波音公司发布的维修指南更换整块蒙皮。这就导致该区域金属疲劳不断累积。22年来，维修人员一直没有发现任何异常情况。飞机出现裂缝后，发生了解压解体。根据事故后回收的机身情况来看，裂缝至少有90.5英寸长，而且研究表明，在空中如果裂缝长度超过58英寸，飞机结构就可能会坍塌。

cards.audioText: Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport, also known as Jiuzhaigou Airport and Jiuhuang Airport, is an airport in Songpan County, Sichuan province. It is about 240 km from Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport, an important aviation hub of Southwest China. It is one of the highest airport in the world with an altitude of3448 meters. There are breathtaking mountain ranges on both sides of the axis of the runway, and the highest Xuebao peak is the main peak of Minshan Mountain, more than 18000 feet above the sea level. The terrain is complex and wind changes rapidly near the airport. So it is considered one of the most difficult airports to fly to in China, aircraft must typically fly at a faster airspeed in order to takeoff or land, but those who fly over here are also amazed by the beautiful scenery. Due to the high elevation, some passengers may experience symptoms of altitude sickness. This should be taken into consideration when planning to fly into or out of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 九寨黄龙机场，又称九寨沟机场、九黄机场，位于四川省松潘县。它距离中国西南地区重要的航空枢纽成都双流国际机场约240公里。该机场是世界上海拔最高的机场之一，海拔达3448米。跑道中轴线两侧是令人叹为观止的山脉，其中最高的雪宝顶是岷山的主峰，海拔超过18000英尺。机场附近地形复杂，风向变化迅速。因此，它被认为是中国飞行难度最大的机场之一，飞机在起降时通常必须以更快的空速飞行，但飞过这里的人也会对这里的美丽景色惊叹不已。由于海拔较高，一些乘客可能会出现高原反应症状。在计划进出该机场时，这一点应该加以考虑。

cards.audioText: On December 7th 2016, a Pakistan International Airlines ATR42, performing flightPakistan661 from Chitral to Islamabad reported the failure of the left hand engine. The crew shut the engine down and continued towards Islamabad descending, some time later, they declared Mayday and shortly afterwards radio and radar contact was lost. The aircraft was unable to maintain heading and turned left before impact with the ground. The airline reported there were 42 passengers, 3 flight crew, 2 cabin crew and a mechanics on board of the aircraft, and all occupants of the aircraft perished in the crash. The investigation into the crash showed that the a accident was caused by technical factors and was not caused by human error. The flight crew of Pakistan661 faced an very complex technical error, that had never occurred before. Due to maintenance irregularities, a turbine blade fractured causing further damage, that made it impossible to control the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 2016年12月7日，一架巴基斯坦国际航空公司的ATR42飞机执行从奇特拉尔飞往伊斯兰堡的巴基斯坦661号航班任务时，报告左侧发动机故障。机组人员关闭了该发动机，继续朝着伊斯兰堡下降飞行。一段时间后，他们发出了遇险信号（Mayday），不久之后，无线电和雷达联系均中断。这架飞机无法保持航向，在撞击地面之前向左转向。该航空公司报告称，机上有42名乘客、3名飞行机组人员、2名客舱机组人员以及1名机械师，机上所有人员都在此次坠机事故中遇难。对此次坠机事故的调查显示，事故是由技术因素导致的，并非人为失误造成。巴基斯坦661号航班的机组人员面临着一个极其复杂的、此前从未出现过的技术故障。由于维护方面的不合规操作，一个涡轮叶片断裂，进而造成了进一步的损坏，使得飞机无法操控。

cards.audioText: A My Cargo Airlines Boeing 747-400 freighter on behalf of Turkish Airlines, performing flight TK-6491 from Hong Kong to Bishkek with 4 crew, was on final approach to Bishkek's runway 26 at 07:18 local time when the aircraft went around from very low height but did not climb out to safety altitude, impacted terrain about 1100 meters past the runway end and went through a couple of houses of a village. All 4 crew on board the 747 as well as 35 people on the ground perished, 8 people on the ground received injuries and were taken to hospitals. The cause of the Boeing 747 aircraft accident was the missing control of the crew over the aircraft position in relation to the glideslope during the automatic approach. The flight was conducted at night in the weather conditions, which is suitable for ICAO CAT Il landing. And as a result, the go-around was not taken in due time and the aircraft had a significant deviation from the established approach chart, which led to the controlled flight into terrain.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架代表土耳其航空公司的麦卡戈货运航空公司（MyCargo Airlines）的波音747-400型货机，执飞从香港飞往比什凯克的TK-6491航班，机上有4名机组人员。当地时间07：18，这架飞机在对比什凯克26号跑道进行最后进近时，在很低的高度进行了复飞，但未能爬升至安全高度，在飞过跑道末端约1100米处撞击到了地面，并穿过了一个村庄的几栋房屋。这架波音747飞机上的4名机组人员以及地面上的35人不幸遇难，8名地面人员受伤并被送往医院。这起波音747飞机事故的原因是，在自动进近过程中，机组人员未能正确掌控飞机相对于下滑道的位置。此次飞行是在夜间进行的，当时的天气条件适合国际民用航空组织（ICAO）二类着陆标准。结果，机组人员没有及时进行复飞，并且飞机严重偏离了既定的进近图表，最终导致了可控飞行撞地事故的发生。

cards.audioText: On April 29th 2013, a National Air Cargo Boeing 747-400 freighter on behalf of US Mobility Command, performing cargo flight from Bagram to Dubai with 7 crew and cargo consisting of 5 military vehicles, has crashed shortly after takeoff. All 7 crew are reported perished in the crash. Afghan Authorities immediately denied claims that the crash of a large civilian cargo aircraft was the result of enemy activities. Several observers on the ground reported the National Air Cargo Boeing 747 had just lifted off and was climbing through approximately 1200 feet when its nose sharply rose, the aircraft appeared to have stalled and came down. According to a listener on frequency, the crew reported the aircraft stalled due to a possible load shift. The National Transportation Safety Board determined that the probable cause of this accident was National Airlines' inadequate procedures for restraining special cargo loads, which resulted in the loadmaster's improper restraint of the cargo. The cargo moved after and damaged hydraulic systems Nos.1 and 2 and horizontal stabilizer drive mechanism components, rendering the airplane uncontrollable.
cards.audioTextZh: 2013年4月29日，一架代表美国机动司令部的美国国家航空货运公司（National Air Cargo）的波音747-400型货机，搭载着7名机组人员和包括5辆军用车辆在内的货物，执行从巴格拉姆飞往迪拜的货运航班任务，在起飞后不久坠毁。据报道，机上7名机组人员全部在此次坠机事故中遇难。阿富汗当局立即否认了这架大型民用货机坠毁是敌方活动所致的说法。地面上的几名目击者称，这架美国国家航空货运公司的波音747飞机刚刚起飞，在爬升至大约1200英尺高度时，机头急剧上扬，飞机似乎失速并坠落。据监听相关频率的人员称，机组人员报告称飞机可能因货物移位而失速。美国国家运输安全委员会认定，这起事故的可能原因是美国国家航空公司在约束特殊货物装载方面的程序不完善，导致货物装卸主管对货物的固定不当。货物移动后损坏了1号和2号液压系统以及水平安定面驱动机构部件，致使飞机失去控制。

cards.audioText: On June 10th 2018, an American Airlines Boeing 777-200 performing flight AA60 from Tokyo to Dallas with 269 people on board, was on approach to Dallas descending through about 9000 feet when the aircraft encountered moderate turbulence. According to National Transportation Safety Board, as the flight began its descent into KDF, the captain illuminated the seat belt sign and made a public address announcement reminding passengers to buckle up for the remainder of the flight. Then the airplane entered a band of small cumulus clouds and experienced 10-15 seconds of moderate turbulence. When the turbulence was encountered, the flight attendants were conducting their final cabin safety checks, so 7 flight attendants received minor injuries, one passenger, who ignored the seat-belt sign and instructions to remain seated, injured his left ankle. The aircraft continued for a landing on Dallas airport runway 18R without further incident about 12 minutes later. The flight crew requested paramedics to meet the airplane at the gate. Finally, the passenger was transported to the hospital, and the 7 flight attendants were treated at the airplane and released.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年6月10日，一架美国航空公司的波音777-200型飞机执行从东京飞往达拉斯的AA60航班，机上载有269人。当飞机下降至约9000英尺高度，正在进近达拉斯时，遭遇了中度颠簸。根据美国国家运输安全委员会的报告，当航班开始下降飞往达拉斯沃思堡国际机场（KDF）时，机长打开了安全带指示灯，并通过客舱广播提醒乘客在航班剩余时间内系好安全带。随后，飞机进入了一片小块积云区域，并经历了10到15秒的中度颠簸。遭遇颠簸时，空乘人员正在进行最后的客舱安全检查，因此7名空乘人员受了轻伤。有一名乘客无视安全带指示灯以及要求其留在座位上的指示，结果左脚踝受伤。大约12分钟后，这架飞机继续在达拉斯机场18R跑道降落，此后未再发生其他意外情况。机组人员要求医护人员在登机口迎接飞机。最后，那名受伤乘客被送往医院，7名受伤的空乘人员在飞机上接受了治疗后并无大碍。

cards.audioText: On March 31st 2014, A Jetblue Embraer ERJ-190 performing flight B6-876 from Kingston to Fort Lauderdale with 98 passengers, encountered smoke in cockpit shortly after departure. The aircraft was cleared to FL340 proceeding north towards the boundary with Havana and was about to contact Havana Control when the smell of smoke was detected by the cockpit crew and after some discussion, the decision was made to return to Kingston. The crew declared an emergency to air traffic control, then the captain elected to hand over pilot flying duties to the first officer in order to give his attention to the overall management of the situation. Both pilots put on their Oxygen masks, and began the descent and preparations to return to Kingston and they made the decision to evacuate the aircraft on the runway. Finally the aircraft landed safely about 15 minutes after takeoff. 6 injured passengers received medical assistance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 2014年3月31日，一架捷蓝航空的巴西航空工业公司ERJ-190型飞机执飞从金斯敦飞往劳德代尔堡的B6-876航班，机上载有98名乘客，在起飞后不久驾驶舱内出现烟雾。这架飞机获批爬升至340飞行高度层（FL340），向北朝着与哈瓦那的边界飞行。就在即将联系哈瓦那空管时，驾驶舱机组人员察觉到了烟雾气味。经过一番讨论后，机组决定返回金斯敦。机组人员向空中交通管制部门宣布了紧急情况，随后机长选择将操纵飞机的职责移交给副驾驶，以便自己能专注于整体情况的处理。两名飞行员都戴上了氧气面罩，开始下降并为返回金斯敦做准备，他们还决定在跑道上疏散乘客。最终，这架飞机在起飞约15分钟后安全着陆。6名受伤的乘客在着陆后接受了医疗救助。

cards.audioText: On August 11th 2016, a Jetblue Airbus A320-200, performing flight B6-429 from Boston, to Sacramento with 146 passengers and 5 crew, was climbing from FL320 presumably to FL340 when the crew stopped the climb at FL334 about 90 nm southeast of Rapid City, due to turbulence causing injuries to 24 passengers and 3 cabin crew. The aircraft diverted t Rapid City for a safe landing on runway 32 about 25 minutes after stopping the climb at FL334. The 27 injured were taken to a hospital with minor injuries. Passengers reported those not belted into their seats were lifted against the ceiling and then slammed down again. A number of cabin ceiling panels received cracks. A replacement A320 was dispatched to Rapid City and reached Sacramento with a delay of 7.5 hours. According to National Transportation Safety Board, probable cause of the occurrence was an inadvertent encounter with convective turbulence while in cruise flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 2016年8月11日，一架捷蓝航空的空客A320-200型飞机执行从波士顿飞往萨克拉门托的B6-429航班，机上载有146名乘客和5名机组人员。当飞机从320飞行高度层（FL320）爬升，预计要升至340飞行高度层时，机组在拉皮德城东南约90海里处的334飞行高度层（FL334）停止了爬升，原因是气流颠簸导致24名乘客和3名客舱机组人员受伤。在FL334高度层停止爬升约25分钟后，这架飞机备降拉皮德城，在32号跑道安全着陆。27名伤者被送往医院，均为轻伤。乘客们称，没有系好安全带的人被抛向天花板，然后又重重地摔下来。客舱的一些天花板镶板出现了裂缝。一架替补的A320飞机被派往拉皮德城，最终晚点7.5小时抵达萨克拉门托。根据美国国家运输安全委员会的说法，这起事件的可能原因是飞机在巡航飞行时意外遭遇了对流性颠簸。

cards.audioText: A Sun Express Germany Boeing 737-800, performing flight XG-3208 from Burgas to Frankfurt, was cleared to climb to and maintain FL220. At the same time, a Go2Sky Boeing 737-800 performing flight 6D-6129 from Antalya to Bratislava was en route at FL240 did not want to change their flight level. ATC instructed XG-3208 to turn left onto a heading 270. The crew however, read back "Climb FL270", which was not picked up by ATC. The crew selected FL270 into their Selected Altitude, and this was duly transmitted by Mode-S to the controller's desk, where a disagree message appeared between cleared and assigned altitude. The aircraft began to climb, about 15 seconds later, the radar issued a short term conflict alert between XG-3208 and 6D-6129. Then ATC instructed XG-3208 to descend back to FL220 immediately, 4 seconds later the crew read that instruction back. And the aircraft already climbed through FL236. The separation reduced to 0 feet vertically and 2.6 nm horizontally and the aircraft continued to climb reaching FL250, and re-establishing vertical separation. ATC thus instructed XG-3208 to continue the climb to FL260.
cards.audioTextZh: .一架德国阳光快运航空公司（Sun Express Germany）的波音737-800型飞机，执飞从布尔加斯飞往法兰克福的XG-3208航班，获得许可爬升至并保持在220飞行高度层（FL220）。与此同时，一架Go2Sky航空公司的波音737-800型飞机执飞从安塔利亚飞往布拉迪斯拉发的6D-6129航班，正在240飞行高度层（FL240）航路上飞行，且不想改变其飞行高度层。空中交通管制（ATC）指令XG-3208航班左转至航向270度。然而，机组复诵的是“爬升至270飞行高度层（FL270）”，而空中交通管制并未注意到这一错误复诵。机组人员在其选定高度设置中选择了FL270，并且通过S模式适时地将这一信息传输到了管制员的操作台上，此时在许可高度和设定高度之间出现了不一致的提示信息。飞机开始爬升，大约15秒后，雷达发出了XG-3208航班和6D-6129航班之间的短期冲突警报。随后，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班立即下降至FL220，4秒后机组复诵了该指令。而此时飞机已经爬升至236飞行高度层。两机的垂直间隔缩小至0英尺，水平间隔为2.6海里，并且这架飞机继续爬升，达到了250飞行高度层，随后重新建立了垂直间隔。因此，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班继续爬升至260飞行高度层。

cards.audioText: On January 29th 2015, a Ryanair Boeing 737-800, performing FR-8592 from London to Bergerac, was on NDB approach Y to Bergerac's runway 28 in instrument meteorological conditions. The aircraft descended below minimum safe altitude when it was handed off to tower. The approach controller received a Minimum Safe Altitude Warning and thee aircraft's EGPWS issued a warning, too. The crew initiated a go-around and the aircraft climbed to safe altitude. Then the crew positioned for another approach and landed safely on runway 28 about 24 minutes after aborting the first approach. According to the investigation, the incident occurred while the aircraft performed an NDB approach without DME, probably without external visual references. Meanwhile, the first preparation of the approach was probably incomplete or imprecise. As a result, the late modification did not permit the crew to agree on the guidance modes. This resulted in confusion of the captain as to the horizontal trajectory to be followed by the aircraft. This state of confusion led him to request an early descent below the safety altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 2015年1月29日，一架瑞安航空的波音737-800型飞机执行从伦敦飞往贝杰拉克的FR-8592航班，在仪表气象条件下，采用无方向信标（NDB）进近方式，朝着贝杰拉克机场28号跑道进近。当飞机移交给塔台管制时，它下降到了最低安全高度以下。进近管制员收到了最低安全高度警告，飞机的增强型近地警告系统（EGPWS）也发出了警告。机组人员启动了复飞程序，飞机爬升至安全高度。然后机组人员重新调整位置准备再次进近，并在放弃第一次进近约24分钟后，安全降落在28号跑道上。根据调查，这起事件发生在飞机在没有测距仪（DME）且可能没有外部目视参考的情况下进行无方向信标进近时。同时，第一次进近的准备工作可能不完整或不准确。因此，后期的修正没能让机组人员就引导模式达成一致。这导致机长对于飞机应遵循的水平航线感到困惑。这种困惑的状态使他要求飞机提前下降到安全高度以下。

cards.audioText: On October 25th 2018, a Vueling Airbus A320-200, performing flight VY-1431 from Bilbao to Barcelona with 114 passengers and 6 crew, departed Bilbao's runway. At that time, the left engine dropped two bonnets. In the absence of any abnormal indications and unaware of the separation, the crew continued the flight to Barcelona for a safe landing. Although a part of the engine cowling became stuck in the left main gear, the gear retracted normally after takeoff and extended in Barcelona without problems. The aircraft received minor damage at the left main gear and the left side of the fuselage where debris hit, however all persons on board disembarked normally, no medical attention was needed. The investigation has determined that the incident was caused by flying the airplane without closing and properly latching the cowls on the airplane's left engine, which was in turn caused by an improper maintenance operation, and by the incorrect performance of the walk-around check prior to the flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年10月25日，一架伏林航空（Vueling）的空客A320-200型飞机执行从毕尔巴鄂飞往巴塞罗那的VY-1431航班，机上载有114名乘客和6名机组人员，从毕尔巴鄂机场跑道起飞。就在那时，左发动机的两个发动机罩脱落了。由于没有任何异常指示，机组人员也未察觉到部件脱落，便继续飞往巴塞罗那并安全着陆。尽管有一部分发动机整流罩卡在了左主起落架上，但起落架在起飞后正常收起，在巴塞罗那着陆前也正常放下，没有出现问题。飞机的左主起落架以及机身左侧被碎片击中的部位受到了轻微损伤，不过机上所有人员都正常下机，无人需要医疗救治。调查认定，这起事件的原因是飞机在左发动机整流罩未关闭且未正确锁好的情况下起飞，而这又是由不当的维修操作以及飞行前绕机检查执行不到位所导致的。

cards.audioText: On April 28th 2018, a Qantas Boeing 737-800, performing flight QF567 from Sydney to Perth, had safely landed on Perth's runway 03, vacated the runway via taxiway J2 but taxied past the hold short point of runway 06 and crossed an illuminated stop bar without an air traffic control clearance. Another Qantas Boeing 737-800, performing flight QF582 from Perth to Sydney, was accelerating for takeoff from runway 06 when QF567 crossed the hold short line on taxiway J2, prompting tower to instruct QF582 to stop immediately. QF582 rejected takeoff and came to a stop near taxiway J2. The aircraft vacated the runway via taxiway A and returned to the apron. The Australia Transport Safety Bureau report into the serious incident has blamed taxiway design, flight crew distraction and incorrect mental model for the runway incursion of another flight QF567. The ATSB said that soon after, the flight crew of QF567 became aware of their position and stopped their aircraft just before crossing the edge of runway 06 with QF582's wingtip passing about 15 meters from QF567's nose at low speed just before coming to a stop.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年4月28日，一架澳航（Qantas）的波音737-800型飞机执行从悉尼飞往珀斯的QF567航班，已安全降落在珀斯机场的03号跑道上，随后通过J2滑行道脱离跑道，但滑行时越过了06号跑道的等待点，并且在未经空中交通管制许可的情况下穿过了亮起的停止标志杆。另一架澳航的波音737-800型飞机，执飞从珀斯飞往悉尼的QF582航班，正在06号跑道上加速准备起飞，就在这时QF567航班越过了J2滑行道上的等待线，这促使塔台立即指示QF582航班停止。QF582航班中止了起飞，在J2滑行道附近停了下来。这架飞机随后通过A滑行道脱离跑道，返回停机坪。澳大利亚运输安全局（Australia Transport Safety Bureau）对这起严重事件的报告指出，QF567航班发生跑道侵入事件的原因在于滑行道设计问题、机组人员注意力分散以及对跑道情况的错误心理认知模式。澳大利亚运输安全局表示，不久后，QF567航班的机组人员意识到了他们的位置，在即将越过06号跑道边缘前停下了飞机，而QF582航班的翼尖在即将停下前以低速从距离QF567航班机头约15米处掠过。

cards.audioText: On Nov 20th 2013, an Atlas Air Boeing 747-400 Dreamlifter, performing freight flight 5Y4241 from New York to Wichita McConnell Airbase, with 2 crew, was on a GPS/RNAV approach to Mcconnell Airport's runway 19L, but unintentionally landed on runway 18 of Wichita's Jabara Airport, and managed to stop the aircraft on the runway. The crew subsequently reported to be on the ground and intending to vacate via taxiway D, to which the puzzled tower responded "stand by", then reporting they were about 8 nm from the aerodrome. The crew believed they had landed on Wichita's Beech Airport, the even more puzzled tower controller replied "confirm you landed at Beech Airport?", the crew requested the UNICOM frequency for Beech after the tower had reported the tower was closed at that time of the night. McConnell Tower then reported the coordinates of Beech Airport, the crew returned the coordinates, after which tower identified the airport as Jabara according to those position data. In the meantime a person on the ground had arrived at the aircraft and told the crew the local frequency. The aircraft and airport sustained no damage.
cards.audioTextZh: 2013年11月20日，一架阿特拉斯航空（Atlas Air）的波音747-400“梦想运输者”（Dreamlifter）货机，执行从纽约飞往威奇托麦康奈尔空军基地的5Y4241货运航班，机上有两名机组人员。该飞机当时正采用全球定位系统/区域导航（GPS/RNAV）进近方式，准备降落至麦康奈尔机场的19L跑道，但却意外降落在了威奇托贾巴拉机场的18跑道上，并且成功在跑道上使飞机停了下来。随后，机组人员报告称已在地面，并打算通过D滑行道脱离跑道，对此感到困惑的塔台回应称“请稍等”，然后机组报告称他们距离机场大约8海里。机组人员认为他们降落在了威奇托的比奇机场，更加困惑的塔台管制员回应道“确认你们降落在了比奇机场？”。在塔台告知当晚那个时候比奇机场的塔台已经关闭后，机组人员索要了比奇机场的通用航空无线电台（UNICOM）频率。接着，麦康奈尔机场塔台报告了比奇机场的坐标，机组人员回复了坐标，之后塔台根据那些位置数据确定该机场是贾巴拉机场。与此同时，地面上有一个人来到了飞机旁，并告知了机组人员当地的频率。飞机和机场均未受到损坏。

cards.audioText: A bmi Regional Embraer ERJ-145, performing flight BM1753 from Munich to Norrkoping with 18 passengers and 3 crew, was self-positioning for an ILS approach to Norrkoping's runway 27. The aircraft was cleared to descend to 2100 feet and cleared the approach to runway 27. At the same time an ultralight aircraft was operating below the controlled airspace in uncontrolled airspace performing a VFR flight, the two aircraft were on different radio frequencies. While still positioning to intercept the localizer, the aircraft automatically turned west and began to descend, one pilot believed they were capturing the glideslope, the other pilot believed they were on localizer and above glide. The crew changed from automatic glideslope coupling to vertical speed and increased the rate of descent to re-capture the glideslope. The crew subsequently queried about the target on their TCAS screen and the altitude of the Embraer. When the distance reduced to 1 nautical mile horizontally and 200 feet vertically, the Embraer's TCAS issued a resolution advisory, and the crew initiated a go-around. The aircraft positioned for another approach and landed safely about 10 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架英国米德兰地区航空公司（bmi Regional）的巴西航空工业公司ERJ-145型飞机，执飞从慕尼黑飞往北雪平的BM1753航班，机上载有18名乘客和3名机组人员，当时正在自行调整位置，准备采用仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近北雪平机场的27号跑道。这架飞机获得许可下降至2100英尺，并获批进近27号跑道。与此同时，一架超轻型飞机在管制空域下方的非管制空域内进行目视飞行规则（VFR）飞行，两架飞机使用的是不同的无线电频率。在仍处于调整位置以截获航向道的时候，这架飞机自动向西转弯并开始下降。一名飞行员认为他们正在截获下滑道，而另一名飞行员则认为他们处于航向道上且在下滑道上方。机组人员将自动下滑道耦合模式改为垂直速度模式，并增加了下降率以重新截获下滑道。随后，机组人员对他们的空中交通防撞系统（TCAS）屏幕上的目标以及这架ERJ-145飞机的高度提出了疑问。当两机的水平距离缩小至1海里、垂直距离缩小至200英尺时，这架ERJ-145飞机的防撞系统发出了避让建议，机组人员启动了复飞程序。这架飞机重新调整位置进行再次进近，并在大约10分钟后安全着陆。

cards.audioText: On September 30th 2018, an Easyjet Airbus A319 performing flight U2-211 from London to Glasgow, with 148 passengers and 6 crew was descending towards Glasgow when the first officer, pilot flying, became unfit to fly, relinquished control to the captain and left the cockpit. The commander declared PAN and continued for a safe landing in Glasgow. The probable cause of the incident was that the co-pilot experienced anxiety which developed into an anxiety attack during the approach to Glasgow. Thee commander, ATC and cabin crew worked together effectively to achieve a safe single pilot landing and to get medical help for the co-pilot. The opportunity for the incident to occur might have been reduced by the co-pilot reporting unfit for duty, more effective communication between the co-pilot and the commander, and use of support available from peers or one of the official assistance programmes.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年9月30日，一架易捷航空（Easyjet）的空客A319型飞机执行从伦敦飞往格拉斯哥的U2-211航班，机上载有148名乘客和6名机组人员。在飞机朝着格拉斯哥下降的过程中，担任操纵飞行员的副驾驶身体状况不适宜继续飞行，便将飞机控制权移交给机长，随后离开了驾驶舱。机长宣布了“PAN”（表示遇到紧急情况但尚未达到最危急程度的信号），并继续安全降落在格拉斯哥。这起事件的可能原因是，副驾驶在进近格拉斯哥的过程中产生了焦虑情绪，进而发展成了焦虑发作。机长、空中交通管制人员以及客舱机组人员进行了有效协作，成功实现了单飞行员安全着陆，并为副驾驶提供了医疗救助。如果副驾驶能更早报告自己不适宜执行任务，副驾驶与机长之间能进行更有效的沟通，或者副驾驶能利用同事提供的支持，或者借助官方援助项目之一，那么这起事件发生的可能性或许会降低。

cards.audioText: An AirAsia Airbus 330-300, with 359 people on board, was en route at FL380 about 200 nautical mile southwest of Perth. Then the left hand engine suffered a blade fracture. The engine ingested the blade and caused severe damage in engine core and severe vibrations. The crew shut the engine down, and drifted the aircraft down to FL200, and returned to Perth for a safe landing about 2 hours after the engine failure. Passengers reported they heard a large bang, followed by severe vibrations, and sounds like a spinning washing machine. They were instructed to brace for landing. Australia's emergency services reported, they put their marine emergency services on standby for a possible water landing. The airline reported the aircraft returned to Perth due to a technical problem, but they didn't confirm it is an engine issue. Emergency services were called as precaution only as part of the standard operating procedures. The passengers then rebooked onto other flights.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架载有359人的亚洲航空（AirAsia）空客A330-300型飞机，当时正在珀斯西南约200海里处、380飞行高度层（FL380）的航路上飞行。随后，其左侧发动机的一个叶片发生断裂。发动机吸入了该叶片，导致发动机核心部分受到严重损坏，并引发了剧烈振动。机组人员关闭了这台发动机，让飞机下降至200飞行高度层（FL200），并在发动机失效约2小时后返回珀斯安全着陆。乘客们称，他们听到了一声巨响，紧接着是剧烈的振动，还听到了类似旋转的洗衣机发出的声音。他们接到指令，要做好着陆的防冲击姿势。澳大利亚的应急服务部门报告称，他们让海上应急服务处于待命状态，以防飞机可能会在水上迫降。该航空公司表示，飞机因技术问题返回珀斯，但并未确认这是发动机问题。呼叫应急服务部门只是作为预防措施，是标准操作程序的一部分。之后，乘客们重新预订了其他航班。

cards.audioText: An Eastar Jet B737-800, performing flight from Korea to Japan, was cleared for the approach to runway 03L. However, the aircraft was aligned with runway 03R. But the runway 03R was occupied by a vehicle. The aircraft went around from very low height. Then it positioned for another approach to runway 03L. Finally, the aircraft landed safely on runway 03L about 9 minutes after the go around. JTSB reported, that they have opened an investigation into the incident. The east side runway was occupied by a vehicle when the aircraft attempted to land on. But the aircraft didn't land on the right runway as instructed by ATC. The aircraft went around and landed at the west side runway 9 minutes later. JTSB released their final report, explaining the probable causes of the serious incident. In this serious incident, it is highly probable that because the captain of the aircraft misidentified the runway. He made an approach for the different runway where an inspection vehicle was running on.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架东星航空（Eastar Jet）的波音737-800型飞机，执行从韩国飞往日本的航班任务，获得许可进近03L跑道。然而，这架飞机却对准了03R跑道。但03R跑道上有一辆车辆占用。飞机在很低的高度进行了复飞。随后，它重新调整位置，准备再次进近03L跑道。最终，在复飞约9分钟后，这架飞机安全降落在了03L跑道上。日本运输安全委员会（JTSB）报告称，他们已对这起事件展开调查。当飞机试图降落时，东侧跑道（03R跑道）被一辆车辆占用。但飞机没有按照空中交通管制（ATC）的指示降落在正确的跑道上。飞机进行了复飞，并在9分钟后降落在了西侧跑道（03L跑道）上。日本运输安全委员会发布了最终报告，解释了这起严重事件的可能原因。在这起严重事件中，极有可能是因为飞机机长认错了跑道，所以他对准了有一辆检查车辆正在行驶的另一条跑道进行进近。

cards.audioText: An Air France Airbus A319-100, performs flight from London to Paris with 136 people on board. When the aircraft was climbing through FL230, the crew donned their oxygen masks, declared Mayday and requested an immediate return to London. The crew advised they suspected a fire on board, and then, they reported they had smoke and fumes in the cockpit. The aircraft landed safely back on runway 13R about 23 minutes after departure. The crew advised they were able to vacate the runway as the flight attendants confirmed there was no fire on board. Finally, the aircraft taxied to the apron. The aircraft was able to depart about 4 hours after landing, and reached Paris with a delay of 4.5 hours. Maintenance identified a faulty display as source of the fumes and smoke. The incident was evoked by internal failure of the top middle display unit of the cockpit dashboard.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架法国航空公司（Air France）的空客A319-100型飞机，执行从伦敦飞往巴黎的航班，机上载有136人。当飞机爬升至230飞行高度层（FL230）时，机组人员戴上了氧气面罩，发出了遇险信号（Mayday），并请求立即返回伦敦。机组人员表示，他们怀疑飞机上有火灾，随后，他们报告称驾驶舱内有烟雾。这架飞机在起飞约23分钟后安全返回，降落在13R跑道上。机组人员表示，由于空乘人员确认机上没有火灾，他们得以驶离跑道。最后，飞机滑行至停机坪。这架飞机在降落后约4小时得以再次起飞，晚点4.5小时抵达巴黎。维修人员确定，有故障的显示屏是烟雾的来源。这起事件是由驾驶舱仪表盘顶部中间显示单元的内部故障引发的。

cards.audioText: A Scoot Airbus A319-100, performing flight Philippines to Singapore with 129 people onboard, was descending towards Singapore when the flight crew donned their oxygen masks and declared PAN PAN, reporting excessive cabin altitude, and initiated an emergency descent to 9000 feet. The aircraft continued to Singapore for a safe landing on runway 20C about 23 minutes after declaring PAN PAN. The likely cause of the excessive cabin altitude was a corruption of LFE that is landing field elevation in the CPC. The CPC manufacturer believed that the corruption arose from a fatigue solder joint on the CPC circuit board. There had been past occurrences of excessive cabin altitude that were caused by a corruption of LFE value in the CPC, of which one was determined to have likely been caused by a fatigue solder joint, similar to this occurrence.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架酷航（Scoot）的空客A319-100型飞机，搭载着129名乘客，执行从菲律宾飞往新加坡的航班任务。在飞机朝着新加坡下降的过程中，机组人员戴上了氧气面罩，发出了“PAN PAN”（表示紧急情况但情况尚不太危急的信号），报告客舱高度过高，并启动了紧急下降程序，降至9000英尺高度。在发出“PAN PAN”信号约23分钟后，这架飞机继续飞往新加坡，并安全降落在20C跑道上。客舱高度过高的可能原因是客舱压力控制器（CPC）中的着陆场海拔（LFE）数据出现错误。客舱压力控制器的制造商认为，该数据错误是由客舱压力控制器电路板上的一个焊点疲劳导致的。过去也曾发生过客舱高度过高的情况，原因也是客舱压力控制器中的着陆场海拔数值错误，其中有一次经判定很可能是由焊点疲劳引起的，与此次事件的情况类似。

cards.audioText: On 26 June 2006, a British Airways Airbus A320-20O pushed back using a towbarless tractor at London Heathrow Airport. But that unit was disconnected from the aircraft. After receiving taxi clearance from ATC, the aircraft started moving under its own power, and shortly afterwards, collided with the tractor that had just performed the pushback. Both the right engine of the aircraft and the tractor were damaged. The investigation report published in May 2017 stated, that the primary causal factor of the accident, was the headset operator giving the "all clear" signal to the flight crew, before the tractor had been repositioned to a safe distance from the aircraft. Contributory factors were the co-pilot failing to see the tractor. What's more, the fact that the tractor didn't drive away after the aircraft began to taxi was also a reason for this accident.
cards.audioTextZh: 2006年6月26日，一架英国航空公司的空客A320-200型飞机在伦敦希思罗机场使用无拖把牵引车进行后推操作。但牵引车与飞机脱开了连接。在得到空中交通管制（ATC）的滑行许可后，飞机开始依靠自身动力移动，不久之后，就与刚刚完成后推操作的牵引车相撞。飞机的右发动机和牵引车均遭到损坏。2017年5月发布的调查报告称，这起事故的主要原因是，在牵引车还未重新移动到离飞机安全距离之外时，头戴式耳机操作员就向机组人员发出了“一切正常”的信号。促成事故发生的因素包括副驾驶没有看到牵引车。此外，在飞机开始滑行后，牵引车没有驶离这一情况也是导致这起事故的一个原因。

cards.audioText: On August 1st 2018, an Aeromexico Connect ERJ'190 from Durango to Mexico rejected takeoff from Durango's runway 03 because of adverse weather at about 15:15 local time. The aircraft veered left off the runway, overran the end of the runway and burst into flames in viewing distance of the airport's apron. The aircraft was destroyed, there were no fatalities, 2 people received serious injuries and 83 people received minor injuries. Some people with injuries were taken to a local hospital. The airline stated there were 99 passengers including 2 infants and 4 crew on board. The aircraft was 10 years old and had operated for Aeromexico since 2014. The local governor reported the aircraft was about to take off when the aircraft suffered an accident. According to flight data recorder as well as cockpit voice recorder, the pilots did a good job to bring the plane down, which prevented things from worse to catastrophe.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年8月1日，当地时间约15点15分，一架墨西哥航空连接公司（Aeromexico Connect）的ERJ190型飞机执行从杜兰戈飞往墨西哥城的航班任务，由于恶劣天气，在杜兰戈机场03跑道上中断起飞。飞机向左偏离跑道，冲出跑道末端，并在机场停机坪可视范围内起火燃烧。这架飞机损毁严重，所幸无人员死亡，2人受重伤，83人受轻伤。一些受伤人员被送往当地医院。该航空公司称，机上有99名乘客（包括2名婴儿）和4名机组人员。这架飞机已服役10年，自2014年起为墨西哥航空公司执飞任务。当地州长报告称，飞机在即将起飞时发生了事故。根据飞行数据记录器以及驾驶舱语音记录器显示，飞行员们采取了有效措施使飞机停下，避免了事态恶化成一场灾难。

cards.audioText: A Delta Airlines Airbus 330, performing a flight from New York to Paris, was en route at FL380 about 700 nm southwest of Reykjavik airport, Iceland when the crew decided to divert to Iceland, reporting with left hand engine failure. The crew requested to descend to FL320 and set course for Reykjavik. The diversion was approved by Oceanic Control within a minute, however, the request to descent took more than 15 minutes due to a lot of traffic around that needed to be moved out. The aircraft continued to maintain FL380 in the meantime. Finally, the aircraft descended to FL290 and landed safely on Iceland about 2 hours after the decision to divert. After the landing, another aircraft was sent from Amsterdam to fly the 96 passengers and cargo from Iceland to Paris. According to the investigation, the crew attempted to move the thrust lever back and forth when the engine started to vibrate, but this resulted in the engine stalling a number of times. The crew thus declared emergency and diverted to Iceland on single engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架达美航空公司（Delta Airlines）的空客330型飞机，执行从纽约飞往巴黎的航班任务。当飞机在冰岛雷克雅未克机场西南约700海里处、处于380飞行高度层（FL380）的航路上时，机组人员决定备降冰岛，报告称左侧发动机出现故障。机组人员请求下降到320飞行高度层（FL320），并设定飞往雷克雅未克的航线。大洋管制部门在一分钟内就批准了此次备降，然而，由于周围空域有大量航班，需要先进行调配，所以下降请求过了15分钟才获批。在此期间，飞机继续保持在380飞行高度层。最终，这架飞机下降到290飞行高度层（FL290），并在决定备降约2小时后安全降落在冰岛。飞机降落后，另一架从阿姆斯特丹派出的飞机将机上的96名乘客和货物从冰岛运往巴黎。根据调查，当发动机开始出现振动时，机组人员试图来回移动推力杆，但这导致发动机多次失速。于是，机组人员宣布了紧急情况，并以单发动机状态备降冰岛。

cards.audioText: A visual approach is an ATC authorization for aircraft on IFR flight plan to proceed visually to the airport, even to the landing. It is not an instrument approach procedure, and there is no missed approach segment. Even when an aircraft is being vectored for an instrument approach, controllers may initiate or pilots may request a visual approach provided the pilot subsequently reports the airport or runway in sight. Before clearing an aircraft for a visual approach, controllers should ensure that weather conditions at the airport are VFR, and they need resolve potential conflicts with all other aircraft. The pilot must, at all times, have either the airport or the preceding aircraft in sight. This approach must be authorized and under the control of the appropriate air traffic control facility. Reported weather at the airport must be ceiling at or above 1000 ft, and visibility of 3 miles or greater. An aircraft unable to complete visual approach shall be handled as any "go around", and appropriate separation must be provided.
cards.audioTextZh: 目视进近是空中交通管制（ATC）对处于仪表飞行规则（IFR）飞行计划中的飞机的一种许可，允许其以目视方式飞往机场，甚至直接着陆。它并非一种仪表进近程序，且不存在复飞航段。即使一架飞机正按引导进行仪表进近，只要飞行员随后报告已看到机场或跑道，管制员也可以发起、或者飞行员可以请求进行目视进近。在批准一架飞机进行目视进近之前，管制员应确保机场的天气状况符合目视飞行规则（VFR），并且他们需要解决与所有其他飞机之间可能存在的冲突。飞行员在任何时候都必须能够看到机场或前方的飞机。这种进近方式必须得到相应空中交通管制机构的批准并处于其管控之下。机场所报告的天气状况必须是：云底高度达到或高于1000英尺，能见度为3英里或更远。一架无法完成目视进近的飞机应按照任何“复飞”情况来处理，并且必须为其提供适当的间隔。

cards.audioText: An aircraft was ready for taxi and it was cleared to taxi to the departure runway holding point. It was also approved to cross an inner and outer taxiway en route, so the pilot released the parking brake. When the aircraft started to move, the pilot saw a B747 on his left, and the B747 went faster than him. The controller immediately instructed the pilot to hold short and give way to the B747 but the pilot only paid attention to the B747 on his left, so he didn't follow the instruction and continued to move to the threshold. The aircraft stopped when the First Officer warned "stop!" and the pilot applied the brakes at once. When a pilot made errors, the First Officer played important role. Without the First Officer, their aircraft would have probably collided with another aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架飞机在准备滑行，并且得到滑行到等待点的许可。滑行路线允许穿过内侧和外侧滑行道，所以飞行员松开了刹车。飞机开始移动后，飞行员看到左侧有一架波音747，这架波音747的速度更快。管制员立刻指挥飞机等待给波音747让路，但飞行员只注意到左侧的波音747，所以他并没有听到指令，而是继续向入口移动。副驾驶发出警告说："停下！"于是飞行员立刻进行刹车。飞行员出现错误时，副驾驶的作用很重要。如果不是副驾驶，他们的飞机很可能与另一架飞机相撞。

cards.audioText: A flight flew from Beijing to Shanghai. During the flight, the aircraft requested radar vectors to Shanghai Approach for losing some altitude. The inbound course was 157° and altitude was 3000 feet. The controller gave the instruction, "Fly heading 130°, intercept LOC Runway 16", but after following the instruction, TCAS showed several targets. Then the ATC gave another instruction, "Do not cross LOC course, for separation". The pilot responded, "Wilco." When they captured the LOC course, they reported to ATC, but ATC said, "I told you, do not capture the LOC course." Both pilots were not sure about the ATC's meaning but they continued to approach and landed safely. After the flight, the flight crew discussed about the ATC instruction, and they thought the instruction could be understood differently. It was a fortune that they landed safely, so the ATC must use standard words to give clear instructions when they were working.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架飞机从北京飞往上海。途中，飞机向上海进近申请雷达引导下降高度。向台航道157°,高度3000英尺。管制员给出指令："航向130°,切入跑道16航道。"但完成指令后，TCAS显示几个活动目标。然后ATC给出另一指令："不要穿过航道，保持间隔。"飞行员回复："照办。"飞机截获航道时，飞行员向ATC报告，但ATC说："我说的是，不要截获航道。"两位飞行员无法确定ATC的意图，但他们继续进近并安全着陆。飞行结束后，机组对ATC的指令进行讨论，他们认为指令可以有不同的理解方式。幸运的是飞机能够安全着陆，所以ATC在工作时必须使用标准用语来给出指令。

cards.audioText: At 1:30 pm local time, the crew members checked in for a long distance flight, and the aircraft took off after 3:30 pm. Another 2 hours later, the operation asked the aircraft to return back to the airport of departure because of technical fault, so the captain had to tell passengers about what was going on via PA. After landing, the flight crew had worked for about 8 hours, and their work should be taken over under the circumstances, but the operation told them that they had to change to operate another shorter and delayed flight. It was already eight o' clock after the aircraft landed. Three of the crew decided not to operate the flight and I supported their opinion. Two replacement crew members arrived at the aircraft and they still needed to operate their new flight. At about ten o'clock, everything was ready for departure. The crew members hadn't had any formal meal since then.
cards.audioTextZh: 当地时间下午1:30，机组成员到机场报到，为一次长途飞行做准备，飞机在下午3:30之后起飞。约2小时后，由于技术故障，运行控制部门要求飞机返回出发机场，机长只得通过客舱广播向乘客说明情况。飞机着陆时，机组已经工作约8小时，按当时情况本应由其他机组接替，但运行控制部门却通知他们，必须改为执行另一个航程较短但已经延误的航班。飞机落地时已是晚上8点。3名机组成员决定不再执行该航班，我支持他们的决定。两名替换机组成员随后抵达飞机，但原机组仍需执行他们新分配的航班。到晚上10点左右，一切离场准备就绪。自报到以来，机组成员一直没有吃过一顿正式的饭。

cards.audioText: In 2005, direct charter flight between Chinese mainland and Taiwan was opened. Departure and destination airports included Beijing, Guangzhou, Shanghai and Taipei. It was the first ever non-stop, round-trip charter flight across the Taiwan Straits in 56 years. It was also the first time since 1949 that a mainland jetliner flew for Taiwan on normal commercial flight. The first mainland aircraft to take off was CCA1087 which departed from the Beijing Capital Airport at 8:00 am on Saturday. All the 88 passengers on board were Taiwan business people and their families. During the Spring Festival, they went back home for traditional family reunion. The first mainland aircraft to land was CSZ3097. It only took 90 minutes for all the 242 passengers on board to fly from Guangzhou to Taipei. After nearly 4 hours of non-stop flight, a charter plane of Taiwan-based China Airlines landed in Beijing. The flight time was much shorter than the same trip in the past. Previous flight would take about 10 hours, and passengers had to transit in Hong Kong or Macao. The direct charter flight will provide convenience to people on the mainland and Taiwan.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年，中国大陆与台湾之间开通了直航包机。出发和到达机场包括北京、广州、上海和台北。这是56年来两岸首次开通不经停往返包机，也是自1949年以来，大陆喷气式客机首次执行飞往台湾的正常商业航班。最先从大陆起飞的是国航CCA1087航班，飞机于星期六上午8:00从北京首都机场起飞。机上88名乘客全部是台湾商务人士及其家属，他们在春节期间返乡与家人团聚。最先抵达台湾的是南航CSZ3097航班。机上242名乘客从广州飞往台北，全程仅用90分钟。经过近4小时不经停飞行，一架台湾中华航空公司的包机在北京着陆。与过去相同行程相比，飞行时间大幅缩短；以往需要约10小时，乘客还必须在香港或澳门中转。直航包机将为大陆和台湾民众往来提供便利。

cards.audioText: The breakup of China Airlines Flight 611, a Boeing 747-200, has drawn international attention because it comes at a time of increasing concern over how long older jets can remain airworthy. Some research has suggested that metal fatigue may be a particular problem in planes that are used regularly in very warm, humid places like Taipei and Hong Kong. But Boeing maintains that with proper maintenance, aircraft aging should not be a problem. The flight data recorder shows that the plane began gaining altitude at a significantly faster rate in the 27 seconds before the plane broke apart, although the extra gain in altitude was well within the plane's design limits. The plane was supposed to be leveling off then as it approached its cruising altitude of 35, 000 feet. According to the examination of the wreckage, investigators analyzed that there's no evidence of an explosion or pilot error.
cards.audioTextZh: 中华航空611号航班是一架波音747-200，其空中解体事件引起国际社会关注，因为人们正越来越担忧老旧喷气式飞机能够保持适航状态多长时间。一些研究认为，在台北、香港等炎热潮湿地区频繁运行的飞机尤其容易出现金属疲劳问题。但波音公司坚持认为，只要维护得当，飞机老化不应成为问题。飞行数据记录器显示，在飞机解体前27秒内，飞机的爬升率明显增大，不过增加的高度仍完全处于飞机的设计限制范围内。当时飞机接近35,000英尺巡航高度，本应正在改平。根据对残骸的检查，调查人员认为没有证据显示发生过爆炸，也没有证据表明飞行员操作失误。

cards.audioText: One day, an accident happened because an aircraft was guided improperly by a marshaller when parking. The marshaller first guided the aircraft to a gate. When the aircraft was near the stop line, the marshaller gave a premature crossed wands signal which means stopping taxiing, so the aircraft was stopped abruptly. The pilot set the parking brake and released the seatbelt sign. Unexpectedly, the marshaller showed the separated wands again and stopped them a little forward of the point. He did not give a clear signal, and the sudden stop caused fatigue and a medical emergency of 2 passengers. When the marshaller was asked about the signal, he said he did not give the signal. Anyway, it was not a good guidance but the final position of the aircraft was proper. Luckily there were no injuries on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，一架飞机在停靠机位时因信号员引导不当而发生事件。信号员先引导飞机滑向机位。飞机接近停止线时，信号员过早给出指挥棒交叉信号，表示停止滑行，飞机因此突然停下。飞行员设置停留刹车并关闭安全带指示灯。出乎意料的是，信号员随后又给出指挥棒分开信号，让飞机继续向前移动一点后才再次停下。信号员的指令不清晰，飞机突然停止导致两名乘客身体不适，其中出现医疗紧急情况。被问及相关信号时，信号员否认自己发出过该信号。无论如何，这次引导并不规范，不过飞机最终停靠位置正确。所幸机上没有人员受伤。

cards.audioText: When a B747 was climbing out, its No.1 engine failed. The failure caused the aircraft to yaw the heading about 20 degrees from the original. The Primary Engine Display showed that the thrust was zero, the engine indications were all red, and the temperature was exceeding 680℃.The aircraft had autopilot disconnection, then it suddenly yawed and the heading deviated 10 degrees. The pilot immediately leveled off the aircraft so that he could check the engine. Then he confirmed that No.1 engine was failed. The EGT temperature was still high when all proper procedures were done. So the pilot pulled out the engine fire lever to secure the engine and completed the checklist. Because of the landing weight requirements, the aircraft had to dump fuel before landing. Then the pilot requested radar vector to the fuel dumping area and started dumping fuel at 8000 feet. During the 35 minutes of dumping, the controller asked other aircraft to avoid the dumping area. At last, they made an auto landing then taxied to the gate safely.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架B747在上升，此时1号发动机失效。故障导致飞机从原航线偏航20度。主发动机显示器显示推力为零，发动机故障显示亮起，温度超过680℃。飞机的自动驾驶断开，然后飞机突然偏航10度。飞行员立刻平飞来检查发动机，然后飞行员确定1号发动机已失效。所有程序全部完成后，EGT温度仍然很高，所以飞行员拉出发动机灭火手柄来保护发动机，并完成检查单。由于着陆重量限制，飞机着陆前必须放油。飞行员请求雷达引导到放油区，然后在8000英尺高开始放油。放油持续了35分钟，这期间管制员指挥其它飞机避开放油区。最后，飞机自动着陆并安全滑到停机位。

cards.audioText: A B737 was cleared to taxi to holding point of runway 29 while the pilot saw the landing lights of A320 on landing rollout at the opposite end of the runway. A320 had landed on runway 11 and a conflict was nearly to happen. In order to exit the runway quickly, the pilot of B737 turned 180 degrees. At the same time, tower called and gave him instruction to vacate the runway. The B737 almost collided with A320 but there were nothing wrong with the two aircraft. The cause of this possible accident was that the two operations were conducted in both directions on runway 11/29. A320 was landing on runway 11 while B737 was holding short of runway 29 and waiting for ATC clearance at the same time. Then the tower called them and instructed them to fly SH-01 departure and climb 7000 feet when airborne, but they considered it as a clearance, so they began to taxi onto the runway. At that time, the tower and ground were combined. The pilot had called the tower twice without receiving any response, so he was not sure whether the aircraft had landed.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架波音737获准滑行至29号跑道等待点。此时飞行员看到一架空客A320在跑道另一端亮着着陆灯，正在着陆滑跑；该A320是在11号跑道着陆，两机险些发生冲突。为了尽快退出跑道，波音737飞行员将飞机转向180度。与此同时，塔台呼叫并指令其脱离跑道。波音737与空客A320险些相撞，但两架飞机均未受损。这起险情的原因，是11/29号跑道同时进行相反方向运行：空客A320在11号跑道着陆，而波音737在29号跑道外等待管制许可。随后塔台呼叫波音737，向其发布SH-01离场程序以及离地后爬升至7,000英尺的指令，但机组把这段指令误认为进入跑道的许可，因此开始滑入跑道。当时塔台和地面管制席位合并运行。此前飞行员曾两次呼叫塔台但都没有收到回应，因此无法确定那架飞机是否已经着陆。

cards.audioText: The ATC cleared an aircraft to take off, but shortly after take-off, two of the flight attendants smelled something burning. They immediately informed the purser while found that the captain had already contacted the Tower and requested airport assistance. Some passengers felt panic when they saw the smoke in the cabin. Soon captain told passengers about the situation via PA.A few minutes later, dense smoke spread all over the cabin and some passengers suffered from smoke inhalation. At the same time, the flight attendants consulted their emergency checklist and tried to keep the passengers in order. The aircraft finally returned to the departure airport. Fire trucks arrived and ambulances were ready to meet them at the apron. Fortunately, all the passengers were safely evacuated and got effective first aid. After inspection, the cause of the accident was clear. It was an electrical fire in the cockpit.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架飞机从ATC处得到起飞许可，但在起飞后不久，两名乘务员闻到烧焦的味道，他们立刻通知了乘务长，同时发现机长已经联系塔台并请求机场援助。一些乘客看到客舱有烟开始感到恐慌。很快，机长通过广播将情况告知乘客。几分钟后，客舱内布满浓烟，有些乘客吸入了烟尘。此时，乘务员完成紧急检查单并尽力维持乘客的秩序。飞机最终返回出发机场，消防车和救护车在机坪等待飞机。幸运的是，乘客们全部被安全撤离并得到急救。经检查，事故原因是由于驾驶舱发生电气火灾。

cards.audioText: In 1986, a little girl named Crystal Grant living in Memphis, Tennessee got a liver disease and needed a liver transplant. Her family got information that a liver source became available but she must fly to Houston, Texas, she would be able to take the medical treatment. Before departure, an accident happened that the plane blew a couple of tires and ran off the runway into a fence while taking off. At the same time, a Coca-Cola corporate jet had just arrived at the airport carrying their CEO, and the pilot who saw the accident heard the experience of Crystal. Then the pilot briefed the CEO about the story. After visiting Crystal, the CEO decided to take her to Houston by his corporate jet. Meanwhile, the liver which Crystal needed was in San Diego, California, but the flight to transport the liver got failed. The CEO asked the pilot if they could fly to San Diego to pick up the liver first, but found that they would not have enough time for the transplant. Then the CEO contacted the governor of California and explained the situation. Finally, the governor dispatched an F-18 fighter jet to safely transport the liver container to Houston. Everything ran smoothly and the little girl got a successful transplant.
cards.audioTextZh: 1986年，家住田纳西州孟菲斯的小女孩Crystal Grant患有肝病，需要接受肝脏移植。家人得知已有可用肝源，但她必须飞往得克萨斯州休斯顿才能接受治疗。出发前，她原本要乘坐的飞机在起飞时爆了数个轮胎，冲出跑道并撞上围栏。与此同时，一架搭载可口可乐公司首席执行官的公务机刚刚抵达机场。公务机飞行员目睹了事故并听说Crystal的经历，随后向首席执行官讲述此事。首席执行官探望Crystal后，决定用自己的公务机送她前往休斯顿。Crystal需要的肝脏位于加利福尼亚州圣迭戈，但原计划运输肝脏的航班未能成行。首席执行官询问飞行员能否先飞往圣迭戈取肝脏，却发现这样将赶不上移植手术。首席执行官随后联系加利福尼亚州州长并说明情况。最终，州长派出一架F-18战斗机，将装有肝脏的容器安全运至休斯顿。整个过程进展顺利，小女孩成功接受了移植手术。

cards.audioText: A man was on a flight from Seattle to San Francisco, but along the way, the plane stopped unexpectedly in Sacramento. The flight attendant explained the situation and told passengers that they could get off the aircraft for a walk within 50 minutes before the plane re-boarded. Passengers got off the plane in succession except one person. When the man walked by the only person on board he could tell the person was a blind man. Because the man was wearing sunglasses and a seeing eye dog was lying quietly underneath the seat in front of him. The blind man had flown this flight frequently because the pilot could call him by name. The pilot asked, "Keith, we' re in Sacramento for almost an hour. Would you like to get off and stretch your legs?" The blind man said no but he asked the pilot if he could take his dog for a walk. What the pilot did not know was, all the people in the gate area came to a complete standstill when they saw him, because the pilot got off the plane with a seeing eye dog and a pair of sunglasses on. It caused a panic between passengers that they thought the pilot was a blind man. They not only tried to change planes, but also wanted to change airlines! It took time for the pilot and flight attendants to explain to passengers and calm them down. Later the aircraft took off again.
cards.audioTextZh: 一位男士乘坐飞机从西雅图飞往旧金山，途中飞机突然在萨克拉门托降落。乘务员向乘客解释了情况，并告诉他们可以在起飞前下飞机活动50分钟。乘客们依次下飞机，但有一位乘客没走。当男士经过这位乘客时，他注意到这位乘客是盲人。因为他戴着墨镜，一只导盲犬安静地躺在他前方的座位下。这位盲人肯定经常乘坐这趟航班，因为飞行员能够直接叫出他的名字。飞行员问他："Keith，我们将在萨克拉门托停留一小时，你想下飞机活动一下吗？"这位盲人拒绝了，但他问飞行员是否可以带他的导盲犬散个步。但飞行员不知道的是，门口的乘客在看到他时全都停下了，因为他在下飞机时戴着墨镜并牵着一只导盲犬。这引发了乘客们的恐慌，他们以为飞行员是个盲人。乘客们不仅想更换航班，而且还想更换航空公司！飞行员和乘务员花了一段时间向乘客解释情况并让大家冷静下来，之后飞机再次起飞了。

cards.audioText: On a flight, a middle-aged, well-off white South African Lady was not satisfied with her seat for she found herself sitting next to a black man. She called the flight attendant over and asked to change to another seat. The attendant wanted to know the reason, which made the woman more irritable. "Can't you see? You' ve sat me next to a kaffir. I can't possibly sit next to this disgusting human. Find me another seat!" The flight attendant found it hard to deal with because the flight was very full, but she told the woman that she would go and check to see if there was any seat available in club or first class. A few minutes later the attendant returned with good news. Economy and club are both full, but there were one seat in first class. When the attendant delivered the news, the lady cannot help but looked at the people around her with a smug and self-satisfied grin. Then the attendant continued, "We don't make this kind of upgrade as usual, however, I just got special permission from the captain and he felt that it was outrageous for our passenger to be forced to sit next to such an obnoxious person. "She then turned to the black man sitting next to the woman and said, "So if you'd like to get your things, sir, I have your seat ready for you. " The surrounding passengers all stood and gave a standing ovation, the black guy walks up to the front of the plane.
cards.audioTextZh: 一次飞行中，有位来自南非、富有的中年白人女士对自己的座位不满意，因为她发现自己的座位在一位黑人男士旁边，她向乘务员要求换座位。乘务员询问换座位的原因，这让她更加烦躁：“你看不到吗？你们让我坐在黑人旁边，我不能坐在这么恶心的人旁边，给我换个座位！”乘务员很难解决这个问题，因为飞机几乎客满，但她还是告诉女士她会查询公务舱或头等舱是否有空位。几分钟后，乘务员带回了好消息。经济舱和公务舱全部客满，但头等舱还有一个座位。乘务员说到这里时，那位女士禁不住自鸣得意地笑着看向周围的人。乘务员接着说到：“这种情况下通常不会给乘客升舱，然而机长刚才有特别许可，他不能接受我们的乘客要被迫坐在讨厌的人身边。”然后她对女士身边的乘客说：“所以如果您愿意收拾行李，我们已为您准备好座位。”周围的乘客全部起立鼓掌，黑人乘客换到了飞机前部的座位。

cards.audioText: An aircraft broke due to some unexplained problems of the propeller. The pilot tried every method to repair but only to get more confused. So he had to call an experienced engineer to find out the problem. The engineer searched the engine carefully. It took a long time for the engineer to finish the checking procedure, at last he only knocked the engine at a place then the engine was repaired well. The engineer charged the pilot for 5000 dollars, but the pilot was not willing to pay for it since he thought that it was too expensive for just a knock. The engineer was upset about the pilot's words for he didn't understand the value of engineers' work. He said, "It is inexpensive for a knock. A knock only values for 5 dollars, but knowing the correct place to knock values 4995 dollars. "
cards.audioTextZh: 由于螺旋桨的问题飞机损坏，飞行员尝试用各种方法修理，但却只让自己更困惑，所以他不得不叫一位有经验的工程师来解决问题。工程师仔细地检查发动机，检查程序花费很长时间，最后工程师在发动机某处敲了敲，然后发动机就修好了。工程师向飞行员收取5000美金的费用，但飞行员不愿意付，他认为敲一下飞机就收取这些费用太贵了。工程师对此很失望，因为这说明飞行员不懂得工程师工作的价值。工程师说："修理费并不贵，敲一次只需5美金，但知道敲一次的正确位置价值4995美金。"

cards.audioText: A worker in the airport just finished his work, while he was walking along the apron he found a female pilot was struggling with a huge package. The package was stuck, half of the package was in the plane and another half was out. The worker was a very kind and warmhearted man, so he tried to help the female pilot. He went into the plane and tried his best to push the package, but the package did not move and nothing happened. Later the worker and the pilot decided to push and pull at the same time. They tried so hard over and over again and both got exhausted, but they still couldn't move the package. The worker felt hopeless and he said it was impossible to get the package out of the plane. Then he heard the pilot shrieking, "Oh, no! I was trying to stuff it in!"
cards.audioTextZh: 一位机场工人刚结束工作，他在停机坪看到一位女飞行员正在费力处理一个大包裹。包裹被卡住，一半在飞机内一半在飞机外。这位工人很热心，所以他想帮助这个女飞行员。他走到机舱内并尽力将包裹向外推，但是包裹根本没有挪动。之后，工人和飞行员决定一个人推的同时另一个人拉。他们一次次努力，两个人都很累，但仍然没有挪动包裹。工人感到很绝望，他说包裹可能没办法从飞机里拿出来了，然后他听到了飞行员的大叫："不！我是想将包裹放进去！"

cards.audioText: Lately I was on a VFR flight. We were passing within Aerodrome Traffic Zone under the control of Local Approach, visibility was good, and there was not too much traffic on the frequency. The controller requested a position report by asking if we were over an Island, the feature cannot be found on the half million chart and I was not familiar with it. So I looked for it and asked for clarification. During the period a potential Airprox developed. Fortunately the pilot noted it and avoided it by an evasive maneuver. The pilot and I were both annoyed by the controller for using an unrecognizable local feature which caused confusion and distraction for us. We were squawking 7000 Mode C, so our position should be known. If not, or if there were too much traffic on screen, the controller should have asked for a specific squawk. Controllers should know that non-local pilots only navigate according to charted features. To avoid accidents, local knowledge should be taken seriously.
cards.audioTextZh: 最近在一次目视飞行时，我们在当地进近的指挥下通过机场活动区域，能见度很好，频率里也没有很多飞机。管制员要我们报位置报，询问我们是否飞过某个岛，我在地形图上看不到这个岛，我对这里的地形也并不熟悉，所以我试图寻找这个地形并要求管制员进行说明。在这期间，飞机险些与其它飞机相撞。幸运的是，飞行员通过规避机动避免了事故。飞行员和我都很恼火，由于管制员在指挥时使用无法找到的当地地形，导致我们很迷惑并为此分神。我们的应答机是C模式，编码7000，所以管制员应该知道飞机的位置。如果管制员不知道，或屏幕上有太多活动，管制员应向我们要求特定的编码。管制员要了解，非当地的飞行员只能根据图表上的地形导航。为避免事故发生，要谨慎使用当地知识进行指挥。

cards.audioText: The flight was flying to UK, and before landing, we were asked to hold at FL150 for approximately 30 minutes delay due to the weather. The ATC first instructed us to hold at a level around FL100 and the next clearance The situation was embarrassing. I had to apologize on the radio telephone and ATC responded, "No problem", with updated heading and further descent. However, that airport was not the place to be at the wrong level and heading on a busy, rough Sunday night! In the days following, by giving the incident much thought, I found the major contributing factor of my mistake. We were not supposed to hear what we thought we should hear, thus confusing heading and cleared level. Instead, we should pay attention to the ATC instruction.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机正飞往英国。着陆前，由于天气，我们要在高度层150等待30分钟左右。ATC首先指挥我们在高度层100等待，我们认为下个指令应该是下降到更低高度，当我们接近高度层80时，ATC询问我们是否转向航向080。这种情况让人很为难，我不得不在通话时道歉，ATC回复：“没关系”，然后告知我修正后的航向和下降高度。然而，在繁忙的周日晚，错误的高度层和航向会让飞机无法到达机场！接下来的几天中，我对这件事思考了很多，并找到出现错误的主要原因。我们不应假设自己会收到什么指令，从而会弄混航向和高度。相反，我们应关注ATC给出的指令。

cards.audioText: John was the captain of a flight from Shanghai to Hong Kong. On July 20th, he and his first officer, Ted, controlled the airplane to take off from Shanghai airport. When the plane reached 1200 feet, a windshear warning occurred with the warning sound echoed in the cockpit. Under those circumstances, John took over the control immediately and called for the checklist. The result showed the left PFD indicated normally and only a malfunction indication appeared on the right seat PFD. The flight crew came to an agreement it was a false warning, so they continued to climb. The plane safely landed on Hong Kong airport 3 hours later. The crew asked a ground maintenance personnel to fix the problem. Unfortunately, on the way back, the same trouble appeared again.
cards.audioTextZh: John是一架上海飞往香港航班的机长。7月20日，他和副驾驶Ted操纵飞机从上海机场起飞。飞机爬升到1,200英尺时出现风切变警告，警报声在驾驶舱内响起。John立即接管操纵并要求执行检查单。检查结果显示，左座主飞行显示器指示正常，只有右座主飞行显示器出现故障指示。机组一致判断这是一次虚假警告，因此继续爬升。3小时后，飞机在香港机场安全着陆。机组请地面维修人员排除故障。遗憾的是，在返程途中同样的故障再次出现。

cards.audioText: 18. During a flight from Hong Kong to Beijing, we captured an urgency call from UAL320 that they had a bird strike. A bird crashed their left windshield and the captain was badly wounded by the broken glass, so they requested for priority landing and ambulance. We informed this serious incident to the controller. The controller contacted the UAL320 at once without receiving any response. So we were asked to relay the instruction to UAL320. Luckily, we contacted them successfully, "UAL320, CCA830, Beijing Approach cleared you ILS straight in approach runway 16R, you are number one, ambulance and first aid will be ready for you. ""Roger, thank you very much", the UAL320 replied. Finally, the aircraft landed on Beijing airport safely and the captain was sent to hospital immediately. There were no other people injured on the airplane.
cards.audioTextZh: 在香港飞往北京途中，我们接到来自美联航320的紧急呼叫，他们的飞机遭遇鸟击。有鸟撞到左边挡风玻璃，玻璃破损，机长受重伤，所以他们请求优先着陆和救护车。我们将这起严重事故告诉管制员，管制员立刻联系美联航320，但没有收到任何回复。于是管制员要求我们传送指令给美联航320。幸运的是，我们与美联航320成功建立联系：“美联航320，国航830，北京进近同意直接盲降进近跑道16右，你是第一个，救护车和急救已就位。”“收到，非常感谢。”美联航320这样回复我们。飞机最终在北京机场安全着陆，机长被立刻送往医院，机上没有其他人员受伤。

cards.audioText: 19. I still remember my solo day. On that day, the vice president of the United States was driven to the airport. Air force 2, a new B757, landed at about 9o'clock but we had to wait until all the formalities were completed on the apron. My CFI had asked me if I was ready for solo. At that time I said yes because of my confidence, and the clear weather also helped, but when I got into the cockpit and knew the CFI wasn't coming, I still felt a bit nervous and I hoped not to screw it up. Everything was as usual and it was even better for me to notice that the plane had a better climb rate and there was a lot more room in the C150 with only one person. Everything went by the book except when I lost mic on the floor and stumbled with repeated clearance of the option. Three landings seemed better than the once I did when the CFI was with me. The airplane finally safely landed with everything going smoothly. On my way home I thought about this experience of flying a real airplane alone. To have the vice president fly all that way just watch me solo gave me more confidence about myself.
cards.audioTextZh: 到现在我还能想起单飞那天的经历。那天，美国副总统到达机场。空军二号，一架全新波音757，在9点左右着陆，但我们必须在机坪等待所有仪式完成。我的总飞行教练之前询问我是否已准备好单飞，由于对自己有信心，并且天气条件好，我回答没问题。但当我走进驾驶舱得知总飞行教练不在时，我还是感到有些紧张，并且希望我不会犯错误。飞行一切正常，我甚至感到飞机有更好的爬升率，单独一个人在塞斯纳150上显得舱内很空旷。所有事情都按照检查单执行除了我把麦克风掉在了地上而且蹩脚的重复执行了许可选项。这三个落地比之前跟总飞行教练飞得都要好。最终，飞机安全降落，飞行顺利。回家的路上，我在回想这次单独飞行的经历。副总统特地赶过来看我单飞这件事情上给了我莫大的自信。

cards.audioText: 20. The flight was from New York to Dallas. When passengers were boarding, an elderly couple found a woman occupied their seats in first class. The flight attendant wanted to see her boarding pass to solve the problem, but the woman responded in fake broken English, "No English, pas anglais. " The attendant knew it was a pretence because the woman had been chatting a bit with another passenger. Then, she tried to persuade the woman to show the boarding pass but only to get disregard. At last, she had to use French to talk with the woman. The woman was so surprised that she let go of her ticket and gave it to the attendant. After checking the boarding pass, the attendant walked the woman all the way to her seat which was at the back of the plane, then she returned to first class. During the flight, the woman continued complaining in French and asking that attendant to serve her. The attendant smiled and served her everything she wanted, but talked with her in English as she spoke in French. Finally, the flight landed safely at Dallas. The woman was one of the last people off the plane. She demanded the attendant's name and worker ID so she could complain about her. Unexpectedly, the attendant smiled and told the woman it would be nice if she stopped pretending that she couldn't speak or understand English. The woman scowled and marched off the plane.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架飞机从纽约飞往达拉斯。登机时，一对老夫妇发现一位女士坐在他们的头等舱座位上。乘务员想检查她的登机牌，但她用蹩脚的英语回复："不会英语。"乘务员知道这是借口，因为她之前在用英语和另一位乘客交谈。之后，乘务员想劝说女士出示登机牌，但是她完全不理。最后，乘务员不得不用法语和她交流，她非常惊讶于是放手把票给了乘务员。检查完登机牌后，乘务员带领女士走到她位于飞机后部的座位，然后乘务员回到了头等舱。整个飞行期间，这位女士一直在用法语抱怨并要求那位乘务员为她提供服务。乘务员微笑着满足她的要求，但始终用英语回复她的法语。最终飞机在达拉斯安全降落，这位女士是最后下飞机的乘客们之一，她想知道乘务员的名字和证件号去投诉。意外的是，乘务员微笑着告诉她，如果她能不再假装不懂英语就好了。这位女士皱着眉走下了飞机。

cards.audioText: A ridiculous accident happened when a flight was coming back from Poland in 1998. The plane had just landed at the airport when a guy on board claimed that he had a bomb. All the passengers started to panic. The pilot immediately contacted ATC and asked for emergency services. Because of the man's allegation the plane couldn't get to the gate, so the plane had to board on a bus. All the luggage on the plane was removed and sniffed by a dog. The flight crew and passengers waited and watched for3 hours without air conditioning and food or anything. After searching, it turned out that there was no bomb on board. The guy was just drunk, and he went mad because they wouldn't give him another beer.
cards.audioTextZh: 1998年，一架从波兰返航的飞机上发生了一起荒唐事件。飞机刚在机场着陆，一名机上乘客就声称自己携带炸弹，所有乘客顿时陷入恐慌。飞行员立即联系空中交通管制并请求应急服务。由于这名男子声称机上有炸弹，飞机无法驶向登机口，乘客只得转乘摆渡车。机上所有行李都被卸下，并由嗅探犬检查。机组和乘客在没有空调、食物或其他保障的情况下等待并观看排查过程长达3小时。检查结果显示机上根本没有炸弹。那名男子只是喝醉了，因为机组不肯再给他一杯啤酒而失控闹事。

cards.audioText: Before the flight, a man used his miles to upgrade to first class. He thought this would make his flight much more comfortable than usual, but what happened later proved he was wrong. He sat next to an old lady whose family members were in economy class. Soon after take-off, when the man was about to begin eating, the old lady suddenly and explosively vomited.
