The flight attendant rushed to her to deal with the situation, but the old lady did not turn better. Another half an hour later, when the man was stepping around her to use the restroom, she vomited again and some of her vomits even got on the man' s clothes. After cleaning himself out in the restroom, the man came back and found his seat was crowded with the lady's family members. Because of the crowd, he was asked to simply stand and wait during 40 minutes of turbulence, and during that time the sick lady vomited yet again. That whole area smelled terrible. Passengers couldn't just stand while the plane landed, so the man had to exchange his seat with the lady's niece whose seat was in economy class. The worst is, when the man asked if he could get his miles back, he was told "NO". The man was not satisfied and he thought this unforgettable flying experience was a total nightmare.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行前，一位男士用里程升到头等舱。他原以为这次飞行会比以前更舒适，但后来发生的事证明了他的选择是错的。他的座位在一位老妇人旁边，老妇人的家人全都在经济舱。起飞后不久，当他准备用餐时，老妇人猛地呕吐起来。乘务员很快来处理完这个情况，但老妇人的情况并没有转好。半小时后，这位男士从老妇人身边经过去洗手间，这时老妇人再次呕吐起来，有些呕吐物甚至弄到了他的衣服上。在洗手间清理完，他发现自己的座位附近挤满了老妇人的家人。由于人太多，飞机颠簸的40分钟里他只能站着等待，在这期间老妇人再次呕吐起来，整个区域弥漫着可怕的味道。飞机着陆时乘客必须坐下，所以他只能和在经济舱的老妇人的侄女换座位。更糟糕的是，他升舱的里程无法返还。他为此感到很不满意，他认为这次经历简直是个噩梦。

cards.audioText: During a flight from Rhode Island to Washington, an accident happened and brought bad influence on the airline. The aircraft took off from the airport smoothly and the flight was incident-free en route. When the plane was approaching to the airport, the pilot was tired so he missed the controller' s instruction. Then the controller gave the instruction again. This time, the pilot became clear but he applied the brakes suddenly. Because of his sudden operation, the back door of the plane blew off and passengers could see the runway. Fortunately, the cabin had already lost the pressure so no one flew out and all the passengers stayed in their own seats safely. However, the pilot was grounded because of his misoperation.
cards.audioTextZh: 罗德岛飞往华盛顿的航班上发生一起事故，这起事故给航空公司带来不好的影响。飞机从机场顺利起飞，途中也没有事故发生。飞机进近时，飞行员因为疲劳漏听管制员指令。之后管制员再次给出指令，这时飞行员清醒了并突然刹车。因为突然的操作，飞机的后门被吸走，乘客们能直接看到跑道。幸运的是客舱已降压，没有人因此吸出飞机，乘客们都安全待在座位上。然而，飞行员由于这次失误被停飞。

cards.audioText: The flight was from Seattle to Vancouver. After checking the radar, the pilot requested push back and start up. The airplane was approved to push back and start up but few seconds later the controller found the left engine of the plane got fire. So he gave the pilot a warning immediately and asked if fire service was needed. The pilot shut off the engine immediately to prevent the fire from spreading. "The emergency equipment is standing by. "the controller told the pilot. Several minutes later, passengers were all safely evacuated. There was no one injured but passengers had to change to another airline.
cards.audioTextZh: 该航班从西雅图飞往温哥华。检查雷达后，飞行员请求推出和启动发动机。飞机获准推出开车，但几秒钟后，管制员发现飞机左发起火，立即向飞行员发出警告，并询问是否需要消防服务。飞行员立即关闭发动机，防止火势蔓延。管制员告知飞行员：“应急设备正在待命。”几分钟后，所有乘客安全撤离，无人受伤，但乘客不得不改乘另一家航空公司的航班。

cards.audioText: 25. It was a foggy day in 2001, A Flight 126 from Singapore Airlines was cleared to taxi to runway 19 Right. A few minutes later, a Cessna pilot requested engine start, and the ground controller gave start-up clearance. Then the controller asked 126 to contact the Tower controller. From then on, those two aircraft were on two different radio frequencies. The Cessna started to taxi, but the pilot made the mistake of taxiing to the right and entered taxiway Echo 6. But the Ground controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue its taxi. At the entered the active runway 19 Right. Unfortunately, the two aircraft collided, all 124 people on board died.
cards.audioTextZh: 2001年的一个大雾天，新加坡航空126号航班获准滑行至19右跑道。几分钟后，一架塞斯纳飞机的飞行员请求启动发动机，地面管制员发布开车许可，随后要求126号航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，两架飞机分别使用不同的无线电频率。塞斯纳飞机开始滑行，但飞行员错误地向右转，进入Echo 6滑行道。地面管制员没有发现这一错误，仍许可塞斯纳继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员许可126号航班起飞。126号航班在跑道上加速滑跑时，塞斯纳飞机越过跑道等待标志，进入正在使用的19右跑道。两架飞机不幸相撞，机上124人全部遇难。

cards.audioText: A strong snowstorm hit Chicago International airport in an afternoon. An aircraft from United Airlines circled several times before attempting to land at the airport. The snowstorm had reduced visibility severely. The runway visual range was at 4, 500 feet below the landing minimums for the ILS approach to Runway 13 Center. The controller advised the crew to hold in the air, waiting for the weather to get better, or to divert to another airport with a longer runway. But both suggestions would produce large additional expense for the airline, as well as inconvenience of the flight's passengers. So the crew decided to circle to land on runway 31 Center, which had lower landing minimums. But unfortunately, the strong tailwind made the plane skid off the runway and crash into a stopping truck.
cards.audioTextZh: 某日下午，一场暴风雪袭击了芝加哥国际机场。一架美联航飞机准备在机场着陆，但由于能见度极低，飞机不得不在机场上空盘旋。跑道视程为4500英尺，低于13中跑道的盲降进近标准。管制员建议机组空中等待天气好转，或备降到有较长跑道的另一机场着陆，但是这两种选择均会额外增加公司成本，并给乘客带来不便，于是考虑再三，机组决定在有着较低着陆标准的31中跑道盘旋着陆。很遗憾，强顺风使飞机滑出跑道，撞上了一辆停着的卡车。

cards.audioText: An air traffic controller issued a take-off clearance to the Flight 386 for runway 30R. At the same time, an airport operations officer was operating a vehicle on that runway. The controller had previously issued a clearance to the operations officer to conduct bird dispersal activities on the runway. The operations officer was monitoring his radio and heard Flight 386's take-off clearance. He told the controller that he would vacate the runway. At the same time, the flight crew had observed the vehicle on the runway and did not commence the takeoff. The controller cancelled the take-off clearance until the runway was clear. The investigation found that the controller didn't keep eyes on the runway because he was concentrating on heavy traffic. Another possible reason was that the controller was experiencing some degree of fatigue at the time.
cards.audioTextZh: 一管制员发布起飞许可给386航班，允许该飞机从跑道30右起飞，与此同时，一名机场工作人员正在30右跑道上工作。因为之前管制员让该工作人员在跑道上驱鸟。工作人员在当前频率守听，听到386航班要起飞的许可指令，立刻告诉管制员他会马上离开跑道。同时，机组人员看到跑道上的车辆，没有执行起飞操作。管制员取消了起飞许可，直到跑道被空出来。后据调查，管制员因为指挥飞机过多，没有留意该跑道，导致了这次事件。还有一个可能的原因是管制员此时过于疲惫导致此次事件。

cards.audioText: Getting lost as an airplane flying is a potentially dangerous situation, especially when low on fuel. If a pilot becomes lost, there are some good common sense procedures to follow. If a town or city cannot be seen, the first thing to do is climb. Being mindful of traffic and weather conditions. An increase in altitude increases radio and navigation reception range, and also increases radar coverage. If flying near a town or city, it might be possible to read the name of the town on a water tower. If the airplane has a navigation radio, such as a VOR or ADF receiver, it can be possible to determine position by plotting an azimuth from two or more navigational facilities. If GPS is installed or a pilot has a portable aviation GPS on board, it can be used to determine the position and location of the nearest airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在飞行中迷航是一种潜在的危险情况，特别是在燃料不足的情况下。如果飞行员迷航，可以遵循一些良好的常识程序。如果无法目视某个城镇或城市，首要的就是爬升。留意其他航空器及天气情况。海拔高度的增加使得无线电和导航的接收范围扩大，也增加了雷达覆盖范围。如果在一个城镇或城市附近飞行，可能会在水塔上看到城镇的名字。如果飞机配备无线电导航，如VOR或ADF接收器，它可以通过两个或更多的导航设施绘制方位角来确定位置。如果安装了全球定位系统(GPS),或者飞行员在飞机上配备了便携式航空全球定位系统，就可以确定最近机场的方位和位置。

cards.audioText: It was a foggy day in 2002, SIA 626 was cleared to taxi to runway 36R.A few minutes later, the Cessna pilot requested engine start. The ground controller gave start-up clearance. Then he requested Flight 626 to contact the Tower controller. From then on, those two aircraft were on two different radio frequencies. The Cessna started to taxi, but the pilot made a mistake of taxiing to right and entered taxiway R6. But the ground controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue its taxi. At the same time, the Tower controller cleared Flight 626 for takeoff. When the flight 626 was rolling on the runway, the Cessna crossed the runway holding sign and entered the active runway 36R. Unfortunately, the two aircraft collided, all 114 people on board died.

cards.audioText: Flight 145 nearly collided with Flight 101 at the intersection of runway 16 and runway 22. There were no injuries and no damage to either aircraft. But it was regarded as the most serious incident of this kind. That day, the tower controller cleared Flight 145 to land on runway 22. But he forgot the arriving aircraft when he cleared Flight 101 to take off from the intersecting runway 16. After Flight 145 touched down, the ground radar system alerted. The controller tried to instruct Flight 145 to stop short of runway 16. However, the aircraft just managed to stop in the middle of the intersection. It was impossible for Flight 101 to abort takeoff. So Flight 101 made an early liftoff and flew over Flight 145. The two aircraft missed colliding by only 50 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 145号航班在16号跑道与22号跑道交叉处险些与101号航班相撞。两架飞机均无人受伤，机体也没有损坏，但该事件被认为是此类事件中最严重的一次。当天，塔台管制员许可145号航班在22号跑道着陆；但在许可101号航班从与其相交的16号跑道起飞时，管制员忘记了这架正在进场的飞机。145号航班接地后，地面雷达系统发出警报。管制员试图指令145号航班在16号跑道外等待，但飞机最终只能停在跑道交叉口中央。此时101号航班已无法中断起飞，只能提前离地，从145号航班上方飞过。两架飞机最近时仅相差50英尺，险些相撞。

cards.audioText: When an American Flight 815 was approaching the terminal area of its destination, the flight crew contacted the Approach Control and requested ILS approach for runway 12. The tailwind conditions were reported on runway 12 at that time, so the controller advised the pilot to make a circling approach for runway 30. But the flight crew insisted to land on runway 12 and the controller cleared them to land on that runway. The runway was wet and the braking action was not good. During landing roll, the aircraft skidded to the right side of the runway and went through the airport fences. The fuselage was broken into three pieces, the right engine and right main gear were separated from the aircraft. No one was killed, but many passengers suffered from serious injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 当一架美国航空815航班接近目的地终端区时，机组人员联系进近管制中心，要求在12跑道盲降进近。当时12跑道报告有顺风情况，所以管制员建议飞行员在30跑道盘旋进近。但机组人员坚持在12跑道降落，管制员允许他们在该跑道降落。跑道湿滑，刹车性能也不好。在着陆滑跑过程中，飞机侧滑到跑道右侧，穿过机场围栏。机身断成三段，右发和右主起落架与机身分离。没有人死亡，但许多乘客受了重伤。

cards.audioText: One day, Flight 456, a B737 carrying 152 passengers and 9 crew members, was flying to land at Tokyo International Airport. When it was transferred from Tokyo Control to Tokyo Approach, flight 456 was instructed to proceed to DA to hold because of traffic congestion. During the holding, the flight crew was informed that the local weather was deteriorating and the controller suggested that the pilot divert to the alternate, but the pilot reported that their fuel was not enough to the alternate. So the controller vectored flight 456 by radar to land at runway 34R. Unfortunately, the pilot couldn't stabilize the aircraft on the localizers due to wind shear. Flight 456 went around and made a second approach. Later, it crashed into a hillside due to fuel shortage. The aircraft was broken into pieces and all the people on board were killed.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，一架载有152名乘客和9名机组人员的B737执行456航班在东京国际机场降落。当从东京区调转到东京进近时，因为航空器拥堵，456航班被指示前往DA等待。在等待期间，机组人员被告知当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议飞行员备降，但飞行员报告说他们的燃料不够备降。所以管制员雷达引导456航班降落在34右跑道。不幸的是，由于风切变，飞行员无法在航道上建立稳定进近。456航班执行了复飞，执行了二次进近。后来，由于燃油短缺，飞机在山坡上坠毁。飞机被撞成碎片，机上人员全部遇难。

cards.audioText: When SIA128 was approaching the airspace of Chicago center area control, the controller instructed the flight crew to change radio frequency for the next sector on 132.1. The first officer acknowledged the frequency change and read back the correct frequency. However, the flight crew did not contact ATC on the new frequency. Because the controllers in the receiving units were preparing for a shift change, they didn't know that flight 128 did not establish radio contact, 30 minutes later, the controller at the next sector identified SIA128 on the radar. Although they attempted to establish contact with the airplane by calling the company dispatcher, they got no response from the pilots. The controller finally regained contact with SIA128 on the emergency frequency 50 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 当新航128接近芝加哥中心区域管制时，管制员指示机组人员切换频率到下一扇区132.1。副驾驶确认了切换的频率并进行了复诵。然而，机组人员并没有在新的频率中与管制员建立联系。由于管制员正处于交接班时间，他们不知道128次航班没有建立无线电联系，30分钟后，下一扇区的管制员在雷达上发现了新航128。尽管他们试图通过联系公司签派与飞机建立联系，但飞行员仍没有回应。50分钟后，在紧急频率上管制员终于恢复了与新航128的联系。

Suddenly, the controller noticed the B757's lights came on and it began to move. Realizing the risk of runway incursion, he canceled A320's takeoff clearance immediately.

So the controller vectored flight 123 by radar to land at runway 34R. Unfortunately, the pilot couldn't stabilize the aircraft on the localizer due to wind shear. Flight 123 went around and made a second approach. Later, it crashed into a hillside due to fuel shortage. The aircraft was broken into pieces and all the people on board were killed.
cards.audioTextZh: 有一天，载有152名乘客和9名机组人员的波音737型123号航班正飞往东京国际机场准备降落。当该航班从东京区域管制移交给东京进近管制时，由于空中交通拥堵，123号航班接到指令前往DA点等待。在等待过程中，机组人员得知当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议飞行员备降其他机场，但飞行员报告称燃油不足以支撑他们飞抵备降机场。于是，管制员通过雷达引导123号航班在34R跑道降落。不幸的是，由于遭遇风切变，飞行员无法使飞机在仪表着陆系统的航向道上保持稳定。123号航班复飞并进行了第二次进近。后来，由于燃油短缺，飞机坠毁在一处山坡上。飞机解体，机上所有人员全部遇难。

cards.audioText: One day, Indonesia 205 took off from Jinan to Hangzhou. About one hour later, the aircraft was transferred to Hangzhou Approach. Hangzhou Approach required Indonesia 205 to slow down to 190 knots and later the controller asked the pilot to reduce speed to 160 knots. Three minutes later, Indonesia 205 passed the outer marker inbound. At that time, the controller issued a missed approach clearance because of separation. He instructed Indonesia 205 to make a right turn to a heading of 180 and climb to 900 m. But during the missed approach, the aircraft was out of control because of mechanical problem. The aircraft continued to descend with a high angle of attack. The aircraft impacted trees and buildings and part of the fuselage was damaged.
cards.audioTextZh: 某日，印尼205航班从济南起飞前往杭州。大约一小时后，该航班被移交给杭州进近管制。杭州进近管制要求印尼205航班将速度降至190节，随后管制员又要求飞行员将速度减至160节。三分钟后，印尼205航班在向台飞行时通过了远距指点标。当时，由于间隔问题，管制员发出了复飞指令。他指示印尼205航班右转至航向180度，并爬升至900米。但在复飞过程中，飞机因机械故障失去控制。飞机以大迎角持续下降，撞上了树木和建筑物，部分机身受损。

cards.audioText: One day, AFR188 crashed at Singapore Changi Airport during takeoff. The tower controller instructed the crew to takeoff on Runway 02L, but the crew lined up runway 02R and began their takeoff rolling. The aircraft overran the runway, and crashed into the fence of the airport. Crew members and 110 passengers were killed, and the co-pilot was badly injured. The plane was destroyed by the impact and caught on an intense fire. According to the investigation, there were three reasons leading to the accidents. First of all, the crew didn't use effective methods to verify their position at the airport. Secondly, the crew forgot to check whether they were on the correct runway or not. Finally, the crew members' idle chatting during the taxi resulted in the loss of situational awareness.
cards.audioTextZh: 有一天，法国航空公司188号航班（AFR188）在新加坡樟宜机场起飞时坠毁。塔台管制员指示机组人员在02L跑道起飞，但机组人员却在02R跑道排队并开始了起飞滑跑。飞机冲出跑道，撞上了机场的围栏。机组人员和110名乘客遇难，副驾驶受了重伤。飞机因撞击而损毁，并燃起了熊熊大火。根据调查，导致此次事故的原因有三个。首先，机组人员没有使用有效的方法来确认他们在机场的位置。其次，机组人员忘记检查他们是否在正确的跑道上。最后，机组人员在滑行过程中的闲聊导致他们对所处情况的认知缺失。

cards.audioText: One day, an A320 collided with a B737 during taxi. The right ailerons of B737 was severely damaged but A320 only had minor damage of its left wing. Luckily, there were no injuries. After receiving ATC taxi instruction, the A320 began to pass the B737 from the right side. The captain of A320 thought they had enough room to pass over the B737. But unfortunately Fortunately, the fuel leak didn't develop into fire. The crew of the Boeing aircraft complained that they just parked stationary with the parking brakes applied when they were hit.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，一架空客A320在滑行过程中与一架波音737相撞。波音737的右副翼严重受损，空客A320的左翼仅受到轻微损伤。所幸无人受伤。收到空中交通管制的滑行指令后，空客A320开始从波音737右侧通过。空客A320机长认为两机之间有足够空间，可以越过波音737，但随后发生了碰撞。所幸燃油泄漏没有进一步引发火灾。波音737机组表示，发生碰撞时他们的飞机一直停在原地，且已设置停留刹车，却遭到空客A320撞击。

cards.audioText: A Sun Express Germany Boeing 737-800, performing flight XG-3208 from Burgas to Frankfurt, was cleared to climb to and maintain FL220. At the same time, a Go2Sky Boeing 737-800 performing flight 6D-6129 from Antalya to Bratislava was en route at FL240 did not want to change their flight level. ATC instructed XG-3208 to turn left onto a heading 270. The crew however, read back "Climb FL270", which was not picked up by ATC. The crew selected FL270 into their Selected Altitude, and this was duly transmitted by Mode-S to the controller's desk, where a disagree message appeared between cleared and assigned altitude. The aircraft began to climb, about 15 seconds later, the radar issued a short term conflict alert between XG-3208 and 6D-6129. Then ATC instructed XG-3208 to descend back to FL220 immediately, 4 seconds later the crew read that instruction back. And the aircraft already climbed through FL236. The separation reduced to 0 feet vertically and 2.6 nm horizontally and the aircraft continued to climb reaching FL250, and re-establishing vertical separation. ATC thus instructed XG-3208 to continue the climb to FL260.
cards.audioTextZh: .一架德国阳光快运航空公司（Sun Express Germany）的波音737-800型飞机，执飞从布尔加斯飞往法兰克福的XG-3208航班，获得许可爬升至并保持在220飞行高度层（FL220）。与此同时，一架Go2Sky航空公司的波音737-800型飞机执飞从安塔利亚飞往布拉迪斯拉发的6D-6129航班，正在240飞行高度层（FL240）航路上飞行，且不想改变其飞行高度层。空中交通管制（ATC）指令XG-3208航班左转至航向270度。然而，机组复诵的是“爬升至270飞行高度层（FL270）”，而空中交通管制并未注意到这一错误复诵。机组人员在其选定高度设置中选择了FL270，并且通过S模式适时地将这一信息传输到了管制员的操作台上，此时在许可高度和设定高度之间出现了不一致的提示信息。飞机开始爬升，大约15秒后，雷达发出了XG-3208航班和6D-6129航班之间的短期冲突警报。随后，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班立即下降至FL220，4秒后机组复诵了该指令。而此时飞机已经爬升至236飞行高度层。两机的垂直间隔缩小至0英尺，水平间隔为2.6海里，并且这架飞机继续爬升，达到了250飞行高度层，随后重新建立了垂直间隔。因此，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班继续爬升至260飞行高度层。

cards.audioText: On Jan 31st 2022, an ATR 7 2 performing flight 6 1 7 with 18 passengers and 3 crew, was cleared for a rolling takeoff Runway 03L when the crew after aligning with the runway spotted a vehicle on the runway and rejected takeoff. After the vehicle left the runway, the aircraft departed normally. The tower controller had cleared a maintenance vehicle onto the runway just second earlier, when the vehicle was entering the runway from threshold 2 1 Right, tower just cleared the ATR 7 2 for takeoff. The probable causes of the incident were the lack of adherence with procedures by the controller, as the controller cleared Flight 6 1 7 to enter the runway and take off although the runway was occupied causing a runway incursion on 0 3 Left. And the contributing factors were: the failure of the supervising controller to execute recommendations resulting from previous incidents, not paying special attention to runway checks.
cards.audioTextZh: 2022年1月31日，一架执行617号航班的ATR 72载有18名乘客和3名机组人员，获准在03L跑道进行不停顿滑跑起飞。机组对正跑道后发现跑道上有一辆车辆，随即中断起飞。车辆离开跑道后，飞机正常起飞。就在几秒前，塔台管制员曾许可一辆维修车辆进入跑道；当该车辆正从21R跑道头进入跑道时，塔台又许可ATR 72起飞。此次事件的可能原因是管制员没有遵守程序：尽管跑道仍被占用，管制员仍许可617号航班进入跑道并起飞，导致03L跑道发生跑道侵入。促成因素包括：监督管制员未落实此前事件提出的建议，也未特别重视跑道检查。

cards.audioText: On May 11, 2023, an Endeavor CRJ-900 on behalf of Delta Airlines, performing flight Delta 5 1 4 5, was climbing out of Runway 13 when the crew did not respond to two calls by ATC repeating the same instruction, on the next repeated call the crew read back to climb to 12,000 feet and turn onto heading 3 2 0 degrees, the controller added he needed them to turn right away, at this time the crew requested for a block clearance, the controller queried what altitude they needed, then the crew explained there had an issue with the heading but were fine with the altitude. The controller instructed the crew to initiate a turn and would tell the crew when to roll out of the turn. The crew requested to stop climb at 10,000 feet and subsequently on ATC instruction descended to 9,000 feet while still rolling in and rolling out of turning on ATC instructions. The crew advised they were reading checklists and talking to maintenance but needed to divert to New York. The aircraft landed safely on JFK's Runway 22R.
cards.audioTextZh: 2023年5月11日，Endeavor的一架CRJ-900代表Delta Airlines执行Delta 5145航班，从13号跑道起飞爬升。机组没有回应空中交通管制连续两次发出的同一指令；管制员再次重复呼叫后，机组复诵爬升至12,000英尺并转向航向320度。管制员补充说，他需要机组立即转弯。此时机组请求高度区间许可，管制员询问他们需要什么高度，随后机组解释称航向方面出现了问题，但高度方面没有问题。管制员指示机组开始转弯，并表示会告诉机组何时改出转弯。机组请求在10,000英尺停止爬升，随后按照空中交通管制指令下降至9,000英尺，同时仍根据空中交通管制指令不断进入和改出转弯。机组表示，他们正在执行检查单并与维修部门通话，但需要备降纽约。飞机最终安全降落在JFK机场22R跑道。

cards.audioText: As Flight 1 4 2 descended from 5,200 meters to 1,400 meters, it entered severe thunderstorm area and encountered a massive amount of hail. The wind shield was broken by hail. Both engines lost power due to ingestion of a lot of water and hail. The crew attempted unsuccessfully to restart the engines. They declared an emergency to the Atlanta Approach control and request radar vector to the nearest airport for emergency landing. The approach control advised the crew to land at an air force base, but they could not make it. Finally, the crew decided to make a forced landing on a highway. During landing rollout, the aircraft collided with a gas station and it exploded. The flight crew and 60 passengers were killed by impact force and post-crash fire. Only 19 of passengers survived.
cards.audioTextZh: 142号航班从5,200米下降至1,400米时，进入强雷暴区并遭遇大量冰雹。风挡玻璃被冰雹击碎。由于吸入大量水和冰雹，两台发动机均失去动力。机组尝试重新启动发动机，但未能成功。他们向Atlanta进近管制宣布紧急情况，并请求雷达引导至最近的机场进行紧急着陆。进近管制建议机组在一处空军基地着陆，但飞机无法飞抵该基地。最后，机组决定在一条公路上迫降。在着陆滑跑过程中，飞机撞上一座加油站并发生爆炸。飞行机组和60名乘客因撞击力及坠机后的火灾遇难。只有19名乘客幸存。

cards.audioText: On November 11, 2019, a Westjet Dash 8 performing flight West jet 3 2 9 7 from Vancouver to Prince George (Canada) with 78 passengers and 4 crew, was holding at Prince George, when the crew received a runway surface report indicating the runway was covered 70% with ice and associated poor braking. The crew decided to return to Vancouver. On the way back, about 17 nautical miles northwest of Vancouver, the DEICE PRESSURE caution illuminated. The crew carried out the relevant checklists, the caution light briefly extinguished and illuminated again. The aircraft suffered vibrations in icing conditions prompting the crew to declare PAN PAN and request an immediate descent to a lower altitude. The aircraft was vectored for the approach and landed safely back in Vancouver.
cards.audioTextZh: 2019年11月11日，Westjet的一架Dash 8执行Westjet 3297航班，从Vancouver飞往Prince George（Canada），机上有78名乘客和4名机组人员。飞机在Prince George等待时，机组收到跑道道面报告，报告显示跑道有70%的面积被冰覆盖，且相关的制动效果较差。机组决定返回Vancouver。在返航途中，飞机位于Vancouver西北约17海里处时，DEICE PRESSURE警戒灯亮起。机组执行了相关检查单，警戒灯曾短暂熄灭，随后再次亮起。飞机在结冰条件下发生振动，促使机组宣布PAN PAN并请求立即下降至较低高度。飞机随后接受雷达引导进近，并安全返回Vancouver着陆。

cards.audioText: On September 6, 2023, Virgin Australia Boeing 737-800, performing flight Virgin 3 3 6 from Brisbane to Melbourne (Australia), was enroute when a flight attendant requested access to the cockpit. The captain, pilot monitoring, attempted to open the door but instead of pressing the relevant button activated the rudder trim causing an inflight upset requiring the first officer to apply significant right aileron to prevent the aircraft from rolling left until the trim exceeded aileron authority. The aircraft rolled left to a maximum of 42 degrees left bank before the captain, upon the first officer's request, checked the rudder trim and discovered the problem. The aircraft returned to normal flight and continued to Melbourne for a landing without further incident. One flight attendant received minor injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 2023年9月6日，Virgin Australia的一架Boeing 737-800执行Virgin 336航班，从Brisbane飞往Melbourne（Australia）。飞机在航路飞行期间，一名乘务员请求进入驾驶舱。作为监控飞行员的机长试图打开舱门，但他没有按下相应按钮，而是启动了方向舵配平，导致飞机在飞行中姿态失稳。副驾驶不得不施加很大的右副翼，以防止飞机向左滚转，直到方向舵配平的作用超过副翼的操纵能力。飞机向左滚转，最大左坡度达到42度。随后，应副驾驶要求，机长检查了方向舵配平并发现问题。飞机恢复正常飞行并继续飞往Melbourne，之后着陆，未再发生其他事件。一名乘务员受轻伤。

cards.audioText: On October 24, 2024, a Westjet Dash 8, performing flight Westjet 3 3 7 1 from Saskatoon to Calgary (Canada) with 70 people on board, was cleared for a RNAV Yankee Runway 35L approach in clear weather and light winds. The aircraft touched down at 7 degrees nose up and the aircraft became airborne again. The pitch was reduced and the aircraft touched down a second time 6 seconds later at +2.17 G, the crew received a "TOUCHED runway" advisory light. The aircraft slowed without further incident and taxied to the apron. The Canadian TSB reported there were no injuries, the aircraft however sustained substantial damage to the lower side of the empennage. The occurrence was rated an accident.
cards.audioTextZh: 2024年10月24日，Westjet的一架Dash 8执行Westjet 3371航班，从Saskatoon飞往Calgary（Canada），机上共有70人。在天气晴朗、风力较小的情况下，飞机获准实施35L跑道RNAV Yankee进近。飞机以机头上仰7度的姿态接地，随后再次升空。机组减小俯仰角，飞机在6秒后第二次接地，过载为+2.17 G，机组收到“TOUCHED RUNWAY”提示灯。飞机随后减速，未再发生其他事件，并滑行至停机坪。加拿大运输安全委员会报告称，没有人员受伤，但飞机尾翼下侧受到严重损坏。该事件被定性为事故。

cards.audioText: navigation equipment failure On December 13, 2024, An American Airlines Boeing 7 7 7, performing flight American 7 3 2 from Charlotte (USA) to London Heathrow (UK), was enroute at FL3 5 0 about 110 nautical miles southsoutheast of New York (USA) when the crew advised ATC they had a failure of one of their redundant navigation systems and were unable to cross the ocean, therefore wanted to return to Charlotte. The crew subsequently consulted with dispatch and changed to divert to New York's JFK Airport. The aircraft needed to burn off fuel and subsequently landed safely on JFK's Runway 04L about 4: 50 hours after the decision to divert.
cards.audioTextZh: 导航设备故障。2024年12月13日，American Airlines的一架Boeing 777执行American 732航班，从Charlotte（USA）飞往London Heathrow（UK）。飞机在纽约（USA）东南偏南约110海里处以FL350飞行时，机组向空中交通管制报告，一套冗余导航系统发生故障，飞机无法飞越大洋，因此希望返回Charlotte。随后，机组与签派部门协商，并改为备降纽约JFK机场。飞机需要消耗燃油，之后在作出备降决定约4小时50分钟后安全降落在JFK机场04L跑道。

cards.audioText: On May 12, 2019, flight 1 0 3 was approach Runway 17 when the crew could not extend the nose gear and went around. The crew worked the related checklists and attempted the alternate gear extensions which also could not extend the nose gear. A low approach confirmed the nose gear was still not extended. The crew prepared for nose gear up landing and landed on Runway 17, keeping the nose gear up as long as practical, bringing the aircraft a halt on both main gear struts and the nose of the aircraft. Smoke entered the cabin after the nose touched down. The aircraft was evacuated via slides. There were no injuries and the aircraft sustained substantial damage.
cards.audioTextZh: 2019年5月12日，103号航班正在进近17号跑道时，机组无法放下前起落架并执行了复飞。机组执行了相关检查单，并尝试使用备用起落架放出程序，但前起落架仍无法放下。一次低空通场确认前起落架仍未放出。机组为前起落架未放下着陆做好准备，并在17号跑道着陆，尽可能长时间保持机头不接地，最终飞机依靠两个主起落架支柱和机头停下。机头接地后，烟雾进入客舱。机上人员通过滑梯撤离。没有人员受伤，飞机受到严重损坏。

cards.audioText: On January 17, 2025, an SARAT L 4 1 0, performing a charter flight from Juba to Jebel-Boma County Airstrip (South Sudan), went off or missed the runway while landing at the airstrip and came to a stop on rough terrain and brushland. One passenger received minor injuries. Local Authorities reported the accident occurred at about 16: 00 Local time. The aircraft had been carrying 9 passengers from Juba to Boma, missed the runway and "hit itself" at the side of the runway. A 9 year old girl suffered minor injuries when she collided with the aircraft door while leaving the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年1月17日，一架SARAT L410执行从Juba飞往Jebel-Boma County Airstrip（South Sudan）的包机航班。飞机在该简易机场着陆时偏出或错过跑道，最终停在崎岖地面和灌木丛中。一名乘客受轻伤。当地主管部门报告称，事故发生在当地时间约16:00。飞机当时载有9名乘客，从Juba飞往Boma；飞机错过跑道，并在跑道一侧“撞到了自己”。一名9岁女孩离开飞机时撞到飞机舱门，受了轻伤。

cards.audioText: On January 24, 2025, a United Boeing 7 87, performing flight United 6 13 from Lagos (Nigeria) to Washington Dulles (USA) with 245 passengers and 11 crew, was enroute at FL3 6 0 over Ivory Coast about 170 nautical miles northwest of Abidjan (Ivory Coast) when the aircraft deviated from its assigned flight level twice by about -150 (-175) feet. The aircraft subsequently turned around and returned to Lagos where the aircraft landed without further incident about 100 minutes later. Emergency services treated a number of passengers and crew for minor injuries. Passengers reported while meal service was in progress the aircraft dropped sharply three times, one passenger knocked his head against the ceiling and became unconscious for some time. The airline reported the aircraft turned back to Lagos to address a technical issue. First responders met the passengers and crew to address reports of minor injuries of several passengers and crew.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年1月24日，United的一架Boeing 787执行United 613航班，从Lagos（Nigeria）飞往Washington Dulles（USA），机上有245名乘客和11名机组人员。飞机在Ivory Coast上空以FL360飞行，位于Abidjan（Ivory Coast）西北约170海里处时，两次偏离指定飞行高度层，偏差约为-150（-175）英尺。随后飞机掉头返回Lagos，并在约100分钟后着陆，未再发生其他事件。紧急服务人员为多名受轻伤的乘客和机组人员进行了救治。乘客报告称，当时正在进行餐饮服务，飞机突然急剧下降了三次，一名乘客的头部撞到客舱顶部，并一度失去意识。航空公司报告称，飞机为处理一个技术问题而返航Lagos。第一响应人员接应了乘客和机组人员，以处理多名乘客和机组人员轻伤的报告。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to flock of birds On January 25, 2025, a Transavia Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight 5 1 3 3 from Amsterdam (Netherlands) to Barcelona (Spain), was accelerating for takeoff from Amsterdam's Runway 18L when the crew rejected takeoff reporting they had seen a flock of at least 100 birds ahead. The aircraft slowed and stopped on the runway, the crew advised they did a high speed reject and requested emergency services to check their brakes. The aircraft subsequently returned to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 因鸟群中断起飞。2025年1月25日，Transavia的一架Boeing 737-800执行5133号航班，从Amsterdam（Netherlands）飞往Barcelona（Spain）。飞机正在Amsterdam机场18L跑道加速起飞时，机组中断起飞，并报告他们看到前方有一群至少由100只鸟组成的鸟群。飞机减速并停在跑道上。机组表示，他们实施了一次高速中断起飞，并请求紧急服务人员检查刹车。随后飞机返回停机坪。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to engine anomaly On January 24, 2025, an Asiana Airbus 330-300, performing flight OZ-766 from Chiang Mai (Thailand) to Seoul (South Korea), was accelerating engines for takeoff from Chiang Mai's Runway 36 when the crew rejected takeoff at very low speed (about 12 knots over ground) due an engine problem. The aircraft returned to the apron. Passengers reported seeing sparks and flames from the engine. The airline reported the aircraft with about 270 passengers rejected takeoff due to an engine anomaly. The extent of the engine anomaly is currently being assessed.
cards.audioTextZh: 因发动机异常中断起飞。2025年1月24日，Asiana的一架Airbus 330-300执行OZ-766航班，从Chiang Mai（Thailand）飞往Seoul（South Korea）。飞机正在Chiang Mai机场36号跑道加大发动机推力准备起飞时，机组因发动机问题在很低的速度下中断起飞，当时地速约为12节。飞机返回停机坪。乘客报告看到发动机冒出火花和火焰。航空公司报告称，这架载有约270名乘客的飞机因发动机异常中断起飞。目前正在评估发动机异常的程度。

cards.audioText: midair collision with helicopter on final On January 29, 2025, a PSA Airlines CRJ 700 on behalf of American Airlines, performing flight American Airlines 53 42 from Wichita to Washington National (USA) with 60 passengers and 4 crew, had been on approach to National's Runway 01 and was asked by tower whether they could land Runway 33, which the crew affirmed, the aircraft was subsequently cleared to land on Runway 33. The aircraft was on final approach to National's Runway 33descending through about 200 feet AGL about 0.6 nautical miles before the runway threshold when the aircraft collided with a military Sikorsky UH-60 helicopter call sign PAT 25 with 3 occupants, both aircraft fell into the Potomac River at 2 0: 4 6 Local time. "Tower, did you see that? " somebody radioed at 0 1: 4 6 Zulu time. All subsequent approaches were instructed to go around, departures were halted. All occupants of both aircraft perished as result of the collision. The airport was closed for the time being. Tower told aircraft waiting for departures that there had been a collision on finals to Runway 33, the airfield was closed and they should return to the apron and shut engines down. Tower diverted several helicopters in the area following the crash.
cards.audioTextZh: 在最后进近阶段与直升机发生空中相撞。2025年1月29日，PSA Airlines的一架CRJ 700代表American Airlines执行American Airlines 5342航班，从Wichita飞往Washington National（USA），机上有60名乘客和4名机组人员。飞机原本正在进近National机场01号跑道，塔台询问机组能否在33号跑道着陆，机组作出肯定答复，随后飞机获准在33号跑道着陆。飞机正在National机场33号跑道最后进近，在距跑道入口约0.6海里处下降通过离地约200英尺时，与一架军用Sikorsky UH-60直升机相撞。该直升机呼号为PAT 25，机上有3人。当地时间20:46，两架航空器均坠入Potomac River。Zulu时间01:46，有人通过无线电呼叫：“塔台，你看到了吗？”随后，所有进近中的航空器均被指示复飞，离场航班也被暂停。两架航空器上的所有人员均因碰撞遇难。机场暂时关闭。塔台告知等待起飞的航空器，33号跑道最后进近航线上发生了碰撞，机场已经关闭，它们应返回停机坪并关闭发动机。坠机后，塔台还指挥该区域的数架直升机改航。

cards.audioText: unsafe gear on approach On January 31, 2025, a Portugalia ERJ 1 9 0 on behalf of Air Portugal, performing flight 1 3 1 0 from Lisbon (Portugal) to Manchester (UK), was on final approach to Manchester's Runway 23R when the crew initiated a go around due to an unsafe gear indication, while overflying the airfield during the go around it became clear, both main gear had extended, however, the nose gear had not extended and its doors were still closed. The aircraft positioned for another approach, the crew managed to lower all gear, and landed safely on Runway 23R about 20 minutes after the go around.
cards.audioTextZh: 进近时起落架状态不安全。2025年1月31日，Portugalia的一架ERJ 190代表Air Portugal执行1310号航班，从Lisbon（Portugal）飞往Manchester（UK）。飞机正在Manchester机场23R跑道最后进近时，机组因收到起落架不安全指示而开始复飞。复飞过程中飞越机场时，可以清楚看到两个主起落架均已放下，但前起落架没有放下，其舱门仍然关闭。飞机重新定位实施另一次进近，机组成功放下全部起落架，并在复飞约20分钟后安全降落在23R跑道。

cards.audioText: captain incapacitated On January 19, 2025, a Lufthansa Boeing 7 47, performing flight Lufthansa 4 6 3 from Miami (USA) to Frankfurt/Main (Germany), was enroute at FL3 5 0 about 140 nautical miles west of Gander (Canada) when the crew decided to turn around and divert to Montreal (Canada) reporting the captain had become incapacitated. The aircraft landed in Montreal about 2 hours 20 minutes later. The Canadian TSB reported the captain became ill in the crew rest area. The senior first officer assumed command, the first officer summoned to the cockpit. Two flight attendants provided first aid. Considering the weather the crew decided to divert to Montreal, the crew declared emergency, dumped fuel enroute to Montreal, the aircraft landed in Montreal without further incident.
cards.audioTextZh: 机长失能。2025年1月19日，Lufthansa的一架Boeing 747执行Lufthansa 463航班，从Miami（USA）飞往Frankfurt/Main（Germany）。飞机在Gander（Canada）以西约140海里处以FL350飞行时，机组报告机长已经失能，并决定掉头备降Montreal（Canada）。飞机约2小时20分钟后在Montreal着陆。加拿大运输安全委员会报告称，机长在机组休息区生病。资深副驾驶接管指挥，另一名副驾驶被召入驾驶舱。两名乘务员提供了急救。考虑到天气情况，机组决定备降Montreal。机组宣布紧急情况，并在飞往Montreal途中放油，飞机最终在Montreal着陆，未再发生其他事件。

cards.audioText: cabin pressure problem On February 4, 2024, a Wizz Air Airbus 3 21 200, performing flight 3 1 7 6 from Barcelona (Spain) to Bucharest Otopeni (Romania), was enroute at FL3 3 0 about 140 nautical miles westsouthwest of Bucharest still in Bulgarian Airspace when the crew initiated an emergency descent to FL1 2 0 initially descending in a circle before crossing into Romania, subsequently descended to FL1 0 0 due to problems with the cabin pressure. In contact with Bucharest Center the crew cancelled Mayday as they were not at FL1 0 0. Later on approach the crew declared Mayday again advising a lady (32) in the middle of the cabin needed medical attention. The aircraft continued to Bucharest for a safe landing on Runway 08R about 35 minutes after leaving FL3 3 0.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱压力问题。2024年2月4日，Wizz Air的一架Airbus 321-200执行3176号航班，从Barcelona（Spain）飞往Bucharest Otopeni（Romania）。飞机当时仍位于Bulgarian空域，在Bucharest西南偏西约140海里处以FL330飞行。由于客舱压力出现问题，机组开始紧急下降，最初在进入Romania之前以盘旋方式下降至FL120，随后又下降至FL100。机组与Bucharest Center联系时取消了Mayday，因为他们当时并不在FL100。之后在进近过程中，机组再次宣布Mayday，并报告客舱中部一名女士（32岁）需要医疗救助。飞机继续飞往Bucharest，并在离开FL330约35分钟后安全降落在08R跑道。

cards.audioText: engine fire On January 21, 2025, a Volaris Airbus 3 2 1, performing flight 3 8 1 from Hermosillo to Mexico City (Mexico), was climbing out of Hermosillo's Runway 23 when the crew received a right hand engine fire indication, stopped the climb at 4000 feet and returned to Hermosillo for a safe landing on Runway 23 about 10 minutes after departure. Mexico's A I B rated the occurrence a serious incident and reported the crew heard the fire alarm and saw the indication of engine #2 fire on the ECAM, discharged one fire bottle, declared Mayday and returned to Hermosillo. The occurrence is investigated by Mexico's A I B.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机起火。2025年1月21日，Volaris的一架Airbus 321执行381号航班，从Hermosillo飞往Mexico City（Mexico）。飞机从Hermosillo机场23号跑道起飞爬升时，机组收到右侧发动机火警指示，于是在4,000英尺停止爬升并返回Hermosillo，在起飞约10分钟后安全降落在23号跑道。Mexico的AIB将该事件定性为严重事故征候，并报告称，机组听到火警警报，在ECAM上看到2号发动机起火指示，释放了一瓶灭火剂，宣布Mayday并返回Hermosillo。该事件正由Mexico的AIB调查。

cards.audioText: cracked windshield On February 5, 2025, an Ajet Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight 3 1 8 2 from Istanbul to Batman (Turkey), was climbing out of Runway 06L when the crew stopped the climb at 10,000 feet reporting a cracked windshield. The aircraft returned to Istanbul, went around on final approach to Runway 06R and landed safely on Runway 06R about 15 minutes after the go around and about 45 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 风挡玻璃破裂。2025年2月5日，Ajet的一架Boeing 737-800执行3182号航班，从Istanbul飞往Batman（Turkey）。飞机从06L跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告风挡玻璃破裂，并在10,000英尺停止爬升。飞机返回Istanbul，在对06R跑道实施最后进近时复飞，随后在复飞约15分钟后、起飞约45分钟后安全降落在06R跑道。

cards.audioText: On February 8, 2025, an Easyjet Airbus 3 20 performing flight 2 2 5 2 from Hurghada (Egypt) to Manchester (UK), was enroute at FL3 6 0 about 110 nautical miles southsoutheast of Athens (Greece) when the first officer decided to divert to Athens reporting the captain was ill. The aircraft landed safely on Athens' Runway 03L about one hour later. The airline reported the captain needed medical attention, the first officer performed a routine landing. Paramedics met the aircraft upon arrival. The onward flight was delayed over night and will continue the following day. Hotel rooms and meals were available. Passengers reported about 2 hours into the flight cabin crew were calling for medical staff amongst the passengers, a man had collapsed, several passengers responded to the call, a privacy screen was put in place in the front of the cabin. Cabin crew subsequently told the passengers that the man was in fact the captain of the flight. Emergency services were awaiting the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月8日，Easyjet的一架Airbus 320执行2252号航班，从Hurghada（Egypt）飞往Manchester（UK）。飞机在Athens（Greece）东南偏南约110海里处以FL360飞行时，副驾驶报告机长生病，并决定备降Athens。飞机约一小时后安全降落在Athens机场03L跑道。航空公司报告称，机长需要医疗救助，副驾驶完成了一次正常着陆。飞机到达后，医护人员前来接应。后续航班被推迟一夜，将于次日继续，并提供了酒店房间和餐食。乘客报告称，飞行约2小时后，客舱机组呼叫乘客中的医务人员，一名男子已经倒下，多名乘客响应了呼叫，客舱前部还设置了隐私屏风。随后，客舱机组告诉乘客，该男子实际上就是本次航班的机长。紧急服务人员正在等待飞机到达。

cards.audioText: On February 8, 2025, A Southwest Airlines Boeing 7 37 700, performing flight Southwest 2 3 0 1 from Sacramento to Denver (USA), was climbing out of Sacramento's Runway 35L when the crew requested to level off at 4000 feet advising they were looking at something. After levelling off at 4000 feet the crew advised about a minute later, that they needed to return to Sacramento, they had a possible engine (CFM 56) issue. The aircraft landed safely on Sacramento's Runway 35L about 18 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月8日，Southwest Airlines的一架Boeing 737-700执行Southwest 2301航班，从Sacramento飞往Denver（USA）。飞机从Sacramento机场35L跑道起飞爬升时，机组表示他们正在查看某个情况，并请求在4,000英尺改平。飞机在4,000英尺改平约一分钟后，机组表示需要返回Sacramento，飞机可能存在发动机（CFM 56）问题。飞机在起飞约18分钟后安全降落在Sacramento机场35L跑道。

cards.audioText: two generators failed leaving no lateral navigation On February 8, 2025, a One Air Boeing 7 47 400 freighter, performing flight 2 1 1 from London Heathrow (UK) to Hong Kong (China), was climbing out of Heathrow's Runway 09R when the crew stopped the climb at FL2 5 0, already over the North Sea reporting they had lost two of their four generators and requested radar vectors advising they had no lateral navigation left. The aircraft initially turned back towards England, then turned again and diverted to Amsterdam (Netherlands) advising they didn't need any fuel dump, and landed safely on Amsterdam's Runway 06 about 85 minutes after departure. On May 29th 2024 the AAIB reported the aircraft experienced failures on two electrical busses and lost all pitot heating. The aircraft diverted to Amsterdam due to marginal weather conditions at Heathrow. The occurrence has been rated a serious incident. On Feb 10th 2025 the AAIB reported in an interim statement: "The aircraft departed in weather of rain, thick cloud, and icing conditions. Electrical failures resulted from water having leaked onto the aircraft's avionic equipment - the effects of which included all pitot probe heaters becoming inoperative, and the cabin altitude increasing. The crew began descending the aircraft from FL2 5 0 and experienced unreliable flight instrument indications. They diverted the aircraft to Amsterdam Schiphol Airport, which had clear weather." The investigation is still ongoing.
cards.audioTextZh: 两台发电机失效，导致横向导航能力完全丧失。2025年2月8日，One Air的一架Boeing 747-400货机执行211号航班，从London Heathrow（UK）飞往Hong Kong（China）。飞机从Heathrow机场09R跑道起飞爬升，飞抵North Sea上空后，机组在FL250停止爬升，并报告四台发电机中有两台失效。机组请求雷达引导，并表示飞机已经完全失去横向导航能力。飞机最初掉头飞向England，随后再次转弯并备降Amsterdam（Netherlands）。机组表示不需要放油，飞机在起飞约85分钟后安全降落在Amsterdam机场06号跑道。2024年5月29日，AAIB报告称，飞机的两条电气汇流条发生故障，并失去全部空速管加温。由于Heathrow的天气条件处于临界状态，飞机备降Amsterdam。该事件被定性为严重事故征候。2025年2月10日，AAIB在一份临时声明中报告：“飞机在降雨、厚云和结冰天气条件下起飞。水泄漏到飞机的航空电子设备上，导致电气故障，其影响包括所有空速管探头加温器失效，以及客舱高度升高。机组开始操纵飞机从FL250下降，并遇到不可靠的飞行仪表指示。他们将飞机备降至天气晴朗的Amsterdam Schiphol Airport。”调查仍在进行中。

cards.audioText: On February 9, 2025, a Hawaiian Airlines Airbus A330-200, performing flight HA-22 from Honolulu to Seattle (USA) with 278 people on board, was in the initial climb out of Honolulu's Runway 08R when the crew requested to level off at 3000 feet and return to the airfield advising, they had a continuous trail coming out of the #1 engine and requested the emergency services on arrival. The aircraft returned to Honolulu for a safe landing on Runway 08L about 15 minutes after departure. The crew shut both engines down and did not activate the APU due to the leak concerns, emergency services confirmed a fuel leak from the left hand engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月9日，Hawaiian Airlines的一架Airbus A330-200执行HA-22航班，从Honolulu飞往Seattle（USA），机上共有278人。飞机从Honolulu机场08R跑道起飞并处于初始爬升阶段时，机组请求在3,000英尺改平并返回机场，表示1号发动机后方持续出现一条尾迹，并请求紧急服务人员在飞机到达时提供支援。飞机在起飞约15分钟后返回Honolulu，安全降落在08L跑道。机组关闭了两台发动机，并因担心泄漏而没有启动APU。紧急服务人员确认左侧发动机发生燃油泄漏。

cards.audioText: On February 11, 2025, a GOL Boeing 7 37-8 MAX, performing flight Gol 1 6 7 4 from Rio de Janeiro Galeao to Fortaleza (Brazil), was accelerating for takeoff from Galeao's Runway 10 when a bang was heard, the aircraft veered sharply to the right towards the right runway edge before steering back towards the center line while the aircraft slowed down. After coming to a stop short of the end of the runway the captain announced they had collided with a service vehicle on the runway. The passengers disembarked via mobile stairs onto the runway. There were no injuries, the aircraft as well as the car received substantial damage. The airport reported there had been an incident between a maintenance car and an aircraft on one of the runways, there had been no injuries. The passengers have disembarked normally, operation of the airport was not affected. The airline reported the aircraft collided with an airport vehicle on the runway during the takeoff procedure. Takeoff was rejected and all passengers and crew disembarked safely. A replacement flight to Fortaleza was made available. The airline is cooperating with CENIPA's investigation into the accident. A passenger (a public prosecutor) stated, that the aircraft was close to becoming airborne, when there was a jolt and a noise followed by the crew braking the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月11日，GOL的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX执行Gol 1674航班，从Rio de Janeiro Galeao飞往Fortaleza（Brazil）。飞机正在Galeao机场10号跑道加速起飞时，传来一声巨响，飞机突然向右偏转并冲向跑道右边缘，随后在减速过程中重新转回中线方向。飞机在跑道末端之前停下后，机长宣布飞机与跑道上的一辆勤务车辆发生了碰撞。乘客通过移动式客梯下到跑道上。没有人员受伤，但飞机和车辆均受到严重损坏。机场报告称，一辆维修车辆与一架飞机在其中一条跑道上发生事件，没有人员受伤。乘客已经正常下机，机场运行未受影响。航空公司报告称，飞机在起飞过程中与跑道上的一辆机场车辆相撞，飞机中断起飞，所有乘客和机组人员均安全下机。航空公司安排了前往Fortaleza的替代航班，并正在配合CENIPA对该事故的调查。一名乘客，也是一名检察官，表示飞机接近离地时猛然一震并传来响声，随后机组对飞机实施了制动。

cards.audioText: loss of cabin pressure On February 14, 2025, a Vueling Airbus 3 20 200, performing flight Vueling 1 8 8 4 from Barcelona (Spain) to Berlin (Germany), was climbing through FL3 0 0 out of Barcelona when the crew initiated an emergency descent reporting the loss of cabin pressure. The aircraft levelled off at FL1 0 0 and returned to Barcelona for a safe landing on Runway 24R about 75 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱失压。2025年2月14日，Vueling的一架Airbus 320-200执行Vueling 1884航班，从Barcelona（Spain）飞往Berlin（Germany）。飞机从Barcelona起飞爬升通过FL300时，机组报告客舱失压并开始紧急下降。飞机在FL100改平，随后返回Barcelona，并在起飞约75分钟后安全降落在24R跑道。

cards.audioText: Engine failure On February 13, 2025, a One Air Boeing 7 47 400 freighter, performing positioning flight One Air 9 3 2 Papa from Cardiff (UK) to Zaragoza (Spain), was climbing out of Cardiff's Runway 12 when the crew stopped the climb at FL2 4 0 following an engine failure. The aircraft diverted to East Midlands (UK) for a safe landing on Runway 09 about 50 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机失效。2025年2月13日，One Air的一架Boeing 747-400货机执行调机航班One Air 932 Papa，从Cardiff（UK）飞往Zaragoza（Spain）。飞机从Cardiff机场12号跑道起飞爬升时发生发动机失效，机组在FL240停止爬升。飞机备降East Midlands（UK），并在起飞约50分钟后安全降落在09号跑道。

cards.audioText: radar altimeter malfunctioning On February 13, 2025, an Air Canada Rouge Airbus 319-100, performing flight RV-1833 from Antigua (Antigua) to Toronto (Canada) with 118 people on board, was in the initial climb out of Antigua's Runway 07 when at about 800 feet AGL the crew received numerous successive aural alerts related to the radar altimeter including call outs regarding gear position and throttle position. The crew determined the alerts to be false, stopped the climb at FL110 and entered a hold to troubleshoot. The aircraft subsequently returned to Antigua for a safe landing on Runway 07 about 90 minutes after departure. The Canadian TSB reported after consultation with maintenance operations control the crew pulled the RALT2 circuit breaker, that stopped the aural alerts. The aircraft performed an overweight landing back.
cards.audioTextZh: 雷达高度表故障。2025年2月13日，Air Canada Rouge的一架Airbus 319-100执行RV-1833航班，从Antigua（Antigua）飞往Toronto（Canada），机上共有118人。飞机从Antigua机场07号跑道起飞并处于初始爬升阶段，在离地约800英尺时，机组连续收到多条与雷达高度表有关的声音警报，其中包括与起落架位置和油门位置有关的语音提示。机组判定这些警报为虚假警报，在FL110停止爬升，并进入等待以排查故障。随后飞机返回Antigua，并在起飞约90分钟后安全降落在07号跑道。加拿大运输安全委员会报告称，机组与维修运行控制部门协商后拔出了RALT2断路器，声音警报随即停止。飞机返回后实施了超重着陆。

cards.audioText: complete loss of hydraulics On August, 12, 2024, A Skippers Aviation Swearingen SA 227 DC, performing charter flight PY-6002 from Forrestania to Perth (Australia) with 4 passengers and 2 crew, was enroute nearing the top of descent into Perth when the aircraft experienced a complete loss of hydraulics. The crew entered a hold to prepare for a manual gear extension and flapless landing. The crew requested a ground inspection after landing to check for any fluids leaking from the aircraft and requested a tow truck to pull them off the runway. The aircraft subsequently landed safely on Perth's Runway 24 and vacated the runway onto taxiway A. Unable to establish communication with the tow truck and seeing, some hydraulic pressure was still available and testing of the brakes showed brake pressure was present, the captain decided to taxi the aircraft to the apron. Taxiing downslope due to a slight downhill gradient the aircraft accelerated, both crew applied brakes with no effect, the captain briefly applied reverse, but then feathered the propellers and shut the engines down just before the aircraft collided with a hangar. There were no injuries, the aircraft sustained minor damage.
cards.audioTextZh: 液压系统完全失效。2024年8月12日，Skippers Aviation的一架Swearingen SA 227 DC执行包机航班PY-6002，从Forrestania飞往Perth（Australia），机上有4名乘客和2名机组人员。飞机在航路飞行中接近飞往Perth的下降顶点时，液压系统完全失效。机组进入等待，为人工放下起落架和无襟翼着陆做准备。机组请求飞机着陆后由地面人员检查是否有任何液体从飞机泄漏，并请求拖车将飞机拖离跑道。随后，飞机安全降落在Perth机场24号跑道，并从跑道脱离至A滑行道。由于无法与拖车建立通信，同时看到仍有一些液压压力，并且刹车测试显示存在刹车压力，机长决定将飞机滑行至停机坪。飞机沿着轻微下坡坡度向下滑行时开始加速，两名机组人员均踩下刹车，但没有效果。机长曾短暂使用反推，但随后将螺旋桨顺桨，并在飞机撞上机库前关闭了发动机。没有人员受伤，飞机受到轻微损坏。

cards.audioText: brakes problem On February 20, 2025, a Republic Airways Embraer ERJ 1 7 5 on behalf of American Airlines, performing flight American 45 14 from Jacksonville to Philadelphia (USA) with 76 people on board, was descending towards Philadelphia when the crew reported a brakes indication, they might have a problem with the brakes on landing. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Runway 27L. After landing the crew advised they had normal brakes. Emergency services inspected the aircraft before the aircraft continued to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 刹车问题。2025年2月20日，Republic Airways的一架Embraer ERJ 175代表American Airlines执行American 4514航班，从Jacksonville飞往Philadelphia（USA），机上共有76人。飞机正在向Philadelphia下降时，机组报告出现刹车指示，飞机着陆时的刹车可能存在问题。飞机继续飞行，并安全降落在27L跑道。着陆后，机组表示刹车工作正常。紧急服务人员检查飞机后，飞机继续滑行至停机坪。

cards.audioText: On February 1, 2025, a Sunwing Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight Sunwing 7 2 0 from Toronto (Canada) to Montego Bay (Jamaica), was climbing out of Toronto's Runway 06L when the crew reported they had had a tail strike, stopped the climb at 6000 feet and returned to Toronto for a safe landing on Runway 05 about 20 minutes after departure. The Canadian TSB reported the crew carried out an overweight landing. Maintenance found minor scraping to the tail skid assembly that remained within limits. An overweight landing inspection was done and the aircraft returned to service.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月1日，Sunwing的一架Boeing 737-800执行Sunwing 720航班，从Toronto（Canada）飞往Montego Bay（Jamaica）。飞机从Toronto机场06L跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告飞机发生过擦尾，在6,000英尺停止爬升并返回Toronto，于起飞约20分钟后安全降落在05号跑道。加拿大运输安全委员会报告称，机组实施了超重着陆。维修人员发现尾橇组件存在轻微刮擦，但仍在限制范围内。完成超重着陆检查后，飞机恢复运行。

cards.audioText: On February 23, 2025, an Asiana Airbus 3 50 900, performing flight Asiana 2 1 2 from Seoul (South Korea) to San Francisco (USA), was on final approach to San Francisco's Runway 28L cleared to land at 1 4 0 1 Local time (2 2 0 1 Zulu time), when tower issued a low altitude alert advising the crew to immediately check their altitude, altimeter 30.26. Tower instructed a go around. The crew initiated a go around, positioned for another approach and landed without further incident about 16 minutes after the go around.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月23日，Asiana的一架Airbus 350-900执行Asiana 212航班，从Seoul（South Korea）飞往San Francisco（USA）。飞机正在对San Francisco机场28L跑道实施最后进近，并已于当地时间14:01（Zulu时间22:01）获准着陆。此时，塔台发布低高度警报，提醒机组立即检查高度，高度表拨正值为30.26。塔台指示飞机复飞。机组开始复飞，重新定位实施另一次进近，并在复飞约16分钟后着陆，未再发生其他事件。

cards.audioText: On February 25, 2025, a Southwest Airlines Boeing 737-800, performing flight WN-2504 from Omaha to Chicago Midway (USA), was in the flare to land on Midway's Runway 31C at 08: 48L (14: 48Z), when the crew initiated a go around due to a business jet crossing the runway. The aircraft climbed out to safety, positioned for another approach and landed safely on Runway 31C about 15 minutes later. A Bombardier Challenger 35 was taxiing for departure from Runway 22L and was tracking Runway 04L crossing Runway 31C. Tower was just about to instruct the Boeing to go around when the crew already reported they were going around. Later the crew queried how that happened but was instructed to contact approach. The Bombardier was in contact with ground and had been instructed to hold short of Runway 31C. Following the occurrence ground again advised their holding instructions had been to hold short of Runway 31C, the crew was given a phone number for pilot deviation.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年2月25日，Southwest Airlines的一架Boeing 737-800执行WN-2504航班，从Omaha飞往Chicago Midway（USA）。飞机于当地时间08:48（Zulu时间14:48）在Midway机场31C跑道着陆拉平时，机组因一架公务机正在穿越跑道而开始复飞。飞机爬升至安全高度，重新定位实施另一次进近，并在约15分钟后安全降落在31C跑道。一架Bombardier Challenger 35正滑行前往22L跑道起飞，并沿04L跑道滑行穿越31C跑道。塔台正要指示Boeing飞机复飞时，机组已经报告正在复飞。随后，机组询问此事如何发生，但被指示联系进近管制。Bombardier飞机当时正与地面管制联系，并已被指示在31C跑道外等待。事件发生后，地面管制再次告知机组，之前的等待指令是要求其在31C跑道外等待，并向机组提供了一个用于处理飞行员偏离指令事件的电话号码。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to engine fire On September 30, 2023, a United Boeing 7 37-9 MAX, performing flight united 3 29 from Denver to Boston (USA) with 167 passengers and 6 crew, was accelerating for takeoff from Denver's Runway 16R when the crew rejected takeoff at high speed, in response to the radio transmission tower reported he could see fire from the left hand engine. The crew affirmed and stopped the aircraft, subsequently reporting it appeared they had flat tyres on the right hand side and were disabled. The runway was closed, emergency services responded, tower cleared the crew to evacuate if needed stating "the runway is yours! " While emergency services were responding but had not yet reached the runway tower informed emergency services that they no longer observed any fire, it appears extinguished.
cards.audioTextZh: 因发动机起火中断起飞。2023年9月30日，United的一架Boeing 737-9 MAX执行United 329航班，从Denver飞往Boston（USA），机上有167名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机正在Denver机场16R跑道加速起飞时，机组在高速状态下中断起飞。塔台回应无线电通话时报告，他可以看到左侧发动机冒火。机组予以确认并将飞机停下，随后报告右侧轮胎似乎已经爆胎，飞机无法移动。跑道被关闭，紧急服务人员赶赴现场。塔台许可机组在需要时撤离，并表示：“跑道交给你们！”紧急服务人员正在赶往现场但尚未到达跑道时，塔台通知紧急服务人员，他们已经看不到任何火焰，火似乎已经熄灭。

cards.audioText: hydraulic failure, ran out of fuel, forced landing in a field On September 12, 2023, a Ural Airlines Airbus 3 20 200, performing flight 1 3 8 3 from Sochi to Omsk (Russia) with 161 passengers and 6 crew, was on final approach to Omsk's Runway 07 (length 2500 meters, 8200 feet) when the crew initiated a go around from about 600 meters MSL (2000 feet MSL) due to a hydraulics failure. The aircraft climbed to FL180 and diverted to Novosibirsk at a speed over ground of about 260 knots over ground, however, needed to perform a forced landing on an open field. There were no injuries, the aircraft received damage to gear and wings. The airline reported the green hydraulics system failed on approach to Omsk. The commander decided to divert to an airfield with longer runways, the failure of the green hydraulic system affected operation of spoilers and flaps and increased the landing distance needed. However, the landing gear doors remained open as result of the hydraulic failure and could not be closed. Together with strong headwinds this increased the fuel consumption. The commander realized they could not make it to Novosibirsk and decided to land in an open field with the gear extended. 6 busses have been dispatched to the landing site and take the passengers to Omsk and Novosibirsk. The passengers were supplied with food, water and chargers for mobile phones, the luggage has been handed to the passengers, too.
cards.audioTextZh: 液压系统失效、燃油耗尽并在田野迫降。2023年9月12日，Ural Airlines的一架Airbus 320-200执行1383号航班，从Sochi飞往Omsk（Russia），机上有161名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机正在对Omsk机场07号跑道实施最后进近，该跑道长2,500米，即8,200英尺。机组因液压系统失效，在海拔约600米，即海拔2,000英尺处开始复飞。飞机爬升至FL180，并以约260节地速备降Novosibirsk，但随后不得不在一片开阔田野上迫降。没有人员受伤，飞机的起落架和机翼受到损坏。航空公司报告称，飞机在进近Omsk时绿色液压系统失效。机长决定备降至一座跑道更长的机场，因为绿色液压系统失效影响了扰流板和襟翼的工作，并增加了所需着陆距离。然而，由于液压系统失效，起落架舱门一直保持打开且无法关闭。加上强烈的逆风，这使燃油消耗增加。机长意识到飞机无法飞抵Novosibirsk，决定在起落架放下的状态下于一片开阔田野着陆。已有6辆大巴被派往着陆地点，将乘客送往Omsk和Novosibirsk。乘客获得了食物、饮用水和手机充电器，行李也已交还给乘客。

cards.audioText: loss of separation on runway On February 22, 2023, a Skywest Embraer ERJ 1 7 5 on behalf of United, performing flight United 5 3 2 6 from Burbank to San Francisco (USA) with 73 people on board, had been cleared to line up Runway 33, then waited in position for about two minutes. A Mesa Airlines CRJ 900 on behalf of American Airlines, performing flight American 5 8 2 6 from Phoenix to Burbank (USA) with 41 people on board, was on final approach to Runway 33 when tower advised a departure was in position and would take off before them and instructed the aircraft to continue. A private aircraft on approach also to Runway 33got too close to the CRJ 900 and was instructed to go around. About two minutes after the ERJ 1 7 5 had been cleared to line up Runway 33, tower cleared the aircraft for takeoff and in the same sentence cleared the CRJ 900 to land. The CRJ 900 however initiated a go around and was instructed to turn left, the crew reported receiving a TCAS R A, the ERJ 1 7 5 was instructed to continue their climb and was later instructed to turn left after the aircraft were clear of conflict. The ERJ 1 7 5 continued to destination, the CRJ 900 joined a downwind and landed on Runway 33 about 12 minutes after the go around.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道上的间隔丧失。2023年2月22日，Skywest的一架Embraer ERJ 175代表United执行United 5326航班，从Burbank飞往San Francisco（USA），机上共有73人。飞机获准进入33号跑道并对正，随后在跑道上等待了约两分钟。Mesa Airlines的一架CRJ 900代表American Airlines执行American 5826航班，从Phoenix飞往Burbank（USA），机上共有41人。该机正在对33号跑道实施最后进近时，塔台告知机组，一架离场飞机已在跑道上就位，并将在他们之前起飞，同时指示该机继续进近。另有一架私人飞机也在进近33号跑道，该机与CRJ 900距离过近，因此被指示复飞。ERJ 175获准进入33号跑道并对正约两分钟后，塔台许可其起飞，并在同一句话中许可CRJ 900着陆。然而，CRJ 900开始复飞并被指示左转，机组报告收到TCAS RA。ERJ 175被指示继续爬升，随后在两机脱离冲突后被指示左转。ERJ 175继续飞往目的地，CRJ 900加入三边，并在复飞约12分钟后降落在33号跑道。

cards.audioText: engine fire due to bird strike On March 1, 2025, a Fedex Federal Express Boeing 767-300, performing flight FX-3609 from Newark to Indianapolis (USA) with 3 crew, was climbing out of Newark's Runway 22L, tower already instructed to contact departure, when the crew still on tower declared emergency reporting they had taken a bird into the #2 engine (CF6). The crew of another aircraft on the ground advised tower, they believed they saw the right hand engine fall off the aircraft (which was not correct). Ground observers reported they saw the aircraft flying over them with large flames trailing the right hand engine. The aircraft stopped the climb at 2000 feet, shut the engine down, positioned for the approach and landed safely on Runway 22L about 8 minutes after departure, emergency services already at the runway, the right hand engine still emitting continuous large flames through the exhaust, tower advising the crew the right hand engine emitted fire. The aircraft stopped on the runway, emergency services closed the runway. The crew subsequently advised emergency services, that they had discharged both fire bottles onto the engine after receiving an engine fire indication, emergency services confirmed the engine was still on fire and they were putting water on. Tower closed all runways. The crew reported they were just initiating the turn at about 500 feet AGL when birds got into the right hand engine. About 15 minutes after landing tower reopened Runway 29 while runways 22L and 22R remained closed.
cards.audioTextZh: 因鸟击导致发动机起火。2025年3月1日，Fedex Federal Express的一架Boeing 767-300执行FX-3609航班，从Newark飞往Indianapolis（USA），机上有3名机组人员。飞机从Newark机场22L跑道起飞爬升，塔台已经指示其联系离场管制，但机组仍在塔台频率上宣布紧急情况，并报告2号发动机（CF6）吸入了一只鸟。地面上另一架航空器的机组告知塔台，他们认为看到该飞机的右侧发动机从机体脱落，但这一判断并不正确。地面目击者报告称，他们看到飞机从上空飞过，右侧发动机后方拖着大面积火焰。飞机在2,000英尺停止爬升，关闭发动机，重新定位实施进近，并在起飞约8分钟后安全降落在22L跑道。紧急服务人员已经在跑道旁待命，右侧发动机仍不断从排气口喷出大面积火焰，塔台也提醒机组右侧发动机正在冒火。飞机停在跑道上，紧急服务人员关闭了跑道。随后机组告知紧急服务人员，他们收到发动机火警指示后，已向发动机释放两瓶灭火剂。紧急服务人员确认发动机仍在燃烧，并正在向其喷水。塔台关闭了所有跑道。机组报告称，飞机在离地约500英尺刚开始转弯时，有鸟进入右侧发动机。飞机着陆约15分钟后，塔台重新开放29号跑道，而22L和22R跑道仍然关闭。

cards.audioText: flaps up landing On March 1, 2025, a Norwegian Air Shuttle Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight 9 3 2 3 from Las Palmas (Spain) to Stavanger (Norway), was on approach to Stavanger when the crew stopped the descent at 3000 feet and entered a hold due to problems with the flaps. The crew subsequently prepared for a flaps up landing, positioned for an approach to Stavanger's Runway 18 about 30 minutes later and landed safely at high speed (193 knots over ground). The aircraft stopped at the end of the runway for about 5 minutes before continuing taxi to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 襟翼收上状态着陆。2025年3月1日，Norwegian Air Shuttle的一架Boeing 737-800执行9323号航班，从Las Palmas（Spain）飞往Stavanger（Norway）。飞机正在进近Stavanger时，机组因襟翼问题在3,000英尺停止下降并进入等待。随后，机组为襟翼收上状态着陆做好准备，在约30分钟后重新定位进近Stavanger机场18号跑道，并以较高速度安全着陆，当时地速为193节。飞机在跑道末端停留约5分钟，然后继续滑行至停机坪。

cards.audioText: On March 10, 2025, a Qantas Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight Qantas 5 0 5 from Brisbane to Sydney (Australia) with 127 passengers and 6 crew, was approaching Sydney and needed to enter a hold at FL2 4 0. Just exiting the hold the captain began to suffer from chest pain and requested cabin crew to prepare the defibrillator for him. The first officer took control of the aircraft while cabin crew prepared the pads of the defibrillator on the captain. The aircraft landed safely on Runway 34R about 25 minutes after exiting the hold. Cabin crew did not need to operate the defibrillator, the captain was even able to taxi the aircraft to the apron. Paramedics met the aircraft and transported the captain to a hospital. The airline reported the pilot experienced chest pains during the flight, the other pilot landed the aircraft into Sydney as normal. The pilot was treated by paramedics and taken to a hospital.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年3月10日，Qantas的一架Boeing 737-800执行Qantas 505航班，从Brisbane飞往Sydney（Australia），机上有127名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机正在接近Sydney，需要在FL240进入等待。刚刚退出等待时，机长开始出现胸痛，并请求客舱机组为他准备除颤器。副驾驶接管飞机操纵，客舱机组则将除颤器电极片贴在机长身上。飞机在退出等待约25分钟后安全降落在34R跑道。客舱机组不需要启动除颤器，机长甚至还能够将飞机滑行至停机坪。医护人员前来接应飞机，并将机长送往医院。航空公司报告称，这名飞行员在飞行中出现胸痛，另一名飞行员正常操纵飞机在Sydney着陆。该飞行员接受了医护人员的救治并被送往医院。

cards.audioText: On March 18, 2025, a Japan Air Commuter A T R 4 2, performing flight 2 0 1 from Amakusa to Kumamoto (Japan) with 14 people on board, was climbing out of Amakusa's Runway 31 when the crew stopped the climb at 4000 feet after receiving a lightning strike. The aircraft returned to Amakusa for a safe landing on Runway 31 about 25 minutes after departure. The airline reported the aircraft was inspected, burn marks were found at the nose wheel area and on the tail of the aircraft. All flights of the aircraft until and including Mar 26th 2025 have been cancelled.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年3月18日，Japan Air Commuter的一架ATR 42执行201号航班，从Amakusa飞往Kumamoto（Japan），机上共有14人。飞机从Amakusa机场31号跑道起飞爬升时遭到雷击，机组在4,000英尺停止爬升。飞机返回Amakusa，并在起飞约25分钟后安全降落在31号跑道。航空公司报告称，飞机接受了检查，在前轮区域和飞机尾部发现烧蚀痕迹。该飞机截至并包括2025年3月26日的所有航班均已取消。

cards.audioText: On March 21, 2025, a Jin Air Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight Jin Air 6 5 9 from Seoul Gimpo to Pohang (South Korea) with 42 passengers and 6 crew, was climbing out of Gimpo's Runway 14L when the crew declared PAN PAN and stopped the climb at about 5500 feet due to unreliable airspeed and altitude indications. The aircraft returned to Gimpo Airport for a safe landing on Runway 14R about 50 minutes after departure. The airline reported discrepancies in indicated airspeed and altitude and returned for an urgent landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年3月21日，Jin Air的一架Boeing 737-800执行Jin Air 659航班，从Seoul Gimpo飞往Pohang（South Korea），机上有42名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机从Gimpo机场14L跑道起飞爬升时，机组因空速和高度指示不可靠而宣布PAN PAN，并在约5,500英尺停止爬升。飞机返回Gimpo Airport，并在起飞约50分钟后安全降落在14R跑道。航空公司报告称，指示空速和高度存在差异，因此飞机返回并实施紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: On March 16, 2025, a Cathay Pacific Boeing 7 47 400 freighter, performing flight Cathay 3 1 9 5 from New York JFK (USA) to Toronto (Canada), had just levelled off at cruise FL3 0 0 when the crew donned their oxygen masks and initiated an emergency descent to 10,000 feet due to the loss of cabin pressure. The aircraft returned to New York's JFK airport for a safe landing on Runway 22L about 100 minutes after departure. The crew requested emergency services to inspect the aircraft for structural damage.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年3月16日，Cathay Pacific的一架Boeing 747-400货机执行Cathay 3195航班，从New York JFK（USA）飞往Toronto（Canada）。飞机刚刚在巡航高度FL300改平，机组便因客舱失压戴上氧气面罩，并开始紧急下降至10,000英尺。飞机返回New York的JFK机场，并在起飞约100分钟后安全降落在22L跑道。机组请求紧急服务人员检查飞机是否存在结构损坏。

cards.audioText: engine fire On March 26, 2025, an AirAsia Airbus 3 20-200, performing flight Air Asia 1 2 8 from Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia) to Shenzhen (China) with 171 people on board, was climbing out of Kuala Lumpur's Runway 33 when the crew reported a left engine (CFM 5 6) fire indication, stopped the climb at 4000 feet, worked the related checklist and discharged one of the fire bottles, entered a hold and returned to Kuala Lumpur for a safe landing on Runway 33 about 2 hours after departure. The airline reported all 171 passengers and crew disembarked safely, the fire was extinguished by the engine's Halon fire suppression system. The airline believes the fire was caused by a burst pneumatic duct.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机起火。2025年3月26日，AirAsia的一架Airbus 320-200执行Air Asia 128航班，从Kuala Lumpur（Malaysia）飞往Shenzhen（China），机上共有171人。飞机从Kuala Lumpur机场33号跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告左侧发动机（CFM 56）出现火警指示，在4,000英尺停止爬升，执行相关检查单并释放了一瓶灭火剂。飞机进入等待，随后返回Kuala Lumpur，并在起飞约2小时后安全降落在33号跑道。航空公司报告称，全部171名乘客和机组人员均安全下机，火已由发动机的Halon灭火系统扑灭。航空公司认为，起火是由一条气压导管爆裂造成的。

cards.audioText: EGPWS warning on approach On February 2, 2025, an Easyjet Airbus 3 20 200 Neo, performing flight Easyjet 22 51 from Manchester (UK) to Hurghada (Egypt), was on approach to Hurghada's Runway 34L descending to about 2900 feet on downwind when the EGPWS issued a warning prompting the crew to climb back to 4000 feet while turning for base. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Runway 34L about 7 minutes later. On Mar 29th 2025 Egypt's AAID reported the occurrence was rated a serious incident characterized as "Near CFIT on approach (EGPWS closure)" and is being investigated. The captain reported the incident himself, the airline forwarded the report to the authorities.
cards.audioTextZh: 进近时出现EGPWS警告。2025年2月2日，Easyjet的一架Airbus 320-200 Neo执行Easyjet 2251航班，从Manchester（UK）飞往Hurghada（Egypt）。飞机正在进近Hurghada机场34L跑道，在三边下降至约2,900英尺时，EGPWS发出警告，促使机组在转向四边的同时重新爬升至4,000英尺。飞机继续进近，并在约7分钟后安全降落在34L跑道。2025年3月29日，Egypt的AAID报告称，该事件被定性为严重事故征候，描述为“进近阶段险些发生可控飞行撞地（EGPWS接近率警告）”，目前正在调查。机长自行报告了该事件，航空公司将报告转交给主管部门。

cards.audioText: TCAS resolution on initial climb On March 28, 2025, a Delta Airlines Airbus 3 19 100, performing flight Delta 29 83 from Washington National to Minneapolis (USA), was in the initial climb through about 1300 feet out of Washington's Runway 19 when tower handed the aircraft to departure, the crew read back, immediately afterwards tower attempted to contact Delta 29 83 again with no response. About 20 seconds after the hand off the crew reported on departure frequency, they just had had a TCAS resolution advisory for an aircraft 500 feet below them. The controller confirmed. The aircraft continued the climb and flight to Minneapolis for a safe landing without further incident. The F A A reported: "Delta Air Lines Flight 29 83 was cleared for takeoff at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport around 3 1 5 p.m. local time on Friday, March 28, while four U.S. Air Force T 38 Talons were inbound to Arlington National Cemetery for a flyover. The Delta aircraft received an onboard alert that another aircraft was nearby. Air traffic controllers issued corrective instructions to both aircraft. The F A A will investigate."
cards.audioTextZh: 初始爬升阶段出现TCAS决断咨询。2025年3月28日，Delta Airlines的一架Airbus 319-100执行Delta 2983航班，从Washington National飞往Minneapolis（USA）。飞机从Washington机场19号跑道起飞，并在初始爬升通过约1,300英尺时，塔台将飞机移交给离场管制，机组进行了复诵。紧接着，塔台再次尝试联系Delta 2983，但没有收到回应。移交约20秒后，机组在离场频率上报告，他们刚刚因一架位于本机下方500英尺的航空器收到TCAS决断咨询。管制员予以确认。飞机继续爬升并飞往Minneapolis，最终安全着陆，未再发生其他事件。FAA报告称：“当地时间3月28日星期五下午3:15左右，Delta Air Lines 2983航班在Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport获准起飞，当时四架美国空军T-38 Talon正飞往Arlington National Cemetery执行飞越任务。Delta飞机收到机载警报，提示附近有另一架航空器。空中交通管制员向两架航空器都发布了纠正指令。FAA将对此展开调查。”

cards.audioText: On September 8, 2015, British Airways Flight 2 2 7 6 was preparing to take off from Las Vegas McCarran International Airport to London Gatwick. During the takeoff roll, passengers heard a loud bang from the left side. Flames erupted from the left engine, prompting the pilots to immediately abort the takeoff. The aircraft stopped safely on the runway as smoke began entering the cabin. The crew quickly deployed all emergency slides and began evacuation. Fire trucks arrived within two minutes and extinguished the flames. Twenty-seven passengers suffered minor injuries during evacuation, mostly due to sliding and falls. Investigation revealed a failure in the engine's compressor section caused the fire. Thanks to the crew's training and fast action, all 170 people survived. The event emphasized the importance of precise emergency drills, aircraft evacuation procedures, and immediate decision-making under pressure.
cards.audioTextZh: 2015年9月8日，British Airways 2276航班正准备从Las Vegas McCarran International Airport起飞前往London Gatwick。在起飞滑跑过程中，乘客听到左侧传来一声巨响。左侧发动机喷出火焰，飞行员随即立即中断起飞。飞机安全停在跑道上，此时烟雾开始进入客舱。机组迅速放出全部应急滑梯并开始撤离。消防车在两分钟内到达并扑灭火焰。27名乘客在撤离过程中受轻伤，主要由滑梯滑下和跌倒造成。调查显示，发动机压气机部分发生故障并引发火灾。得益于机组的训练和迅速行动，机上全部170人均幸存。该事件强调了精确应急演练、航空器撤离程序以及在压力下立即作出决定的重要性。

cards.audioText: On September 21, 2005, JetBlue Flight 2 9 2 departed from Burbank, California, heading to New York. Shortly after takeoff, the pilots realized that the nose landing gear was turned sideways and could not retract. The crew informed air traffic control and decided to divert to Los Angeles International Airport. For over two hours, the aircraft circled the area to burn fuel and reduce landing weight. Passengers onboard watched live news coverage of their own situation via the in-flight entertainment system. The aircraft finally landed with its nose gear locked at a 90-degree angle. Sparks flew as the twisted gear scraped the runway, but the pilots kept the aircraft under control. The aircraft came to a complete stop without further incident. No one was injured. The event demonstrated the crew's professionalism and the aircraft's ability to withstand structural problems during landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年9月21日，JetBlue 292航班从California的Burbank起飞，前往New York。起飞后不久，飞行员发现前起落架横向偏转，且无法收起。机组通知空中交通管制，并决定备降Los Angeles International Airport。飞机在该区域盘旋了两个多小时，以消耗燃油并降低着陆重量。机上乘客通过机上娱乐系统观看了关于自身处境的电视新闻直播。飞机最终在前起落架锁定于90度角的情况下着陆。扭转的起落架在跑道上摩擦时火花四溅，但飞行员始终保持对飞机的控制。飞机最终完全停下，未再发生其他事件。没有人员受伤。该事件体现了机组的专业素养，以及飞机在着陆过程中承受结构问题的能力。

cards.audioText: On May 29, 2009, Shenzhen Airlines Flight 9648 was arriving at Guilin Liangjiang International Airport after a routine flight from Nanning. It was raining heavily, and visibility was low. The pilots attempted to land but touched down far along the wet runway. Realizing there was not enough distance to stop, the crew tried maximum braking and reverse thrust. The aircraft skidded, left the runway, and came to rest in soft grass. Passengers panicked, but the crew remained calm and initiated evacuation. All 166 people onboard exited safely, with only minor injuries reported. Investigation found the pilots misjudged approach speed and landing distance in poor weather. The airline implemented stricter training for wet runway operations and emphasized decision-making in unstable approaches. The event showed the risks of landing in adverse conditions and the importance of clear landing criteria.
cards.audioTextZh: 2009年5月29日，Shenzhen Airlines 9648航班完成从Nanning起飞的正常飞行后，正在抵达Guilin Liangjiang International Airport。当时下着大雨，能见度很低。飞行员尝试着陆，但飞机在湿滑跑道上很靠后的位置才接地。机组意识到剩余距离不足以让飞机停下，于是尝试使用最大刹车和反推。飞机打滑，冲出跑道，最终停在松软的草地上。乘客陷入恐慌，但机组保持冷静并开始组织撤离。机上全部166人均安全撤离，仅报告有人受轻伤。调查发现，飞行员在恶劣天气下错误判断了进近速度和着陆距离。航空公司对湿跑道运行实施了更严格的培训，并强调在不稳定进近中作出决定的重要性。该事件表明，在不利条件下着陆存在风险，同时也体现了明确着陆标准的重要性。

cards.audioText: On March 27, 2019, China Eastern Airlines 5 5 1 departed from Shanghai Pudong International Airport en route to London Heathrow. Mid-flight, over international airspace, a passenger suddenly suffered a severe medical crisis, marked by rapid heartbeat, severe asthma, and vomiting. The vigilant cabin crew immediately assisted by having the affected passenger lie down and locating two doctors among the passengers. When the patient's condition deteriorated rapidly, the pilots decided to divert the flight to Beijing. They promptly informed Beijing air traffic control and arranged for an emergency landing. Because the international flight was fully fueled, the pilots released excess fuel midair to meet safety protocols. At 0 5 1 5 PM Beijing time, the aircraft landed safely, and ground medical teams took over. The coordinated effort saved the patient's life and demonstrated effective in-flight crisis management, communication, and adherence to safety procedures.
cards.audioTextZh: 2019年3月27日，China Eastern Airlines 551航班从Shanghai Pudong International Airport起飞，前往London Heathrow。飞行途中，飞机位于国际空域上空时，一名乘客突然出现严重医疗状况，症状包括心跳加快、严重哮喘和呕吐。保持警觉的客舱机组立即提供协助，让患病乘客躺下，并在乘客中找到了两名医生。当患者状况迅速恶化时，飞行员决定备降Beijing。他们立即通知Beijing空中交通管制，并安排紧急着陆。由于该国际航班加注了满量燃油，飞行员在空中释放多余燃油，以符合安全程序。北京时间下午05:15，飞机安全着陆，地面医疗团队随后接手救治。此次协调行动挽救了患者的生命，并体现了有效的空中危机管理、沟通和对安全程序的遵守。

cards.audioText: On November 4, 2010, Qantas Flight 32, an Airbus A380 operated by Qantas, one of the world's largest airlines, departed from Singapore Changi Airport for a long-haul flight to Sydney. Shortly after takeoff, one engine experienced an uncontained failure, showering debris that damaged critical hydraulic systems. The cockpit was flooded with warning signals as the experienced pilots quickly assessed the situation. With remarkable composure, they isolated the malfunctioning engine and managed the cascade of system alerts while maintaining control of the massive aircraft. The crew communicated their predicament to air traffic control and secured priority landing clearance at Sydney Airport. Although passengers endured moments of turbulence and uncertainty, the calm and professional announcements reassured them. Post-flight investigations confirmed that a manufacturing defect compounded by maintenance lapses had caused the failure. Qantas Flight 32 has since become a celebrated case study in effective crew resource management and crisis resolution in modern aviation.
cards.audioTextZh: 2010年11月4日，Qantas 32航班是一架由全球最大航空公司之一Qantas运营的Airbus A380，从Singapore Changi Airport起飞，执行前往Sydney的长途飞行。起飞后不久，一台发动机发生非包容性失效，碎片飞散并损坏了关键液压系统。驾驶舱内出现大量警告信号，经验丰富的飞行员迅速评估情况。他们表现得异常镇定，在保持对这架大型飞机控制的同时，隔离了发生故障的发动机，并处理接连出现的系统警报。机组向空中交通管制通报了所面临的困境，并获得在Sydney Airport优先着陆的许可。尽管乘客经历了一段颠簸和不确定的时刻，机组冷静而专业的广播使他们安心。飞行后的调查证实，一项制造缺陷在维修疏漏的共同作用下导致了这次失效。此后，Qantas 32航班成为现代航空中有效机组资源管理和危机处置的著名案例。

cards.audioText: On July 4, 2001, China Eastern Flight 5 3 9 8 was en route from Shenzhen to Wuhan. As the aircraft approached Wuhan Tianhe Airport, it encountered a strong thunderstorm and severe wind shear. Despite poor weather, the pilots decided to proceed with landing. Just before touchdown, the aircraft suddenly lost altitude and hit the runway hard. The landing gear collapsed, and the right wing broke off, causing a fuel leak and fire. The crew initiated emergency evacuation immediately. Airport fire crews arrived within minutes and contained the fire. Of the 112 people onboard, more than 40 sustained injuries, but no fatalities occurred. The accident highlighted the dangers of wind shear and poor decision-making in stormy weather. Following the investigation, Chinese airlines implemented stricter policies regarding diversion and equipped more airports with wind shear detection systems.
cards.audioTextZh: 2001年7月4日，China Eastern 5398航班正在从Shenzhen飞往Wuhan。飞机接近Wuhan Tianhe Airport时，遭遇强雷暴和严重风切变。尽管天气恶劣，飞行员仍决定继续着陆。就在接地前，飞机突然失去高度并重重撞上跑道。起落架坍塌，右翼折断，导致燃油泄漏和起火。机组立即开始紧急撤离。机场消防人员在数分钟内到达并控制住火势。机上112人中有40多人受伤，但无人死亡。该事故突显了风切变和在暴风雨天气中错误决策的危险。调查结束后，中国各航空公司对备降实施了更严格的政策，并为更多机场配备风切变探测系统。

cards.audioText: On March 29, 2015, Air Canada Flight 624, an Airbus A320, was approaching Halifax Stanfield Airport from Toronto Pearson in heavy snow and poor visibility. As the aircraft descended into the thick weather, the pilots failed to properly monitor altitude, causing the plane to descend too early. At about 1,000 feet, the aircraft struck power lines before hitting the ground about 1.5 kilometers short of the runway. The impact damaged the landing gear and fuselage, but the pilots managed to maintain some control, skidding across the ground and coming to a stop near the runway. The crew quickly evacuated the 133 passengers and five crew members, with 25 people suffering minor injuries. An investigation found that the pilots did not follow the correct descent profile, and poor visibility, snow-covered runways, and inadequate lighting contributed to the incident. In response, Air Canada updated its approach procedures, stressing the use of instrument landing systems and better checklist protocols for low-visibility and winter operations, enhancing safety for future flights in similar conditions.
cards.audioTextZh: 2015年3月29日，Air Canada 624航班是一架Airbus A320，正从Toronto Pearson飞来，在大雪和低能见度条件下进近Halifax Stanfield Airport。飞机下降进入浓厚天气区域时，飞行员未能正确监控高度，导致飞机过早下降。飞机在约1,000英尺高度撞上电线，随后在距跑道入口约1.5公里处撞击地面。撞击损坏了起落架和机身，但飞行员仍设法保持一定程度的控制，飞机在地面滑行后停在跑道附近。机组迅速组织133名乘客和5名机组人员撤离，其中25人受轻伤。调查发现，飞行员没有遵循正确的下降剖面，低能见度、被积雪覆盖的跑道和照明不足也促成了此次事件。作为回应，Air Canada更新了进近程序，强调使用仪表着陆系统，并为低能见度和冬季运行采用更完善的检查单程序，从而提高今后类似条件下飞行的安全性。

cards.audioText: On January 17, 2008, British Airways Flight 3 8, a Boeing 7 7 7, was en route from Beijing to London Heathrow. The flight experienced problems when it began its final approach to Heathrow, and the aircraft experienced a dramatic loss of power just 1,000 feet above the runway. The engines had consumed more fuel than expected, a result of a fuel flow issue. Despite the pilots' attempts to restart the engines, the plane was forced into an emergency landing. The aircraft touched down short of the runway and skidded off the runway. Fortunately, all 136 passengers and 16 crew members survived, but several passengers were injured. The investigation revealed that ice crystals had blocked fuel flow to the engines due to a fault in the design of the fuel system. In response, British Airways and Boeing reviewed fuel management practices, and new safety measures were implemented to prevent such incidents in the future. This event highlighted the importance of thorough maintenance and the complexities of modern aircraft fuel systems.
cards.audioTextZh: 2008年1月17日，British Airways 38航班是一架Boeing 777，正在从Beijing飞往London Heathrow。航班开始对Heathrow实施最后进近时出现问题，飞机在跑道上方仅1,000英尺处突然大幅失去动力。由于燃油流动问题，发动机消耗的燃油多于预期。尽管飞行员尝试重新启动发动机，飞机仍被迫实施紧急着陆。飞机在跑道入口之前接地，随后滑行并冲出跑道。幸运的是，机上136名乘客和16名机组人员全部幸存，但数名乘客受伤。调查显示，由于燃油系统存在设计缺陷，冰晶阻塞了流向发动机的燃油。作为回应，British Airways和Boeing审查了燃油管理做法，并实施了新的安全措施，以防止今后再次发生此类事件。该事件突显了全面维修的重要性以及现代飞机燃油系统的复杂性。

cards.audioText: On August 2, 2005, Air France Flight 358, an Airbus A340, was landing at Toronto Pearson International Airport after a long-haul flight from Paris. The aircraft encountered heavy rain and poor visibility during its final approach. The pilots touched down later than intended, and the aircraft hydroplaned on the wet runway, severely reducing braking efficiency. As a result, the plane overran the runway, veered off the tarmac, and plunged down an embankment. Upon impact, the aircraft caught fire. The crew immediately initiated an emergency evacuation, and all 309 passengers and crew were safely evacuated, though 43 people suffered various injuries, mostly minor. Emergency responders arrived quickly to contain the fire. An investigation into the incident revealed that the pilots failed to execute a go-around despite unstable approach conditions and poor runway visibility. The accident led to changes in runway design to improve drainage, enhanced pilot training for landing in wet conditions, and stricter go-around policies. This incident also highlighted the critical role that well-trained flight attendants played in ensuring a swift and safe evacuation.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年8月2日，Air France 358航班是一架Airbus A340，完成从Paris出发的长途飞行后，正在Toronto Pearson International Airport着陆。飞机在最后进近过程中遭遇大雨和低能见度。飞行员的接地点晚于预期，飞机在湿滑跑道上发生滑水，严重降低了制动效能。因此，飞机冲出跑道，偏离铺装道面并冲下路堤。飞机撞击后起火。机组立即组织紧急撤离，机上全部309名乘客和机组人员均安全撤离，但有43人受到不同程度的伤害，其中大多数为轻伤。紧急救援人员迅速赶到并控制住火势。事故调查显示，尽管进近状态不稳定且跑道能见度较差，飞行员仍未执行复飞。该事故促使跑道设计发生改变，以改善排水能力，同时加强了飞行员在湿滑条件下着陆的培训，并实施了更严格的复飞政策。该事件还突显了训练有素的乘务员在确保快速、安全撤离方面发挥的关键作用。

cards.audioText: On April 17, 2018, Southwest Airlines Flight 1380, a Boeing 737-700, was en route from New York LaGuardia Airport to Dallas Love Field. About 20 minutes into the flight, a loud explosion occurred when one of the plane's engines suffered a catastrophic failure. A piece of the engine's fan blade broke off and struck the fuselage, causing a loss of cabin pressure and a hole in the side of the aircraft. The crew immediately descended to a safe altitude and declared an emergency. The aircraft turned around and made an emergency landing at Philadelphia International Airport, with fire trucks and emergency crews standing by.
