Despite the damage, the skilled crew managed a safe landing. Tragically, one passenger was killed, and several others were injured during the decompression. Investigations revealed that the engine failure was caused by metal fatigue in the fan blade. Southwest Airlines and the FAA mandated more frequent inspections of similar engines to prevent further incidents. This event highlighted the need for rigorous maintenance and the quick response required in in-flight emergencies.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年4月17日，Southwest Airlines 1380航班是一架Boeing 737-700，正在从New York LaGuardia Airport飞往Dallas Love Field。飞行约20分钟后，飞机的一台发动机发生灾难性失效，并伴随一声巨响。发动机的一块风扇叶片断裂并撞击机身，导致客舱失压，机身侧面出现一个破洞。机组立即下降至安全高度并宣布紧急情况。飞机掉头并在Philadelphia International Airport实施紧急着陆，消防车和紧急救援人员在现场待命。尽管飞机受损，技术娴熟的机组仍成功安全着陆。遗憾的是，一名乘客死亡，另有数人在失压过程中受伤。调查显示，发动机失效是由风扇叶片的金属疲劳造成的。Southwest Airlines和FAA要求对同类发动机实施更频繁的检查，以防止更多类似事件。该事件突显了严格维修的必要性，以及在空中紧急情况下迅速响应的重要性。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to loss of brakes On April 5, 2025, a Helvetic Airways Embraer ERJ 190 on behalf of Swiss International Airlines, performing flight Swiss 1674 from Zurich (Switzerland) to Florence (Italy), had been taxiing for departure holding short of Runway 28 when the crew advised they had a technical problem and needed to return to the apron. The aircraft was instructed to cross Runway 28 at the threshold and was given a taxi route. About 20 minutes later the aircraft reported on tower again ready for departure, lined up Runway 28 and began takeoff acceleration but stopped on the runway stating they were not able to vacate the runway due to the loss of brakes. The aircraft was towed off the runway. A passenger reported: " We just had a rejected takeoff at low speed, I am still on the plane. The captain announced brake issues, before takeoff I noticed that we didn't lineup on the runway but instead went to another taxiway, possibly to solve the issue. Then we made a 180, attempted the takeoff, rejected, and now we will be towed back to the gate."
cards.audioTextZh: 因刹车失效中断起飞。2025年4月5日，Helvetic Airways的一架Embraer ERJ 190代表Swiss International Airlines执行Swiss 1674航班，从Zurich（Switzerland）飞往Florence（Italy）。飞机正在滑行准备离场，并在28号跑道外等待时，机组表示出现技术问题，需要返回停机坪。飞机被指示从跑道头穿越28号跑道，并获得一条滑行路线。约20分钟后，飞机再次在塔台频率上报告准备起飞，进入28号跑道并对正后开始加速起飞，但随后停在跑道上。机组表示，由于刹车失效，飞机无法脱离跑道。飞机随后被拖离跑道。一名乘客报告：“我们刚刚在低速状态下中断了起飞，我现在仍在飞机上。机长宣布刹车出现问题。起飞前，我注意到我们没有进入跑道并对正，而是前往另一条滑行道，可能是为了解决这个问题。随后我们进行了180度转弯，尝试起飞，又中断了起飞，现在我们将被拖回登机口。”

cards.audioText: On April 16, 2025, an Air Portugal Airbus 3 20 200, performing flight Air Portugal 6 8 7 from Luxembourg (Luxembourg) to Porto (Portugal), was descending towards Porto when the crew reported smoke in the cockpit. The aircraft continued for a landing on Runway 17without further incident. The airport reported two people were taken to a hospital for smoke inhalation. Initial information by Portugal's Civil Protection had suggested a fire and smoke in the aircraft cabin requiring two people to be taken to hospital for smoke inhalation, however, the airline stated there had been no fire and no smoke in the cabin. The airline confirmed two people were treated for smoke inhalation.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年4月16日，Air Portugal的一架Airbus 320-200执行Air Portugal 687航班，从Luxembourg（Luxembourg）飞往Porto（Portugal）。飞机正在向Porto下降时，机组报告驾驶舱内有烟。飞机继续飞行并降落在17号跑道，未再发生其他事件。机场报告称，两人因吸入烟雾被送往医院。Portugal民防部门的初步信息称，飞机客舱内出现火灾和烟雾，导致两人因吸入烟雾需要被送往医院。然而，航空公司表示没有发生火灾，客舱内也没有烟雾。航空公司确认有两人因吸入烟雾接受了治疗。

cards.audioText: On April 15, 2025, a Frontier Airlines Airbus 3 2 1, performing flight Frontier 3 5 0 6 from Orlando (USA) to San Juan (Puerto Rico) with 228 people on board, touched down hard on San Juan's Runway 10 and went around. During climb out the left hand engine emitted a continuous streak of flames for several seconds. The airport subsequently closed both runways initially advising crews of arriving aircraft there was debris on the runways subsequently advising there had been a hard landing on one runway and the aircraft is now going to use the other runway, the landing runway is being inspected for debris. The aircraft subsequently entered a hold to work checklists associated with the landing gear. The aircraft positioned for a low approach to San Juan's Runway 08 about 27 minutes later and landed without further incident on Runway 08 about 40 minutes after the balked landing. The aircraft vacated the runway at the end and stopped on the parallel taxiway. Runway 08 was reopened after landing, while Runway 10remained closed for some more time.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年4月15日，Frontier Airlines的一架Airbus 321执行Frontier 3506航班，从Orlando（USA）飞往San Juan（Puerto Rico），机上共有228人。飞机在San Juan机场10号跑道重着陆后复飞。爬升过程中，左侧发动机连续数秒喷出一道火焰。机场随后关闭了两条跑道，最初通知进场航空器的机组跑道上有碎片，随后又通知其中一条跑道发生了重着陆，该飞机现在将使用另一条跑道，原着陆跑道正在接受碎片检查。随后，飞机进入等待，以执行与起落架有关的检查单。约27分钟后，飞机重新定位，对San Juan机场08号跑道实施低空进近，并在中止着陆约40分钟后降落在08号跑道，未再发生其他事件。飞机从跑道末端脱离，并停在平行滑行道上。飞机着陆后，08号跑道重新开放，而10号跑道又继续关闭了一段时间。

cards.audioText: On April 26, 2025, a British Airways Boeing 7 7 7, performing flight speedbird 2 1 6 from Washington Dulles (USA) to London Heathrow (UK) with 243 passengers and 15 crew, had departed Dulles' Runway 01R and suffered a bird strike. The crew continued the climb and was enroute at FL350 about 60nm south of Boston (USA) when the crew declared Mayday and requested to divert to Boston advising, they have had a bird strike and now had fumes in the cabin, the cockpit was okay. The fume event in the cabin was uncontrollable, an evacuation was possible, the crew thus requested emergency services to follow them. On final approach the crew advised they would stop on the runway to check the cabin environment and make a decision whether to evacuate. The aircraft landed on Boston's Runway 22L about 25 minutes after declaring Mayday. The aircraft stopped on the runway for about 5 minutes, then vacated the runway and taxied to the apron. After landing the crew reported they did have a bird strike with a large bird of prey, which impacted the underside of the aircraft, probably the air conditioning system causing fumes in the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年4月26日，British Airways的一架Boeing 777执行Speedbird 216航班，从Washington Dulles（USA）飞往London Heathrow（UK），机上有243名乘客和15名机组人员。飞机从Dulles机场01R跑道起飞后遭遇鸟击。机组继续爬升，飞机在Boston（USA）以南约60海里处以FL350飞行时，机组宣布Mayday并请求备降Boston。他们表示飞机曾遭遇鸟击，现在客舱内出现烟雾或异味，但驾驶舱情况正常。客舱内的烟雾或异味状况无法控制，可能需要撤离，因此机组请求紧急服务车辆跟随飞机。在最后进近时，机组表示飞机将在跑道上停下，以检查客舱环境并决定是否撤离。飞机在宣布Mayday约25分钟后降落在Boston机场22L跑道。飞机在跑道上停留约5分钟，随后脱离跑道并滑行至停机坪。着陆后，机组报告飞机确实与一只大型猛禽发生鸟击，该鸟撞击了飞机底部，可能撞到了空调系统并导致客舱内出现烟雾或异味。

cards.audioText: On October 18, 2023, a Fedex Federal Express Boeing 7 67-300, performing flight Fedex-541 from Memphis to Las Vegas (USA), was climbing out of Memphis' Runway 18R when the crew heard a loud bang from the left hand side and observed a fire warning for the left hand engine. The crew pulled the fire handle for the left hand engine and discharged both fire bottles and initiated a return to Memphis stopping the climb at about 3700 feet MSL. On approach back to Memphis the fire warning ceased. The aircraft landed safely on Memphis' Runway 18C about 15 minutes after departure. Attending emergency services observed no active fire but damage to the left hand engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 2023年10月18日，Fedex Federal Express的一架Boeing 767-300执行Fedex-541航班，从Memphis飞往Las Vegas（USA）。飞机从Memphis机场18R跑道起飞爬升时，机组听到左侧传来一声巨响，并观察到左侧发动机火警。机组拉出左侧发动机火警手柄，释放了两瓶灭火剂，并开始返回Memphis，在海拔约3,700英尺停止爬升。飞机返回Memphis进近时，火警消失。飞机在起飞约15分钟后安全降落在Memphis机场18C跑道。前来处置的紧急服务人员没有观察到仍在燃烧的火焰，但发现左侧发动机受损。

cards.audioText: On July 15, 2025, a British Airways Boeing 7 7 7, performing flight Speedbird 2 2 0 3 from London Gatwick (UK) to Cancun (Mexico) with 340 people on board, was climbing out of Runway 26L when the crew stopped the climb at FL1 1 0 reporting fumes on board. The aircraft entered a hold to dump fuel and returned to London Gatwick for a safe landing on Runway 26L about 55 minutes after departure. Passengers reported there was a smell of old socks making them feel dizzy, the crew even opened the cockpit side windows for fresh air.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月15日，British Airways的一架Boeing 777执行Speedbird 2203航班，从London Gatwick（UK）飞往Cancun（Mexico），机上共有340人。飞机从26L跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告机上出现烟雾或异味，并在FL110停止爬升。飞机进入等待以放油，随后返回London Gatwick，并在起飞约55分钟后安全降落在26L跑道。乘客报告称，机上有一股旧袜子的气味，让他们感到头晕，机组甚至打开了驾驶舱侧窗以获取新鲜空气。

cards.audioText: On July 18, 2025, a Delta Airlines Boeing 7 67, performing flight Delta 4 4 6 from Los Angeles to Atlanta (USA) with 224 people on board, was climbing out of Los Angeles' Runway 25R just being handed off to departure when the crew declared emergency reporting a left hand engine fire indication. Departure cleared them to maintain whatever altitude they needed, the crew chose 3000 feet. All departures from Los Angeles were halted, the next aircraft already having received takeoff clearance had their takeoff clearance cancelled and rejected takeoff. The aircraft positioned for an approach to Los Angeles' Runway 25L and landed safely, engine fire extinguished, about 15 minutes after departure. Runway 25Left was temporarily closed after landing. Emergency services inspected the aircraft, which taxied to the apron about 5 minutes after landing. Ground observers reported seeing continuous flames from the left hand engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月18日，Delta Airlines的一架Boeing 767执行Delta 446航班，从Los Angeles飞往Atlanta（USA），机上共有224人。飞机从Los Angeles机场25R跑道起飞爬升，刚被移交给离场管制时，机组宣布紧急情况并报告左侧发动机出现火警指示。离场管制许可机组保持他们所需的任意高度，机组选择3,000英尺。Los Angeles的所有离场航班均被暂停，下一架已经获得起飞许可的航空器被取消起飞许可并中断起飞。飞机重新定位进近Los Angeles机场25L跑道，并在起飞约15分钟后安全着陆，发动机火已熄灭。飞机着陆后，25L跑道暂时关闭。紧急服务人员检查了飞机，飞机在着陆约5分钟后滑行至停机坪。地面目击者报告看到左侧发动机持续喷出火焰。

cards.audioText: On July 13, 2025, a Bangkok Airways Airbus 3 1 9, performing flight 8 0 5 from Koh Samui (Thailand) to Hong Kong (China), was enroute at FL3 3 0 about 120 nautical miles eastnortheast of Bangkok (Thailand) when the crew decided to divert to Bangkok after a passenger's powerbank had caught fire. Cabin crew extinguished the fire and secured the device. The aircraft landed safely on Bangkok's Runway 19 about 30 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月13日，Bangkok Airways的一架Airbus 319执行805号航班，从Koh Samui（Thailand）飞往Hong Kong（China）。飞机在Bangkok（Thailand）东北偏东约120海里处以FL330飞行时，一名乘客的充电宝起火，机组决定备降Bangkok。客舱机组扑灭了火焰并妥善固定该设备。飞机约30分钟后安全降落在Bangkok机场19号跑道。

cards.audioText: On June 24, 2018, a Lufthansa Airbus 3 4 0, performing flight Lufthansa 4 8 9 from San Jose (USA) to Frankfurt Main (Germany), was enroute over the Atlantic Ocean in Canadian Airspace, when a powerbank in the cabin of the aircraft suffered a thermal runaway and caught fire. Cabin crew quickly extinguished the flames and cooled the device down before securing it in a safe container. The aircraft continued the flight to destination for a safe landing without further incidents. On December 19th 2018 the BFU released their June Bulletin briefly stating the occurrence is being investigated by the BFU. After about 4 hours enroute an accessory battery stored in a passenger's rucksack inflamed emitting lots of smoke. The cockpit crew donned their oxygen masks, cabin crew used halon fire extinguishers, put the fire out, cooled the battery down and kept it under surveillance for the remainder of the flight. About 30 minutes later the flight crew removed their oxygen masks and continued the flight to destination. Two passengers were treated for shock after landing in Frankfurt.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年6月24日，Lufthansa的一架Airbus 340执行Lufthansa 489航班，从San Jose（USA）飞往Frankfurt Main（Germany）。飞机在Atlantic Ocean上空、Canadian空域内飞行时，客舱内一个充电宝发生热失控并起火。客舱机组迅速扑灭火焰，将设备冷却后放入安全容器中妥善存放。飞机继续飞往目的地并安全着陆，未再发生其他事件。2018年12月19日，BFU发布6月公报，简要说明该事件正由BFU调查。飞机飞行约4小时后，一块存放在乘客背包中的配件电池起火并冒出大量烟雾。驾驶舱机组戴上氧气面罩，客舱机组使用Halon灭火器将火扑灭，冷却电池，并在剩余航程中持续监控该电池。约30分钟后，飞行机组摘下氧气面罩并继续飞往目的地。飞机在Frankfurt着陆后，两名乘客因受到惊吓而接受治疗。

cards.audioText: On July 25, 2025, A Southwest Airlines Boeing 7 37, performing flight Southwest 1 4 9 6 from Burbank, to Las Vegas (USA), was climbing through about 14100 feet out of Burbank about 11 nautical miles north of Burbank. A Military Hawker Hunter MK.5 8, from El Paso to Point Mugu (USA), was descending through 14,500 feet towards Point Mugu, when the vertical separation reduced to about 350 feet and the horizontal separation reduced to about 4 nautical miles, when both aircraft received TCAS resolution advisories prompting the Hunter to climb and the Boeing to descend. The Hunter climbed about 100 feet in response to the Resolution Advisory, the Boeing descended about 500 feet before resuming the climb. Both aircraft continued to their destinations for landings without further incident. Two flight attendants on board of the Boeing 737 received minor injuries. The FAA reported: "Southwest Airlines Flight 1 4 9 6 responded to an onboard alert that another aircraft was in the vicinity while in Los Angeles Air Route Traffic Control Center airspace. The FAA is investigating the event that occurred around 12 p.m. local time on Friday, July 25." Passengers reported they were lifted out of their seats and onto flight attendants causing injuries to two flight attendants, when the aircraft went into a sudden descent. The flight crew later came on explaining a collision warning had activated and he needed to avoid the aircraft coming at them. The airline reported the crew reacted to onboard traffic alerts, the airline is working with the FAA to understand the circumstances. Two flight attendants are being treated for injuries, none of the passengers received any injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月25日，Southwest Airlines的一架Boeing 737执行Southwest 1496航班，从Burbank飞往Las Vegas（USA）。飞机从Burbank起飞后，在Burbank以北约11海里处爬升通过约14,100英尺。一架军用Hawker Hunter MK.58正从El Paso飞往Point Mugu（USA），并在飞向Point Mugu的过程中下降通过14,500英尺。两机垂直间隔缩小至约350英尺、水平间隔缩小至约4海里时，两架航空器均收到TCAS决断咨询，促使Hunter爬升、Boeing飞机下降。Hunter根据决断咨询爬升约100英尺，Boeing飞机下降约500英尺后恢复爬升。两架航空器均继续飞往各自目的地并着陆，未再发生其他事件。Boeing 737上的两名乘务员受轻伤。FAA报告称：“Southwest Airlines 1496航班位于Los Angeles Air Route Traffic Control Center空域内时，响应了机载系统发出的附近有另一架航空器的警报。FAA正在调查这起发生在7月25日星期五当地时间中午12点左右的事件。”乘客报告称，飞机突然下降时，他们被从座位上抛起并撞到乘务员，导致两名乘务员受伤。随后，飞行机组通过广播解释称，防撞警告已经触发，他需要避让一架迎面而来的航空器。航空公司报告称，机组对机载交通警报作出了反应，航空公司正与FAA合作了解事件经过。两名乘务员正在接受伤情治疗，乘客均未受伤。

cards.audioText: On July 27, 2025, an Air Cairo Airbus 3 20, performing flight Air Cairo 5 0 1 from Cairo (Egypt) to Sharjah (United Arab Emirates), was enroute at FL3 3 0 about 280 nautical miles east of Cairo when the crew initiated an emergency descent to FL1 2 0 due to the loss of cabin pressure. The aircraft returned to Cairo for a safe landing about 1 hour and 55 minutes after departure. According to information The Aviation Herald received the aircraft had been dispatched under minimum equipment list requirements with engine #2 bleed inoperative. In flight engine #1 bleed failed, too, the APU could not be used above FL2 0 0, hence cabin pressure was lost prompting the crew to don their oxygen masks and initiate an emergency descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月27日，Air Cairo的一架Airbus 320执行Air Cairo 501航班，从Cairo（Egypt）飞往Sharjah（United Arab Emirates）。飞机在Cairo以东约280海里处以FL330飞行时，机组因客舱失压开始紧急下降至FL120。飞机返回Cairo，并在起飞约1小时55分钟后安全着陆。根据The Aviation Herald收到的信息，该飞机依据最低设备清单要求放行，当时2号发动机引气系统不工作。飞行中，1号发动机引气系统也发生故障，而APU无法在FL200以上使用，因此客舱失压，机组戴上氧气面罩并开始紧急下降。

cards.audioText: On June 16, 2022, a Lufthansa Cityline CRJ 900, performing flight Lufthansa1 3 7 2 from Frankfurt Main (Germany) to Wroclaw (Poland), was descending towards Wroclaw when the crew stopped the descent at FL1 0 0 reporting they had a spoiler problem and needed a longer runway. The crew decided to divert to Warsaw, climbed to FL1 3 0 and landed safely on Runway 15 about 45 minutes after aborting the approach to Wroclaw. A passenger reported the aircraft had already been swapped before departure and was delayed by about 90 minutes as a result. The crew announced they needed to divert to Warsaw due to problems with the brakes (the passenger said, it remained unclear in the context whether the wheel brakes or speed brakes), on landing in Warsaw they were told to assume the brace position.
cards.audioTextZh: 2022年6月16日，Lufthansa Cityline的一架CRJ 900执行Lufthansa 1372航班，从Frankfurt Main（Germany）飞往Wroclaw（Poland）。飞机正在向Wroclaw下降时，机组报告扰流板出现问题，需要一条更长的跑道，并在FL100停止下降。机组决定备降Warsaw，爬升至FL130，并在中止进近Wroclaw约45分钟后安全降落在15号跑道。一名乘客报告称，飞机在起飞前已经更换，因此延误了约90分钟。机组宣布，由于刹车出现问题，他们需要备降Warsaw。该乘客表示，结合当时情况，所指的是机轮刹车还是减速板仍不明确。飞机在Warsaw着陆时，乘客被告知采取防冲击姿势。

cards.audioText: On May 24, 2024, an Iran Air Fokker 100, performing flight Iran Air 4 5 5 from Tehran Mehrabad to Tabriz (Iran) with 101 passengers and 9 crew, was enroute at FL3 0 0 about 100 nautical miles before Tabriz when the aircraft was struck by lightning about 10 nautical miles from a thunderstorm cell, which caused the loss of AC Essential Bus which lost further systems like weather radar, transponder, TCAS, captain side instruments and loss of automatic cabin pressure control. The captain handed aircraft control to the first officer, cabin pressure was maintained in manual control. Due to the weather at Tabriz the crew decided to return to Tehran, however, the cabin altitude began to climb at 2000 feet per minute and could no longer be controlled prompting the crew to perform an emergency descent and divert to Ardabil (Iran). Ardabil at that time was not operational and was made operational due to the emergency. After entering a hold waiting for the airport staff to arrive the aircraft landed on Ardabil's Runway 15without further incident.
cards.audioTextZh: 2024年5月24日，Iran Air的一架Fokker 100执行Iran Air 455航班，从Tehran Mehrabad飞往Tabriz（Iran），机上有101名乘客和9名机组人员。飞机在距Tabriz约100海里处以FL300飞行时，于距一处雷暴单体约10海里的位置遭到雷击，导致AC Essential Bus失效，并进一步造成气象雷达、应答机、TCAS、机长侧仪表等系统失效，同时自动客舱压力控制功能丧失。机长将飞机操纵权交给副驾驶，客舱压力通过人工控制维持。由于Tabriz的天气状况，机组决定返回Tehran。然而，客舱高度开始以每分钟2,000英尺的速度上升，并且无法再受控制，促使机组实施紧急下降并备降Ardabil（Iran）。Ardabil当时并未运行，但因这次紧急情况而恢复运行。飞机进入等待，等候机场工作人员到达，随后降落在Ardabil机场15号跑道，未再发生其他事件。

cards.audioText: On July 27, 2025, a Scandinavian Airlines Airbus 3 3 0, performing flight Scandinavian 9 1 0 from Newark (USA) to Copenhagen (Denmark), was enroute at FL4 0 0 about 170 nautical miles northwest of Edinburgh (UK) when the crew declared emergency and diverted to Edinburgh due to the failure of another electrical generator, so that only one (main) generator remained online. The aircraft landed safely on Edinburgh's Runway 24 about 35 minutes later. A passenger reported the crew announced in Newark, that they had problems with the APU. In flight the crew announced that two of the four generators on board had failed prompting the diversion to Edinburgh. The Airbus 3 3 0 has one engine driven generator (I D G) per engine, the APU, a backup hydraulic emergency generator and the RAM Air Turbine (R A T).
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月27日，Scandinavian Airlines的一架Airbus 330执行Scandinavian 910航班，从Newark（USA）飞往Copenhagen（Denmark）。飞机在Edinburgh（UK）西北约170海里处以FL400飞行时，由于另一台发电机失效、只剩一台主发电机在线，机组宣布紧急情况并备降Edinburgh。飞机约35分钟后安全降落在Edinburgh机场24号跑道。一名乘客报告称，机组在Newark宣布APU存在问题。飞行中，机组宣布机上四台发电机中有两台失效，因此备降Edinburgh。Airbus 330每台发动机各有一台发动机驱动发电机（IDG），此外还有APU、一台备用液压应急发电机和冲压空气涡轮（RAT）。

cards.audioText: On July 30, 2025, a Delta Airlines Airbus 3 30, performing flight Delta 5 6 from Salt Lake City (USA) to Amsterdam (Netherlands) with 262 passengers and 13 crew, was enroute at FL3 7 0 about 200 nautical miles west of Minneapolis (USA) when the crew decided to divert to Minneapolis after the aircraft had encountered severe turbulence causing 25 injuries on board. The aircraft landed on Minneapolis' Runway 12R about 35 minutes later. The airline reported 25 people were taken to hospitals. Passengers reported they were told one of the flight attendants had suffered a broken rib, another person a fractured leg. The trolleys had been lifted and impacted the cabin ceiling and fell to the floor several times, passengers not wearing their seat belts also hit the cabin ceiling. The crew announced they had lost more than 1000 feet of altitude, they hadn't seen such severe turbulence ever before. According to radar data the aircraft encountered altitude deviations from FL3 7 0 up to FL3 7 6 and down to FL3 6 0 about 80 nautical miles southwest of Casper (USA) about 55 minutes prior to leaving FL3 7 0 for the diversion to Minneapolis.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月30日，Delta Airlines的一架Airbus 330执行Delta 56航班，从Salt Lake City（USA）飞往Amsterdam（Netherlands），机上有262名乘客和13名机组人员。飞机在Minneapolis（USA）以西约200海里处以FL370飞行时，遭遇严重颠簸并造成机上25人受伤，机组决定备降Minneapolis。飞机约35分钟后降落在Minneapolis机场12R跑道。航空公司报告称，25人被送往医院。乘客报告称，他们获悉一名乘务员肋骨骨折，另有一人腿部骨折。餐车被抛起撞到客舱顶部，又多次落回地板，没有系安全带的乘客也撞到了客舱顶部。机组宣布飞机曾损失超过1,000英尺高度，他们以前从未遇到过如此严重的颠簸。根据雷达数据，飞机在Casper（USA）西南约80海里处出现高度偏差，从FL370最高偏至FL376、最低偏至FL360；该情况发生在飞机为备降Minneapolis而离开FL370之前约55分钟。

cards.audioText: On August 3, 2025, a United Boeing 7 87, performing flight United 1 1 2 2 from Newark (USA) to Cape Town (South Africa), was enroute at FL3 3 0 over the Atlantic Ocean about 250 nautical miles eastsoutheast of Newark when the crew reported they had a spoiler problem and requested to return to Newark. The aircraft dumped fuel on the way back. On approach the crew advised they needed to fly 260 knots and would be able to reduce to 185 knots later. The aircraft landed safely on Newark's Runway 22R at a higher than normal speed (about 180 knots over ground) about 100 minutes after departure. A passenger reported about 30 minutes into the flight there were noticeable vibrations. The captain announced they had lost part of a wing, they worked all the checklists and were returning to Newark.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月3日，United的一架Boeing 787执行United 1122航班，从Newark（USA）飞往Cape Town（South Africa）。飞机在Atlantic Ocean上空、Newark东南偏东约250海里处以FL330飞行时，机组报告扰流板出现问题并请求返回Newark。飞机在返航途中放油。进近时，机组表示需要以260节飞行，随后可以将速度减至185节。飞机以高于正常的速度安全降落在Newark机场22R跑道，着陆地速约为180节，距起飞约100分钟。一名乘客报告称，飞行约30分钟后出现明显振动。机长宣布飞机失去了机翼的一部分，机组执行了全部检查单，正在返回Newark。

cards.audioText: On July 31, 2025, a LATAM Boeing 7 8 7, performing flight 6 0 3 from Los Angeles (USA) to Santiago de Chile (Chile), was climbing out of Los Angeles' Runway 25R when ATC cleared the crew to climb to FL2 3 0 and maintain 2 8 0 knots or greater. The crew requested to level off at FL2 3 0 confirming this would be their final level. ATC queried whether everything was okay, the crew hesitated a moment then said yes. The crew subsequently requested to lower their speed to 2 5 0 knots. Upon second query by the controller the crew stated that they had the R A T deployed. Upon further query by ATC whether they wanted to return the crew indicated a return to Los Angeles. The aircraft dumped fuel and returned to Los Angeles for an ILS approach to and safe landing on Runway 25L about 75 minutes after departure. After landing the crew advised they did not need any assistance and wanted to taxi to their gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年7月31日，LATAM的一架Boeing 787执行603号航班，从Los Angeles（USA）飞往Santiago de Chile（Chile）。飞机从Los Angeles机场25R跑道起飞爬升时，空中交通管制许可机组爬升至FL230，并保持280节或更高速度。机组请求在FL230改平，并确认这将是他们的最终高度层。空中交通管制询问一切是否正常，机组犹豫片刻后回答正常。随后，机组请求将速度降低至250节。管制员第二次询问后，机组表示冲压空气涡轮（RAT）已经放出。空中交通管制进一步询问机组是否希望返航，机组表示将返回Los Angeles。飞机放油后返回Los Angeles，实施ILS进近，并在起飞约75分钟后安全降落在25L跑道。着陆后，机组表示不需要任何援助，希望滑行至登机口。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is Lufthansa 1372, while descending towards Wroclaw, you had spoiler problem, you stopped descent at FL100, tell Wroclaw approach you need a longer runway and divert to Warsaw.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Lufthansa 1372。你在向Wroclaw下降时遇到扰流板问题，并在FL100停止下降。请告知Wroclaw进近管制，你需要一条更长的跑道并将备降Warsaw。

cards.audioText: On August 28, 2024, a China Eastern Boeing 7 7 7, performing flight China Eastern 5 6 5 from Shanghai Pudong (China) to Singapore (Singapore) with 220 people on board, was on final approach to Singapore's Runway 20R and was instructed to continue the approach. The preceding aircraft had landed on Runway 20R but had not yet vacated the runway. Assuming that the aircraft would vacate the runway in time, tower cleared the Boeing 7 7 7 to land on Runway 20R. However, the preceding aircraft did not manage to vacate the runway in time. Tower therefore instructed the Boeing 7 7 7 to go around when the aircraft was at 76 feet AGL and about 296 meters ahead of the runway threshold, however, the crew did not respond and continued the landing. When the Boeing 7 7 7 touched down, tower assessed that the tail of the preceding aircraft had already cleared the runway edge line, so that a go around instruction was no longer needed.
cards.audioTextZh: 2024年8月28日，China Eastern的一架Boeing 777执行China Eastern 565航班，从Shanghai Pudong（China）飞往Singapore（Singapore），机上共有220人。飞机正在对Singapore机场20R跑道实施最后进近，并被指示继续进近。前一架航空器已经降落在20R跑道，但尚未脱离跑道。塔台认为该航空器能够及时脱离跑道，因此许可Boeing 777在20R跑道着陆。然而，前一架航空器未能及时脱离跑道。因此，当Boeing 777位于离地76英尺、距跑道入口约296米处时，塔台指示其复飞，但机组没有回应并继续着陆。Boeing 777接地时，塔台判断前一架航空器的尾部已经越过跑道边缘线，因此不再需要复飞指令。

cards.audioText: backup air conditioning system failure On August 11, 2025, a Hawaiian Airlines Airbus 3 2 1, performing flight Hawaiian 5 9 from Sacramento to Kahului (USA), was enroute at FL3 0 0 over the Pacific Ocean about 420 nautical miles westsouthwest of Oakland (USA) when the crew decided to turn around and divert to Oakland. The aircraft descended to FL2 2 0 and landed safely on Oakland's Runway 30 about 2 hours 15 minutes after departure. The airline reported the aircraft developed an issue with the backup air conditioning system, which is required for ETOPS operations more than 3 hours away from the nearest airport. While a replacement aircraft was dispatched to Oakland, the flight crew timed out, the flight was postponed to the next day as flight Hawaiian 1 0 5 9.
cards.audioTextZh: 备用空调系统故障。2025年8月11日，Hawaiian Airlines的一架Airbus 321执行Hawaiian 59航班，从Sacramento飞往Kahului（USA）。飞机在Pacific Ocean上空、Oakland（USA）西南偏西约420海里处以FL300飞行时，机组决定掉头并备降Oakland。飞机下降至FL220，并在起飞约2小时15分钟后安全降落在Oakland机场30号跑道。航空公司报告称，飞机的备用空调系统出现问题。对于距离最近机场超过3小时的ETOPS运行，该系统必须可用。虽然一架替代飞机被调往Oakland，但飞行机组的执勤时间已经超限，因此该航班被推迟至次日，并改为Hawaiian 1059航班。

cards.audioText: flaps up landing On August 13, 2025, a Southwest Airlines Boeing 7 3 7, performing flight Southwest 2 1 5 0 from Houston Hobby to Columbus (USA) with 116 people on board, was descending towards Columbus when the crew advised of a flight control problem, the flaps didn't come down so that they would need to do a flaps up landing at 170 knots. The crew requested an extended downwind to complete checklists, then positioned for an approach to Runway 28L and landed at a higher speed than normal. Emergency services checked the aircraft before the aircraft taxied to the apron. A passenger reported they were told the aircraft needed to do a high speed landing due to flaps problems.
cards.audioTextZh: 襟翼收上状态着陆。2025年8月13日，Southwest Airlines的一架Boeing 737执行Southwest 2150航班，从Houston Hobby飞往Columbus（USA），机上共有116人。飞机正在向Columbus下降时，机组报告飞行操纵系统出现问题，襟翼无法放下，因此需要以170节实施襟翼收上状态着陆。机组请求延长三边，以完成检查单，随后重新定位进近28L跑道，并以高于正常的速度着陆。紧急服务人员检查飞机后，飞机滑行至停机坪。一名乘客报告称，他们被告知飞机因襟翼问题需要实施高速着陆。

cards.audioText: hydraulic problems, flaps did not retract On August 17, 2025, an American Airlines Boeing 737-800, performing flight American 1292 from Los Angeles to Nashville (USA) with 172 people on board, was climbing out of Los Angeles' Runway 25R when the crew requested to level off at 16000 feet to run some checklists advising ATC they needed to maintain 230 knots. The aircraft entered a hold advising ATC they had hydraulic problems, the flaps had not retracted. After the hold the crew requested a long final to Runway 25R and emergency services on standby, they might have a hot brake situation, the crew declared emergency. The aircraft landed on Runway 25R at a higher than normal speed (about 182 knots over ground) about 80 minutes after departure, vacated the runway and stopped for a brief check by emergency services before taxiing to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 液压系统出现问题，襟翼未能收回。2025年8月17日，American Airlines的一架Boeing 737-800执行American 1292航班，从Los Angeles飞往Nashville（USA），机上共有172人。飞机从Los Angeles机场25R跑道起飞爬升时，机组请求在16,000英尺改平以执行一些检查单，并告知空中交通管制，他们需要保持230节。飞机进入等待，并告知空中交通管制液压系统出现问题，襟翼未能收回。结束等待后，机组请求对25R跑道实施长五边进近，并要求紧急服务人员待命，因为刹车可能过热。机组宣布紧急情况。飞机在起飞约80分钟后以高于正常的速度降落在25R跑道，着陆地速约为182节。飞机脱离跑道并停下，接受紧急服务人员的简短检查后滑行至停机坪。

cards.audioText: bird strike On August 21, 2025, a Jin Air Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight Jin Air 1 1 5 from Busan (South Korea) to Nha Trang (Vietnam) with 150 passengers and 6 crew, was climbing out of Busan's Runway 36R when the crew stopped the climb at 6000 feet reporting a bird strike into the right hand engine and entered a hold. The crew subsequently decided to divert to Seoul (South Korea), the aircraft climbed to FL1 8 0 and landed safely on Seoul Incheon's Runway 33L about 2 hours 10 minutes after departure. The airline reported due to night curfew at Busan and the availability of a replacement aircraft in Seoul the crew decided to divert to Seoul.
cards.audioTextZh: 鸟击。2025年8月21日，Jin Air的一架Boeing 737-800执行Jin Air 115航班，从Busan（South Korea）飞往Nha Trang（Vietnam），机上有150名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机从Busan机场36R跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告右侧发动机遭遇鸟击，在6,000英尺停止爬升并进入等待。随后，机组决定备降Seoul（South Korea）。飞机爬升至FL180，并在起飞约2小时10分钟后安全降落在Seoul Incheon机场33L跑道。航空公司报告称，由于Busan实施夜间宵禁，且Seoul有替代飞机可用，机组决定备降Seoul。

cards.audioText: On August 27, 2025, an American Airlines Boeing 7 37 8 MAX, performing flight American 3 8 4 from Montego Bay (Jamaica) to Miami (USA), was climbing out of Montego Bay's Runway 07 when the aircraft flew through a flock of birds. The crew stopped the climb at about 5000 feet and decided to divert to Kingston (Jamaica) climbing to 14000 feet enroute. The aircraft landed on Kingston's Runway 12 about 45 minutes after departure. A passenger reported the aircraft hit a flock of small birds right after rotation, smell developed on board. The crew diverted to Kingston due to the winds at Montego Bay. There was no damage visible to the aircraft. A replacement flight delivered them to Miami with a delay of about 8 hours.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月27日，American Airlines的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX执行American 384航班，从Montego Bay（Jamaica）飞往Miami（USA）。飞机从Montego Bay机场07号跑道起飞爬升时穿过一群鸟。机组在约5,000英尺停止爬升，并决定备降Kingston（Jamaica），途中爬升至14,000英尺。飞机在起飞约45分钟后降落在Kingston机场12号跑道。一名乘客报告称，飞机刚抬轮后就撞上一群小鸟，机上随后出现异味。由于Montego Bay的风况，机组备降Kingston。飞机没有可见损坏。一架替代航班将乘客送往Miami，延误约8小时。

cards.audioText: On August 29, 2025, a Delta Airlines Boeing 7 1 7, 200, performing flight Delta 1 7 0 8 from Huntsville to Atlanta (USA), was accelerating for takeoff from Huntsville's Runway 18R when the crew rejected takeoff at low speed and advised ATC they needed emergency services due to smoke. The aircraft vacated the runway at the first exit about 380 meters down the runway and stopped clear of the runway. The crew inquired whether emergency services were seeing anything from the left hand engine, emergency services they were not seeing anything unusual from either engine. About 10 minutes later the aircraft taxied to the apron with emergency services in trail, the crew suggested the airport might sweep the runway as a precaution.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月29日，Delta Airlines的一架Boeing 717-200执行Delta 1708航班，从Huntsville飞往Atlanta（USA）。飞机正在Huntsville机场18R跑道加速起飞时，机组在低速状态下中断起飞，并告知空中交通管制由于出现烟雾，他们需要紧急服务人员。飞机从距跑道起点约380米处的第一个出口脱离跑道，并在跑道外停下。机组询问紧急服务人员是否看到左侧发动机有任何异常，紧急服务人员回答没有看到任何一台发动机存在异常。约10分钟后，飞机在紧急服务车辆跟随下滑行至停机坪。机组建议机场出于谨慎考虑清扫跑道。

cards.audioText: flight control problem On September 6, 2025, an A S L Airlines Belgium Boeing 7 37 400 freighter, performing flight 2 7 9 Papa from Helsinki (Finland) to Shannon (Ireland), was climbing out of Helsinki's Runway 04R when the crew reported a flight control problem and stopped the climb at FL1 0 0. The aircraft returned to Helsinki for an approach to Runway 04L and was on final approach when the crew requested to hold for about 10 minutes, climbed back to 5000 feet and entered a hold. The aircraft subsequently positioned for another approach to Runway 04L left and landed without further incident about 40 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行操纵问题。2025年9月6日，ASL Airlines Belgium的一架Boeing 737-400货机执行279 Papa航班，从Helsinki（Finland）飞往Shannon（Ireland）。飞机从Helsinki机场04R跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告飞行操纵系统出现问题，并在FL100停止爬升。飞机返回Helsinki，准备进近04L跑道。飞机进入最后进近后，机组请求等待约10分钟，随后重新爬升至5,000英尺并进入等待。之后，飞机重新定位，再次进近04L跑道，并在起飞约40分钟后着陆，未再发生其他事件。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff On September 8, 2025, an Easyjet Europe Airbus 3 20 200, performing flight Easyjet 7 2 7 2 from Basel Mulhouse (Switzerland/France) to Palma Mallorca (Spain), lined up Basel's Runway 15 at 0 8 0 9 Zulu. The aircraft commenced takeoff at 0 8 1 1 Zulu but needed to reject takeoff at high speed (about 112 knots over ground). When Easyjet 7 2 7 2 crossed the hold short line to line up the runway, an arriving Easyjet Airbus 3 20 200, performing flight Easyjet 1 2 1 2 from Budapest (Hungary) to Basel/Mulhouse (Switzerland/France), was on final approach to Basel's Runway 15 about 6 nautical miles before the runway threshold descending through 1940 feet AGL. When Easyjet 7 2 7 2 began to accelerate, Easyjet 1 2 1 2 was about 1 nautical miles ahead of the runway threshold descending through about 370 feet AGL, shortly afterwards the crew initiated a go around at about 350 feet AGL. Easyjet 7 2 7 2 rejected takeoff about 5 seconds later. The airline reported the captain of Easyjet 7 2 7 2 performed a routine takeoff procedure, however, needed to reject takeoff on ATC instruction and returned to the apron. Passengers of Easyjet 7 2 7 2 reported their crew told them they needed to reject takeoff due to an arriving aircraft that came too close. Their aircraft was able to depart later and reached Palma with a delay of about one hour. Easyjet 7 2 7 2 returned to the hold short line and departed Runway 15 about 25 minutes after the rejected takeoff and reached Palma with a delay of about 30 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 中断起飞。2025年9月8日，Easyjet Europe的一架Airbus 320-200执行Easyjet 7272航班，从Basel Mulhouse（Switzerland/France）飞往Palma Mallorca（Spain）。飞机于Zulu时间08:09进入Basel机场15号跑道并对正。飞机于Zulu时间08:11开始起飞，但随后不得不在高速状态下中断起飞，当时地速约为112节。当Easyjet 7272越过跑道等待线进入跑道并对正时，一架执行Easyjet 1212航班、从Budapest（Hungary）飞往Basel/Mulhouse（Switzerland/France）的Easyjet Airbus 320-200正在对Basel机场15号跑道实施最后进近，位于跑道入口前约6海里处并下降通过离地1,940英尺。当Easyjet 7272开始加速时，Easyjet 1212位于跑道入口前约1海里处并下降通过离地约370英尺。不久后，该机机组在离地约350英尺处开始复飞。约5秒后，Easyjet 7272中断起飞。航空公司报告称，Easyjet 7272的机长按照正常程序实施起飞，但随后根据空中交通管制指令中断起飞并返回停机坪。Easyjet 7272的乘客报告称，机组告诉他们，由于一架进场航空器距离过近，飞机需要中断起飞。他们的飞机后来得以起飞，并延误约一小时抵达Palma。Easyjet 7272返回跑道等待线，并在中断起飞约25分钟后从15号跑道起飞，抵达Palma时延误约30分钟。

cards.audioText: On September 10, 2024, an Air China Airbus 320, registration Bravo tree zero five Juliett performing flight Air China four zero tree from Chengdu (China) to Singapore (Singapore) with 146 passengers and 9 crew, was descending towards Singapore when the crew declared emergency reporting they had received a forward cargo hold as well as a lavatory smoke indication. Smoke developed in the cabin. The aircraft landed on Singapore's Runway 20L and stopped on the runway. The aircraft was evacuated via all slides (including the left hand overwing slides). 9 people received minor injuries. Emergency services extinguished a left hand engine fire.
cards.audioTextZh: 2024年9月10日，Air China的一架Airbus 320注册号为B305J，执行Air China 403航班，从Chengdu（China）飞往Singapore（Singapore），机上有146名乘客和9名机组人员。飞机正在向Singapore下降时，机组宣布紧急情况，并报告收到前货舱烟雾指示和卫生间烟雾指示。客舱内出现烟雾。飞机降落在Singapore机场20L跑道并停在跑道上。机上人员通过全部滑梯撤离，其中包括左侧翼上滑梯。9人受轻伤。紧急服务人员扑灭了左侧发动机的火。

cards.audioText: engine vibrations On September 26, 2025, an Eurowings Europe Malta Airbus 3 20-200, registration niner hotel-Echo Uniform Papa performing flight Eurowings 4 3 8 2 from Salzburg (Austria) to Kos (Greece), was climbing out of Salzburg's Runway 33 when the crew reported they had engine vibrations, would not continue the departure and requested to enter a hold. The vibrations started already on the runway before becoming airborne, hence the next departure should not immediately depart. The aircraft entered a hold while the crew was working the related checklists, a runway inspection did not find any debris on the runway. The crew advised their left hand engine was vibrating but was kept running, a normal landing back to Salzburg would occur. The aircraft landed safely back on Runway 15 about 25 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机振动。2025年9月26日，Eurowings Europe Malta的一架Airbus 320-200注册号为9H-EUP，执行Eurowings 4382航班，从Salzburg（Austria）飞往Kos（Greece）。飞机从Salzburg机场33号跑道起飞爬升时，机组报告发动机发生振动，不会继续离场，并请求进入等待。振动在飞机尚未离地、仍位于跑道上时就已经开始，因此下一架离场航空器不应立即起飞。飞机进入等待，机组执行相关检查单；跑道检查没有发现任何碎片。机组表示左侧发动机正在振动，但仍保持运转，飞机将正常返回Salzburg着陆。飞机在起飞约25分钟后安全返回并降落在15号跑道。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to runway incursion On September 28, 2025, an American Airlines Airbus 3 21 200, registration November 1 1 0 Alpha November performing flight American 2 4 5 3 from Los Angeles to Boston (USA), was accelerating for takeoff from Los Angeles' Runway 25R when the crew rejected takeoff at high speed (about 140 knots over ground) due to a runway incursion. The aircraft slowed safely and returned to the apron. An Aerologic Boeing 7 7 7 200 freighter, registration Delta -Alpha Alpha Lima Lima performing flight Aerologic 6 1 9 from Shanghai (China) to Los Angeles (USA), had just landed on Los Angeles's Runway 25L (on Sep 28th 2025 after crossing the date line) and was crossing Runway 25R near the end of the runway without authorization prompting the American Airbus 3 2 1 to reject takeoff. The FAA reported: "AeroLogic Flight 6 1 9 crossed a runway at Los Angeles International Airport without authorization as American Airlines Flight 2 4 5 3 was taking off. Air traffic control instructed the American crew to cancel their takeoff. The event happened around 10: 35 p.m. local time on Sunday, Sept. 28. The closest proximity of the two aircraft was approximately 5,200 feet."
cards.audioTextZh: 因跑道侵入中断起飞。2025年9月28日，American Airlines的一架Airbus 321-200注册号为N110AN，执行American 2453航班，从Los Angeles飞往Boston（USA）。飞机正在Los Angeles机场25R跑道加速起飞时，机组因跑道侵入在高速状态下中断起飞，当时地速约为140节。飞机安全减速并返回停机坪。Aerologic的一架Boeing 777-200货机注册号为D-AALL，执行Aerologic 619航班，从Shanghai（China）飞往Los Angeles（USA）。该机刚刚在Los Angeles机场25L跑道着陆，即跨越日期变更线后的2025年9月28日，随后未经许可在跑道末端附近穿越25R跑道，促使American的Airbus 321中断起飞。FAA报告称：“AeroLogic 619航班未经许可穿越Los Angeles International Airport的一条跑道，当时American Airlines 2453航班正在起飞。空中交通管制指示American机组取消起飞。该事件发生在9月28日星期日当地时间晚上10:35左右。两架航空器之间的最近距离约为5,200英尺。”

cards.audioText: landed below minimum fuel On October 3, 2025, a Malta Air Boeing 7 37 800 on behalf of Ryanair, registration niner Hotel-Quebec Bravo Delta performing flight Ryanair 3 4 1 8 from Pisa (Italy) to Prestwick (UK), was on final approach to Prestwick's Runway 20 when the crew went around due to weather. The aircraft entered a hold, then attempted a second approach to Runway 20 about 30 minutes after the go around, but again needed to go around. The aircraft again entered a hold, about 10 minutes after entering the hold the crew decided to divert to Edinburgh (UK) where the aircraft joined the final approach to Runway 24 about one hour after the first go around but again went around. The aircraft subsequently diverted to Manchester (UK) where the aircraft landed on Runway 23R about 110 minutes after the first go around. On Oct 5th 2025, the Aviation Herald received information that the aircraft landed below minimum fuel with just 220 kilograms fuel (total, 100 kilograms in left and 120 kilograms in right tank) remaining.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆时燃油低于最低标准。2025年10月3日，Malta Air的一架Boeing 737-800代表Ryanair运营，注册号为9H-QBD，执行Ryanair 3418航班，从Pisa（Italy）飞往Prestwick（UK）。飞机正在对Prestwick机场20号跑道实施最后进近时，机组因天气原因复飞。飞机进入等待，并在复飞约30分钟后第二次尝试进近20号跑道，但又一次需要复飞。飞机再次进入等待。进入等待约10分钟后，机组决定备降Edinburgh（UK）。飞机在第一次复飞约一小时后加入Edinburgh机场24号跑道最后进近，但再次复飞。随后飞机备降Manchester（UK），并在第一次复飞约110分钟后降落在23R跑道。2025年10月5日，The Aviation Herald收到信息称，飞机着陆时燃油低于最低标准，仅剩220公斤燃油，其中左侧油箱100公斤、右侧油箱120公斤。

cards.audioText: On October 6, 2025, a Cityjet Canadair CRJ-900 on behalf of Scandinavian Airlines, registration Echo India-Hotel Sierra Echo performing flight Scandinavian1 6 8 4 from Milan Malpensa (Italy) to Copenhagen (Denmark) with 91 people on board, was enroute at FL3 4 0 about 20 nautical miles east of Zurich (Switzerland) when the crew declared Mayday, Mayday, Mayday reporting smoke in the cabin and requested an emergency descent. ATC cleared them to FL2 5 0 maintaining present heading at first. The aircraft subsequently positioned for an approach to Zurich's Runway 16 and landed safely on that runway about 20 minutes after leaving FL3 4 0. The crew vacated the runway and stopped on the taxiway requested emergency service to check for any smoke visible on the outside of the aircraft. The crew advised that everything looked okay in the inside of the aircraft, and the aircraft taxied to the apron about 3 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年10月6日，Cityjet的一架Canadair CRJ-900代表Scandinavian Airlines运营，注册号为EI-HSE，执行Scandinavian 1684航班，从Milan Malpensa（Italy）飞往Copenhagen（Denmark），机上共有91人。飞机在Zurich（Switzerland）以东约20海里处以FL340飞行时，机组宣布“Mayday，Mayday，Mayday”，报告客舱内有烟并请求紧急下降。空中交通管制最初许可飞机保持当前航向下降至FL250。随后，飞机重新定位进近Zurich机场16号跑道，并在离开FL340约20分钟后安全降落在该跑道。机组脱离跑道并停在滑行道上，请求紧急服务人员检查飞机外部是否能看到烟雾。机组表示飞机内部看起来一切正常，飞机约3分钟后滑行至停机坪。

cards.audioText: passenger battery thermal runaway On October 9, 2025, an All Nippon Airways Boeing 7 87-10, registration Juliett Alpha 9 8 1 Alpha performing flight all nippon 9 9 4 from Okinawa to Tokyo Haneda (Japan), was climbing out of Okinawa when a passenger's power bank placed in his carry on luggage under the seat in front of him began to emit smoke. Cabin crew extinguished the fire and secured the device. The flight crew continued the flight to Tokyo where the aircraft landed without further incident about 2 hours fifteen minutes after departure. The airline reported the Lithium Ion power bank of a passenger caught fire shortly after takeoff, cabin crew secured the device, the flight crew decided to continue to destination as the fire had been extinguished. Japan's Ministry of Transport reported a portable battery by a passenger caught fire at high altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘客电池热失控。2025年10月9日，All Nippon Airways的一架Boeing 787-10注册号为JA981A，执行All Nippon 994航班，从Okinawa飞往Tokyo Haneda（Japan）。飞机从Okinawa起飞爬升时，一名乘客放在随身行李中的充电宝开始冒烟，该行李位于其前方座椅下。客舱机组扑灭了火焰并妥善固定该设备。飞行机组继续飞往Tokyo，飞机在起飞约2小时15分钟后着陆，未再发生其他事件。航空公司报告称，一名乘客的锂离子充电宝在起飞后不久起火，客舱机组妥善固定了该设备；由于火已扑灭，飞行机组决定继续飞往目的地。Japan交通运输部门报告称，一名乘客的便携式电池在高空起火。

cards.audioText: toxic fumes on the aircraft On October 13, 2025, an American Airlines Airbus 3 21-200, registration November 5 8 7 Uniform Whiskey performing flight American 2 7 4 from Los Angeles to New York JFK (USA), was climbing out of Los Angeles' Runway 25R when the crew stopped the climb at 5000 feet requesting to return to Los Angeles, subsequently the crew donned their oxygen masks and advised ATC they had "toxic fumes on the aircraft". The aircraft returned to Los Angeles for a landing on Runway 25L without further incident about 15 minutes after departure. Seven passengers reported feeling sick and with bad taste in their mouths, they were assessed by medical stuff at the airport. Nobody was taken to a hospital.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机上出现有毒烟雾或异味。2025年10月13日，American Airlines的一架Airbus 321-200注册号为N587UW，执行American 274航班，从Los Angeles飞往New York JFK（USA）。飞机从Los Angeles机场25R跑道起飞爬升时，机组在5,000英尺停止爬升并请求返回Los Angeles。随后机组戴上氧气面罩，并告知空中交通管制，飞机上出现“有毒烟雾或异味”。飞机返回Los Angeles，并在起飞约15分钟后降落在25L跑道，未再发生其他事件。7名乘客报告感到不适且口中有难闻的味道，他们在机场接受了医务人员的评估。无人被送往医院。

cards.audioText: On October 18, 2025, an Air China Airbus 3 21-200, registration Bravo-8 5 8 3 performing flight Air China 1 3 9 from Hangzhou (China) to Seoul (South Korea), was enroute at FL3 3 0 over the East China Sea about 120 nautical miles east of Shanghai (China) when a passenger's Lithium Battery stored in the overhead locker overheated and burst ablaze. While cabin crew doused the fire and contained the device, flight crew turned the aircraft around to divert to Shanghai Pudong (China). The aircraft landed without further incident on Pudong's Runway 34L about 40 minutes later. No injuries are being reported. The airline reported a Lithium Battery spontaneously combusted within a passenger's luggage, the crew reacted according to procedures and secured the device. No injuries occurred, the aircraft diverted to Shanghai for an emergency landing. A replacement aircraft was provided. Several passengers reported the fire suddenly broke out and posted videos and photos on China's social networks.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年10月18日，Air China的一架Airbus 321-200注册号为B-8583，执行Air China 139航班，从Hangzhou（China）飞往Seoul（South Korea）。飞机在East China Sea上空、Shanghai（China）以东约120海里处以FL330飞行时，一名乘客存放在行李架内的锂电池过热并突然起火。客舱机组扑灭火焰并控制住该设备，同时飞行机组操纵飞机掉头备降Shanghai Pudong（China）。飞机约40分钟后降落在Pudong机场34L跑道，未再发生其他事件。没有人员受伤的报告。航空公司报告称，一块锂电池在乘客行李内自燃，机组按照程序作出反应并妥善固定该设备。没有人员受伤，飞机备降Shanghai并实施紧急着陆。航空公司提供了一架替代飞机。数名乘客报告称，火焰突然出现，并在China的社交网络上发布了视频和照片。

cards.audioText: runway incursion On October, 14, 2025, a DHL Aero Expreso Boeing 7 67-300, registration Hotel Papa-3 6 1 0 Delta Alpha Echo performing flight 1 5 5 8 from Buenos Aires Ezeiza (Argentina) to Santiago (Chile), was taxiing for departure from Runway 29, when the aircraft crossed the runway. An Avianca Airbus 3 20-200 Noe, registration Hotel Kilo-5 3 6 0 performing flight 1 1 1 from Medellin (Colombia) to Buenos Aires Ezeiza (Argentina), was on short final to Runway 29 about 1.37 nautical miles before the runway threshold when the 7 67 crossed the hold short line, was about 0.77 nautical miles before the runway threshold when the 7 67 crossed the runway edge line, was about 0.53 nautical miles before the runway threshold when the 7 67 crossed the other runway edge line to exit the runway and was about 100 meters, 330 feet past the runway threshold when the 7 67 crossed the other hold short line and thus vacated the runway. Argentina's JST reported a runway incursion occurred when one aircraft was landing and the other one was taxiing for departure. The occurrence was rated a serious incident and is being investigated.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道侵入。2025年10月14日，DHL Aero Expreso的一架Boeing 767-300注册号为HP-3610DAE，执行1558号航班，从Buenos Aires Ezeiza（Argentina）飞往Santiago（Chile）。飞机正在滑行准备从29号跑道起飞时穿越了跑道。Avianca的一架Airbus 320-200 Noe注册号为HK-5360，执行111号航班，从Medellin（Colombia）飞往Buenos Aires Ezeiza（Argentina），正在对29号跑道实施短五边进近。当该机位于跑道入口前约1.37海里处时，Boeing 767越过跑道等待线；当该机位于跑道入口前约0.77海里处时，Boeing 767越过跑道边缘线；当该机位于跑道入口前约0.53海里处时，Boeing 767越过另一侧跑道边缘线驶出跑道；当该机位于跑道入口之后约100米，即330英尺处时，Boeing 767越过另一侧跑道等待线，从而完全脱离跑道。Argentina的JST报告称，一架航空器正在着陆、另一架正在滑行准备离场时发生了跑道侵入。该事件被定性为严重事故征候，目前正在调查。

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to bird strike On October 18, 2025, an E A T Leipzig Airbus 300-600 on behalf of Lufthansa, registration Delta Alpha Echo Alpha Bravo performing flight 6 7 3 1 from Amsterdam (Netherlands) to London Heathrow (UK), was accelerating for takeoff from Amsterdam's runway tree six Center when the crew rejected takeoff at high speed (about 100 knots over ground) due to a bird strike into the right hand engine. Tower reported seeing the right hand engine flame out. The crew requested emergency services to inspect the aircraft for damage, shut the right hand engine down for that inspection and subsequently returned to the apron on one engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 因鸟击中断起飞。2025年10月18日，EAT Leipzig的一架Airbus 300-600代表Lufthansa运营，注册号为DAEAB，执行6731号航班，从Amsterdam（Netherlands）飞往London Heathrow（UK）。飞机正在Amsterdam机场36C跑道加速起飞时，机组因右侧发动机遭鸟击而在高速状态下中断起飞，当时地速约为100节。塔台报告看到右侧发动机熄火。机组请求紧急服务人员检查飞机是否受损，关闭右侧发动机以便进行检查，随后使用一台发动机返回停机坪。

cards.audioText: problems with landing gear, overran runway on landing back On October 20, 2025, an AZAL Azerbaijan Airlines Airbus 3 20-200, registration 4 Kilo-Alpha Zulu 8 4 performing flight AZAL 20 from St. Petersburg (Russia) to Baku (Azerbaijan) with 155 people on board, was climbing out of St. Petersburg's Runway 28R when the crew stopped the climb at FL0 6 0 and entered a hold due to problems with the landing gear. The aircraft performed two low approaches to Runway 28R, then entered a hold for about one hour, then performed another low approach to Runway 28R and positioned for a full stop landing on Runway 28R. Upon landing the aircraft overran the end of the runway and came to a stop with all gear on soft ground past the runway around 100 meters, 330 feet past the runway end about 3 hours after departure. There were no injuries. The airline reported the crew decided to return to St. Petersburg due to a technical problem with the landing gear and burned off fuel. A replacement aircraft has been dispatched.
cards.audioTextZh: 起落架出现问题，返航着陆时冲出跑道。2025年10月20日，AZAL Azerbaijan Airlines的一架Airbus 320-200注册号为4K-AZ84，执行AZAL 20航班，从St. Petersburg（Russia）飞往Baku（Azerbaijan），机上共有155人。飞机从St. Petersburg机场28R跑道起飞爬升时，机组因起落架出现问题而在FL060停止爬升并进入等待。飞机对28R跑道实施了两次低空进近，随后进入等待约一小时，又对28R跑道实施了一次低空进近，之后对正28R跑道准备全停着陆。着陆后，飞机冲出跑道末端，并在跑道末端以外约100米，即330英尺处的松软地面上停下，所有起落架均位于松软地面；此时距起飞约3小时。无人受伤。航空公司报告称，机组因起落架技术问题决定返回St. Petersburg，并消耗了燃油。航空公司已派出一架替代飞机。

cards.audioText: engine failure on very short final On October 12, 2025, a Westjet Boeing 7 37-8 MAX, registration Charlie-Golf Foxtrot Juliet Mike performing flight Westjet 7 0 7 from Toronto to Vancouver (Canada) with 183 people on board, was on short final to Vancouver's Runway 08R descending between 700 and 300 feet AGL when the left hand engine (Leap) lost power, the aircraft on autopilot drifted to the left and the airspeed reduced by about 7 knots, the crew observed an engine fail and autothrottle caution light. The captain announced an engine failure, the crew elected to continue the landing. At that time the left engine stabilized again, the parameters returned to normal. The aircraft landed safely with both engines operating normally and taxied to the apron. The Canadian TSB reported maintenance performed numerous activities to troubleshoot the power loss. During a fuel nozzle check a loose B-nut was discovered which was retorqued. The fuel metering unit was also replaced.
cards.audioTextZh: 在极短五边进近时发动机失效。2025年10月12日，Westjet的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX注册号为C-GFJM，执行Westjet 707航班，从Toronto飞往Vancouver（Canada），机上共有183人。飞机正在对Vancouver机场08R跑道实施短五边进近，在离地700至300英尺之间下降时，左侧发动机（Leap）失去动力；处于自动驾驶状态的飞机向左偏移，空速降低约7节，机组观察到发动机失效和自动油门警告灯。机长宣布发动机失效，机组决定继续着陆。此时左侧发动机重新稳定，参数恢复正常。飞机在两台发动机均正常运转的情况下安全着陆，并滑行至停机坪。Canada运输安全委员会报告称，维修人员进行了多项工作以排查动力丧失问题。在检查燃油喷嘴时发现一个松动的B形螺母，并重新按规定扭矩拧紧。燃油计量组件也已更换。

cards.audioText: On October 24, 2025, an Air France Boeing 7 7 7-300, registration Foxtrot-Golf Zulu November Golf performing flight Air France 6 5 2 from Paris Charles de Gaulle (France) to Saint Denis (Reunion) with 312 passengers and 14 crew, was enroute at FL3 1 0 about 50 nautical miles southsoutheast of Zurich (Switzerland) when the crew declared PAN PAN reporting heat in the cabin and requested to return to Paris Charles de Gaulle. The crew subsequently decided to dump fuel on the way back and advised no further assistance was needed. Swiss ATC advised, that upon entering France they would need to declare emergency to be able to dump fuel over French territory, the crew thus upgraded to Mayday, Mayday. The aircraft landed safely on Charles de Gaulle's Runway 26R about 100 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年10月24日，Air France的一架Boeing 777-300注册号为F-GZNG，执行Air France 652航班，从Paris Charles de Gaulle（France）飞往Saint Denis（Reunion），机上有312名乘客和14名机组人员。飞机在Zurich（Switzerland）东南偏南约50海里处以FL310飞行时，机组宣布PAN PAN，报告客舱内发热，并请求返回Paris Charles de Gaulle。机组随后决定在返航途中放油，并表示不再需要其他协助。Switzerland空中交通管制告知机组，进入France后，如需在France领土上空放油，他们必须宣布紧急情况，因此机组将紧急状态升级为“Mayday，Mayday”。飞机在起飞约100分钟后安全降落在Charles de Gaulle机场26R跑道。

cards.audioText: On August 20, 2025, a Thai Airways Airbus 3 5 0 900, registration Hotel Sierra-Tango Hotel Yankee performing flight Thai Airway 9 2 5 from Munich (Germany) to Bangkok (Thailand), was enroute over Thailand when the aircraft encountered turbulence. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Bangkok's Runway 19. Thailand's AIB reported the aircraft encountered turbulence while enroute resulting in 4 serious and 1 minor injury. The occurrence was rated an accident and is being investigated.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月20日，Thai Airways的一架Airbus 350-900注册号为HS-THY，执行Thai Airway 925航班，从Munich（Germany）飞往Bangkok（Thailand）。飞机在Thailand上空飞行时遭遇湍流，随后继续飞往Bangkok并安全降落在19号跑道。Thailand航空事故调查机构报告称，飞机在航路上遭遇湍流，造成4人重伤、1人轻伤。该事件被定性为事故，目前正在调查。

cards.audioText: inflight upset causes injuries On October 30, 2025, a Jetblue Airbus 3 20 200, registration November 6 0 5 Juliet Bravo performing flight Jetblue 1 2 3 0 from Cancun (Mexico) to Newark (USA), was enroute at FL3 5 0 about 70 nautical miles westsouthwest of Tampa (USA) when the aircraft experienced an inflight upset causing injuries to a number of people. The aircraft descended rapidly, briefly maintained about 20,000 feet and continued the descent for an approach to Tampa. The crew reported they had had flight control problems that caused at least three injuries, head injuries, on board. The aircraft landed on Tampa's Runway 01L about 20 minutes after leaving FL3 5 0. Jetblue reported the affected passengers were taken to hospitals, the others were checked by medical staff the airport. The aircraft is now being checked. A replacement aircraft continued the flight but needed to divert to La Guardia before reaching Newark.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中姿态异常造成人员受伤。2025年10月30日，Jetblue的一架Airbus 320-200注册号为N605JB，执行Jetblue 1230航班，从Cancun（Mexico）飞往Newark（USA）。飞机在Tampa（USA）西南偏西约70海里处以FL350飞行时发生飞行中姿态异常，造成多人受伤。飞机迅速下降，短暂保持约20,000英尺，随后继续下降并进近Tampa。机组报告称，飞机出现飞行操纵问题，造成机上至少3人受伤，伤情为头部受伤。飞机在离开FL350约20分钟后降落在Tampa机场01L跑道。Jetblue报告称，受影响的乘客被送往医院，其他人员由机场医务人员进行检查。目前正在检查该飞机。一架替代飞机继续执行该航班，但在抵达Newark前需要备降La Guardia。

cards.audioText: laptop hides away On October 15, 2025, a United Boeing 7 67 400, registration November 7 6 0 5 4 performing flight United 1 2 6 from Washington Dulles (USA) to Rome Fiumicino (Italy) with 216 people on board, was enroute at FL3 1 0 about 80 nautical miles southeast of Boston (USA) when the crew decided to return to Washington as a precaution, after a passenger's laptop had fallen behind a cabin wall and down a small gap leading to the (pressurized) cargo hold causing concerns that the Lithium Ion battery could suffer a thermal runaway. The aircraft landed safely on Washington's Runway 01R about 80 minutes after the decision to turn around. The airline reported maintenance personnel located and retrieved the laptop, the aircraft was able to depart again.
cards.audioTextZh: 笔记本电脑掉入隐蔽位置。2025年10月15日，United的一架Boeing 767-400注册号为N76054，执行United 126航班，从Washington Dulles（USA）飞往Rome Fiumicino（Italy），机上共有216人。飞机在Boston（USA）东南约80海里处以FL310飞行时，机组决定采取预防措施返回Washington。此前，一名乘客的笔记本电脑掉到客舱壁板后方，并沿着一处通往增压货舱的小缝隙落下，引发对其锂离子电池可能发生热失控的担忧。飞机在决定返航约80分钟后安全降落在Washington机场01R跑道。航空公司报告称，维修人员已找到并取回该笔记本电脑，飞机随后得以再次起飞。

cards.audioText: On November 3, 2025, a Ryanair Boeing 7 37-800, registration Echo India-Delta Papa Juliet performing flight Ryanair 2 6 8 2 from Milan Bergamo (Italy) to Cluj (Romania), was descending towards Cluj when the captain declared PAN PAN reporting the first officer had become incapacitated, subsequently the captain upgraded to Mayday. The aircraft landed safely on Cluj's Runway 25 and stopped on the runway, where emergency services awaited the aircraft. The first officer, unconscious at that time, was taken to a hospital. About 50 minutes after landing the aircraft was towed to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年11月3日，Ryanair的一架Boeing 737-800注册号为EI-DPJ，执行Ryanair 2682航班，从Milan Bergamo（Italy）飞往Cluj（Romania）。飞机正在向Cluj下降时，机长宣布PAN PAN，报告副驾驶失能，随后将紧急状态升级为Mayday。飞机安全降落在Cluj机场25号跑道并停在跑道上，紧急服务人员已在那里等候。此时处于昏迷状态的副驾驶被送往医院。飞机在着陆约50分钟后被拖至停机坪。

cards.audioText: On August 24, 2025, an Iberia Airbus 3 20-200, registration Echo Charlie-Mike Delta Kilo performing flight Iberia 6 9 4 from Catania (Italy) to Madrid (Spain) with 146 passengers and 6 crew, was enroute at FL3 5 0 overflying Palma Mallorca (Spain) when the crew observed a weather balloon. The aircraft continued to Madrid for a safe landing. On Nov 4th 2025 Spain's CIAIAC reported the weather balloon passed approximately 200 meters (660 feet) to the right of the aircraft and about 30 meters(100 feet) above. The occurrence is being investigated.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月24日，Iberia的一架Airbus 320-200注册号为EC-MDK，执行Iberia 694航班，从Catania（Italy）飞往Madrid（Spain），机上有146名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机在飞越Palma Mallorca（Spain）时以FL350飞行，机组观察到一个气象气球。飞机继续飞往Madrid并安全着陆。2025年11月4日，Spain航空事故与事故征候调查委员会报告称，该气象气球从飞机右侧约200米，即660英尺处，以及飞机上方约30米，即100英尺处经过。该事件目前正在调查。

cards.audioText: On August 12, 2025, a Smartwings Boeing 7 37-800 on behalf of Eurowings, registration Oscar Kilo-Tango Sierra Foxtrot performing flight Eurowings 6 8 2 from Cologne (Germany) to Athens (Greece), was descending through FL2 6 0 towards Athens when the cabin altitude warning illuminated prompting the crew to don their oxygen masks and perform the related memory items. The cabin altitude could be controlled at 10,000 feet with the bleed valve fully closed. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Athens' Runway 03R. Czechia's UZPLN reported a maintenance organisation was called in, which incorrectly released the aircraft back to flight under minimum equipment list requirements after disconnecting the cabin pressure control system. The maintenance engineer did not follow the fault isolation manual which indicated that the "LOW INFLATION/HIGH LEAKING" fault message does not indicate a fault in the digital cabin pressurization system.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月12日，Smartwings的一架Boeing 737-800代表Eurowings运营，注册号为OK-TSF，执行Eurowings 682航班，从Cologne（Germany）飞往Athens（Greece）。飞机正在向Athens下降并通过FL260时，客舱高度警告灯亮起，机组因此戴上氧气面罩并执行相关记忆项目。在引气活门完全关闭的情况下，客舱高度能够控制在10,000英尺。飞机继续飞行并安全降落在Athens机场03R跑道。Czechia航空事故调查机构报告称，一家维修机构受邀处理该问题；该机构断开客舱压力控制系统后，错误地依据最低设备清单要求放行飞机重新投入飞行。维修工程师没有遵循故障隔离手册；该手册指出，“LOW INFLATION/HIGH LEAKING”故障信息并不表示数字式客舱增压系统存在故障。

cards.audioText: On November 22, 2025, a Scoot Airbus 3 21, registration 9 Victor-November Charlie Juliet performing flight Scoot 9 3 9 from Hong Kong (China) to Singapore (Singapore), was descending towards Singapore when a passenger's power bank overheated and caught fire. Cabin crew used fire extinguishers and water to put the fire out and put the power bank into a safe container. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Runway 20C. The airline reported a small fire from a passenger's power bank, which was promptly extinguished by cabin crew. Passengers reported there had been a strong burning odour in the cabin when the aircraft was about to land. Flight attendants were rushing through the aircraft with protective gloves, fire extinguishers and subsequently carried a bag towards the aft galley.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年11月22日，Scoot的一架Airbus 321注册号为9V-NCJ，执行Scoot 939航班，从Hong Kong（China）飞往Singapore（Singapore）。飞机正在向Singapore下降时，一名乘客的充电宝过热并起火。客舱机组使用灭火器和水将火扑灭，并把充电宝放入安全容器。飞机继续飞行并安全降落在20C跑道。航空公司报告称，一名乘客的充电宝引发小火，客舱机组迅速将其扑灭。乘客报告称，飞机即将着陆时，客舱内出现强烈的烧焦气味。乘务员戴着防护手套、拿着灭火器在客舱内快速行动，随后将一个袋子带往后厨房。

cards.audioText: On November 14, 2025, a Ryanair Boeing 7 37-8 MAX, registration Echo India-Hotel Golf Golf performing flight Ryanair 8 5 0 6 from London Stansted (UK) to Malaga (Spain) with 93 passengers and 5 crew, was on final approach to Malaga's Runway 12 when the aircraft encountered windshear at about 840 feet AGL prompting the crew to initiate a go around. The aircraft initially settled in a climb to about 1900 feet MSL but then entered a descent reaching a rate of descent of up to 4100 fpm. The GPWS activated and initiated a "Pull UP! Pull Up! " The aircraft descended to about 890 feet at excessive speed then began to climb again. The crew subsequently positioned for another approach to Runway 12 and landed without further incident.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年11月14日，Ryanair的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX注册号为EI-HGG，执行Ryanair 8506航班，从London Stansted（UK）飞往Malaga（Spain），机上有93名乘客和5名机组人员。飞机正在对Malaga机场12号跑道实施最后进近时，在离地约840英尺处遭遇风切变，促使机组开始复飞。飞机最初稳定爬升至平均海平面以上约1,900英尺，但随后转为下降，下降率最高达到每分钟4,100英尺。近地警告系统启动并发出“Pull Up！Pull Up！”警告。飞机以过高速度下降至约890英尺，随后再次开始爬升。机组之后重新定位，对12号跑道实施另一次进近，并顺利着陆。

cards.audioText: On December 4, 2025, a United Boeing 7 7 7 200, registration November 7 4 0 0 7 performing flight United 9 4 9 from London Heathrow (UK) to San Francisco (USA) with 162 passengers and 12 crew, was enroute at FL3 4 0 over the Atlantic Ocean about 360 nautical miles northwest of Edinburgh (UK) when the crew decided to turn around and divert to Edinburgh due to a burning odour on board. The aircraft landed safely on Edinburgh's Runway 06 about one hour after turning around. The airline reported the aircraft diverted to Edinburgh due to a burning smell on board, the passengers were taken to hotels and rebooked onto other flights.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年12月4日，United的一架Boeing 777-200注册号为N74007，执行United 949航班，从London Heathrow（UK）飞往San Francisco（USA），机上有162名乘客和12名机组人员。飞机在Atlantic Ocean上空、Edinburgh（UK）西北约360海里处以FL340飞行时，机组因机上出现烧焦气味而决定掉头并备降Edinburgh。飞机在掉头约一小时后安全降落在Edinburgh机场06号跑道。航空公司报告称，飞机因机上出现烧焦气味备降Edinburgh，乘客被安排入住酒店并改签至其他航班。

cards.audioText: cabin pressurization problems On December 19, 2025, a Pakistan International Airlines Boeing 7 7 7-300, registration Alpha Papa-Bravo Mike Sierra performing flight Pakistan 8 6 0 from Jeddah (Saudi Arabia) to Lahore (Pakistan) with 381 people on board, was enroute at FL3 5 0 about 200 nautical miles south of Dammam (Saudi Arabia) when the crew initiated a rapid descent to FL1 0 0 (descending through FL2 0 0 about 5 minutes later), the passenger oxygen masks deployed. The aircraft turned north and diverted to Dammam for a safe landing on Runway 34R about 85 minutes after leaving FL3 5 0. The airline reported a technical issue. Passengers reported the oxygen masks deployed in the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱增压问题。2025年12月19日，Pakistan International Airlines的一架Boeing 777-300注册号为AP-BMS，执行Pakistan 860航班，从Jeddah（Saudi Arabia）飞往Lahore（Pakistan），机上共有381人。飞机在Dammam（Saudi Arabia）以南约200海里处以FL350飞行时，机组开始快速下降至FL100；约5分钟后，飞机正在下降通过FL200，乘客氧气面罩已释放。飞机转向北方并备降Dammam，在离开FL350约85分钟后安全降落在34R跑道。航空公司报告称飞机出现技术问题。乘客报告称，客舱内的氧气面罩已经释放。

cards.audioText: On January 27, 2026, a Southwest Airlines Boeing 7 37 8 MAX, registration November 8 5 6 3 Zulu performing flight Southwest 4 9 9 6 from San Antonio to Dallas Love (USA), was accelerating for takeoff from San Antonio's Runway 22 when tower called out a swear word and instructed the flight to cancel takeoff clearance as well as an aircraft on final approach to go around after seeing a private light aircraft entering the runway. The aircraft rejected takeoff at about 90 knots over ground and stopped safely. The Southwest Boeing stopped on the runway, held position, vacated the runway and returned to the hold short line of Runway 22. The aircraft, that had been delayed by about 80 minutes for first attempt of departure, departed about 40 minutes after the rejected takeoff and reached Dallas with a delay of 2 hours.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年1月27日，Southwest Airlines的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX注册号为N8563Z，执行Southwest 4996航班，从San Antonio飞往Dallas Love（USA）。飞机正在San Antonio机场22号跑道加速起飞时，塔台在看到一架私人轻型航空器进入跑道后喊出一句脏话，并指示该航班取消起飞许可，同时指示一架正在最后进近的航空器复飞。飞机在地速约90节时中断起飞并安全停下。这架Southwest Boeing停在跑道上，原地等待，随后脱离跑道并返回22号跑道等待线。该机在第一次尝试离场前已经延误约80分钟，又在中断起飞约40分钟后起飞，最终抵达Dallas时延误2小时。

cards.audioText: spoiler extended uncommandedly On December 31, 2025, an Atlas Air Boeing 7 67-300, registration November 6 4 0 Golf Tango performing flight 8 7 1 3 from Frankfurt Hahn (Germany) to Seattle, (USA), was enroute at FL3 5 0 over southern Greenland when a left outboard spoiler extended fully and uncommandedly resulting in roll. The captain disconnected the autopilot, corrected the bank angle manually, declared Mayday and diverted to Keflavik (Iceland) where the aircraft landed safely about 2 hours later. The Canadian TSB reported the aircraft reached a maximum bank angle of 18.63 degrees before recovery. The spoiler remained extended until the aircraft descended through FL1 9 0, then retracted. The TSB stated: "Maintenance replaced the #2 spoiler power control actuator and the 1 L spoiler control module, with operational and leak checks satisfactory."
cards.audioTextZh: 扰流板未经指令伸出。2025年12月31日，Atlas Air的一架Boeing 767-300注册号为N640GT，执行8713号航班，从Frankfurt Hahn（Germany）飞往Seattle（USA）。飞机在Greenland南部上空以FL350飞行时，左侧外侧扰流板未经指令完全伸出，导致飞机滚转。机长断开自动驾驶，手动修正坡度角，宣布Mayday并备降Keflavik（Iceland），飞机约2小时后安全着陆。Canada运输安全委员会报告称，飞机在恢复前达到的最大坡度角为18.63度。该扰流板一直保持伸出，直至飞机下降通过FL190后才收回。运输安全委员会表示：“维修人员更换了2号扰流板动力控制作动器和1L扰流板控制模块，操作检查和渗漏检查结果均令人满意。”

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to runway incursion On February 20, 2026, a LATAM Chile Airbus 3 20 200, registration Charlie Charlie-Charlie Oscar Foxtrot performing flight 4 2 7 8 from Bogota to San Andres Island (Colombia) with 157 people on board, was accelerating for takeoff from Bogota's Runway 14R when the crew rejected takeoff at very high speed (about 160 knots over ground) due to a military helicopter crossing the runway at low height. The aircraft slowed safely and vacated the runway onto the parallel taxiway, where the tyres deflated due to the hot brakes. There were no injuries. Aerocivil Colombia reported the military helicopter was just departing when it crossed about midway of the Runway 14R prompting the crew of the Airbus 3 20 to reject takeoff. The occurrence is being investigated. According to tower tapes it appears both aircraft had been cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 因跑道侵入中断起飞。2026年2月20日，LATAM Chile的一架Airbus 320-200注册号为CC-COF，执行4278号航班，从Bogota飞往San Andres Island（Colombia），机上共有157人。飞机正在Bogota机场14R跑道加速起飞时，因一架军用直升机在低高度穿越跑道，机组在极高速度下中断起飞，当时地速约为160节。飞机安全减速并脱离跑道进入平行滑行道；轮胎因刹车过热而泄气。无人受伤。Colombia民航局报告称，这架军用直升机刚刚起飞，在14R跑道约中部位置穿越跑道，促使Airbus 320机组中断起飞。该事件目前正在调查。根据塔台录音，两架航空器似乎都已获得起飞许可。

cards.audioText: power bank's thermal runaway On February 22, 2026, a Horizon Air Embraer ERJ-1 7 5 on behalf of Alaska Air, registration November 6 4 1 Quebec X-ray performing flight Alaska 2 1 1 7 from Wichita to Seattle (USA), was climbing out of Wichita when the crew stopped the climb at FL2 0 0 after the power bank of a passenger suffered a thermal runaway and caught fire. While cabin crew doused and secured the device, the flight crew returned the aircraft to Wichita for a safe landing on Runway 01L about 40 minutes after departure. The owner of the power bank was taken to a hospital with minor burns.
cards.audioTextZh: 充电宝发生热失控。2026年2月22日，Horizon Air的一架Embraer ERJ-175代表Alaska Air运营，注册号为N641QX，执行Alaska 2117航班，从Wichita飞往Seattle（USA）。飞机从Wichita起飞爬升时，一名乘客的充电宝发生热失控并起火，机组因此在FL200停止爬升。客舱机组在用水浇淋并妥善固定该设备的同时，飞行机组操纵飞机返回Wichita，并在起飞约40分钟后安全降落在01L跑道。充电宝的所有者因轻微烧伤被送往医院。

cards.audioText: bird strike results in engine fire On January 28, 2026, an Amazon Prime Air Airbus 3 30 300, registration November 5 8 2 7 Kilo performing flight 2 6 1 6 from Cincinnati to Houston Intercontinental (USA) with 2 crew, was departing Covington's Runway 27 when the left hand engine ingested a number of birds. The aircraft stopped the climb at 3000 feet, the crew donned their oxygen masks reporting smoke in the cockpit, and returned to Cincinnati for a safe landing on Runway 36R about 10 minutes after departure. After landing the crew advised they needed a ladder to the 1 Romeo door as they had an engine fire on the left hand side and wanted the #1 engine checked for fire.
cards.audioTextZh: 鸟击导致发动机起火。2026年1月28日，Amazon Prime Air的一架Airbus 330-300注册号为N5827K，执行2616号航班，从Cincinnati飞往Houston Intercontinental（USA），机上有2名机组人员。飞机从Covington机场27号跑道起飞时，左侧发动机吸入多只鸟。飞机在3,000英尺停止爬升；机组戴上氧气面罩，报告驾驶舱内有烟，并返回Cincinnati，在起飞约10分钟后安全降落在36R跑道。着陆后，机组告知他们需要一架梯子到1R舱门，因为左侧发生了发动机火警，他们希望检查1号发动机是否起火。

cards.audioText: On May 8, 2026, Frontier Airlines Flight 43 45, an Airbus 3 21 neo with 231 people aboard, was preparing for takeoff from Denver International Airport bound for Los Angeles. At 2 3 1 9 local time, during the high-speed takeoff roll on Runway 17L, the aircraft struck a pedestrian who had illegally entered the airfield. The victim was partially ingested into the left engine, causing an immediate fire and smoke in the cabin. The captain swiftly aborted the takeoff and informed ATC: "We just hit a person... engine fire." Airport fire crews arrived within two minutes and extinguished the blaze. All passengers and crew evacuated via emergency slides; 12 sustained minor injuries. Investigations revealed the individual had climbed over the perimeter fence just two minutes prior. The F A A and NTSB launched a full probe into security breaches.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月8日，Frontier Airlines 4345航班使用一架Airbus 321neo执飞，机上共有231人，正准备从Denver International Airport起飞前往Los Angeles。当地时间23:19，飞机正在17L跑道高速滑跑起飞时，撞到一名非法进入机场飞行区的行人。该人员的一部分被吸入左侧发动机，随即引发火灾并导致客舱内出现烟雾。机长迅速中断起飞，并通知空中交通管制：“我们刚刚撞到一个人……发动机起火。”机场消防人员在两分钟内抵达并将火扑灭。所有乘客和机组人员均通过应急滑梯撤离，其中12人受轻伤。调查发现，该人员在事件发生仅两分钟前翻越了机场周界围栏。FAA和NTSB已对安保漏洞展开全面调查。

cards.audioText: United Airlines Flight 1 69, a Boeing 7 67 operating from Venice to Newark, encountered a bizarre incident on May 3, 2026. On final approach to Runway 29, the aircraft descended below the glide path. The landing gear and fuselage struck several highway light poles and a semi-truck on the New Jersey Turnpike directly beneath the approach path. Shockingly, the crew and 231 passengers remained completely unaware of the collision. The jet landed safely and taxied to the gate normally. Ground control later notified the pilots of the incident. The truck driver suffered minor cuts from broken glass. The aircraft sustained structural damage to the fuselage and landing gear. The NTSB is investigating pilot awareness, auto-pilot discrepancies, and airport approach zone safety barriers.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月3日，United Airlines 169航班使用一架Boeing 767执飞，从Venice飞往Newark，期间发生了一起离奇事件。飞机正在对29号跑道实施最后进近时下降至下滑道以下。起落架和机身撞上了进近航径正下方New Jersey Turnpike公路上的数根路灯杆和一辆半挂卡车。令人震惊的是，机组和231名乘客完全没有意识到发生了碰撞。飞机安全着陆并正常滑行至登机口。地面管制随后将该事件通知飞行员。卡车司机被碎玻璃轻微割伤。飞机机身和起落架受到结构性损伤。NTSB正在调查飞行员的察觉情况、自动驾驶系统异常以及机场进近区安全屏障。

cards.audioText: A Cessna 1 7 2 training flight crashed in Florida on March 23, 2026, resulting in two fatalities. The flight, with a student pilot and instructor onboard, departed from North Perry Airport for a routine navigation exercise. Approximately 25 minutes into the flight, over Boynton Beach, the aircraft experienced a catastrophic failure of the flight control system. Witnesses reported the plane spiraled steeply before impacting a residential neighborhood. The NTSB preliminary report ruled out engine failure, focusing on a faulty elevator control mechanism. No one on the ground was injured. The aircraft was destroyed on impact. This crash highlighted ongoing concerns about aging general aviation aircraft and maintenance oversight. The flight school temporarily suspended operations pending a full safety review.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年3月23日，一架Cessna 172训练飞机在Florida坠毁，造成2人死亡。机上有一名学员飞行员和一名教员，飞机从North Perry Airport起飞，执行常规导航训练。飞行约25分钟后，飞机在Boynton Beach上空的飞行操纵系统发生灾难性故障。目击者报告称，飞机以大坡度螺旋下降，随后撞入一处居民区。NTSB初步报告排除了发动机故障，调查重点为升降舵操纵机构故障。地面无人受伤。飞机在撞击中完全损毁。这起坠机事故凸显了人们对老旧通用航空器和维修监管的持续担忧。该航校暂停运营，等待完成全面安全审查。

cards.audioText: On March 22, 2026, Jazz Air Flight 86 46, a C R J-900 operating for Air Canada Express, collided with a fire truck at New York's LaGuardia Airport. The accident occurred at 2 3: 3 7 as the flight landed on Runway 04. An airport fire department vehicle was crossing the runway in response to a separate, false alarm when it was struck by the jet's right wing. The impact severed the truck's cab; two firefighters were killed. The aircraft suffered substantial wing damage but remained controllable. The captain and first officer died in the accident, 9 passengers received serious injuries, 32 passengers received minor injuries. The NTSB found the fire crew had misheard ATC clearance and entered the active runway without authorization. This tragedy emphasized critical breakdowns in radio communication and situational awareness.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年3月22日，Jazz Air 8646航班使用一架CRJ-900代表Air Canada Express运营，在New York的LaGuardia Airport与一辆消防车相撞。事故发生于23:37，当时该航班正在04号跑道着陆。一辆机场消防部门车辆正在穿越跑道，以响应另一起误报，随后被飞机右翼撞击。撞击切断了消防车驾驶室，2名消防员死亡。飞机机翼受到严重损伤，但仍可操纵。机长和副驾驶在事故中死亡，9名乘客重伤，32名乘客轻伤。NTSB发现，消防人员误听了空中交通管制许可，未经授权进入正在使用的跑道。这起悲剧凸显了无线电通信和情景意识方面的严重失效。

cards.audioText: A tragic military aviation accident occurred on March 23, 2026, when a Lockheed C 1 3 0 Echo Hercules transport plane crashed in Colombia. The aircraft, carrying 69 military personnel and supplies, was on a routine supply mission to a remote outpost. During final approach in heavy rain and low visibility, the plane struck a mountain ridge shortly before landing. All aboard perished. The Colombian Air Force attributed the crash to controlled flight into terrain, likely caused by a combination of severe weather and inaccurate navigation data. Rescue efforts were hampered by the remote location and adverse weather. This crash stands as the deadliest aviation accident of 2026. Investigations continue regarding possible equipment malfunctions and crew resource management.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年3月23日发生了一起悲惨的军用航空事故，一架Lockheed C-130E Hercules运输机在Colombia坠毁。该机载有69名军事人员和补给物资，正在执行向一个偏远前哨运送补给的常规任务。飞机在大雨和低能见度条件下实施最后进近时，于着陆前不久撞上山脊。机上所有人员全部遇难。Colombia空军将这起坠机事故归因于可控飞行撞地，可能由恶劣天气和不准确导航数据共同造成。偏远的位置和恶劣天气阻碍了救援工作。这起坠机事故是2026年死亡人数最多的航空事故。有关可能存在的设备故障和机组资源管理问题仍在调查中。

cards.audioText: On May 2, 2026, China Eastern 5 4 0 6, an Airbus 3 5 0, experienced a ground incident after landing at Shanghai Pudong International Airport. During taxiing to the gate, the aircraft's left wing struck a passenger boarding bridge multiple times. Initial investigations pointed to a sudden mechanical failure in the nose wheel steering system, causing the pilot to lose directional control. Despite the impact, the crew maintained composure, deployed emergency slides, and safely evacuated all 320 passengers without injury. The wing sustained significant structural damage. This incident highlighted the risks during ground operations and the value of modern aircraft safety systems. C A A C has ordered enhanced maintenance checks for Airbus 3 5 0 steering components.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月2日，China Eastern 5406航班使用一架Airbus 350执飞，在Shanghai Pudong International Airport着陆后发生地面事件。飞机滑行前往登机口期间，左翼多次撞到一座旅客登机桥。初步调查指向前轮转向系统突然发生机械故障，导致飞行员失去方向控制。尽管发生撞击，机组仍保持镇定，放出应急滑梯，并将全部320名乘客安全撤离，无人受伤。机翼受到严重结构性损伤。该事件凸显了地面运行期间的风险以及现代航空器安全系统的价值。CAAC已要求加强对Airbus 350转向部件的维修检查。

cards.audioText: An Airbus 2 2 0 operated by Swiss International Airlines faced a critical in-flight emergency on May 9, 2026, en route to Zurich. While cruising at 37,000 feet, the aircraft's air data computer system failed completely. This caused erroneous readings on all cockpit displays, including airspeed and altitude. The crew immediately declared an emergency and initiated a rapid descent. With unreliable flight data, pilots relied on backup instruments and basic pitch-and-power settings. The aircraft diverted to Geneva Airport, where it performed a manual visual approach and landed safely. There were 132 passengers onboard; no injuries were reported. Investigators suspect a software glitch caused the dual failure of the redundant systems.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月9日，Swiss International Airlines运营的一架Airbus 220在飞往Zurich途中遭遇严重的飞行中紧急情况。飞机在37,000英尺巡航时，空中数据计算机系统完全失效，导致驾驶舱所有显示器均出现错误读数，包括空速和高度。机组立即宣布紧急情况并开始快速下降。由于飞行数据不可靠，飞行员依靠备用仪表以及基本的姿态和推力设置操纵飞机。飞机备降Geneva Airport，以手动目视进近方式安全着陆。机上有132名乘客，无人员受伤报告。调查人员怀疑，一个软件故障导致两套冗余系统同时失效。

cards.audioText: On February 10, 2026, a domestic flight in Somalia, operated by a Fokker 50 with 55 people, suffered a runway excursion upon landing at Mogadishu International Airport. After experiencing a technical fault shortly after takeoff, the crew decided to return immediately. However, upon landing, the aircraft's braking system failed to function properly. The plane overran the runway end and slid into the adjacent beach, partially submerging the fuselage in the Indian Ocean. Remarkably, all passengers and crew survived without serious injury. The evacuation was completed quickly as the aircraft began to sink. The Somali Civil Aviation Authority is investigating maintenance records and possible water contamination in the brake hydraulic system.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年2月10日，Somalia一架由Fokker 50执飞、机上共有55人的国内航班，在Mogadishu International Airport着陆时冲出跑道。飞机起飞后不久发生技术故障，机组决定立即返航。然而着陆时，飞机的刹车系统未能正常工作。飞机冲出跑道末端并滑入旁边的海滩，机身部分浸入Indian Ocean。值得庆幸的是，所有乘客和机组人员均幸存，没有人严重受伤。飞机开始下沉时，人员迅速完成撤离。Somalia民航局正在调查维修记录，以及刹车液压系统可能受到水污染的问题。

cards.audioText: A Lufthansa Airbus 3 2 1 neo encountered an engine fire indication on May 11, 2026, during climb-out from Athens International Airport. Immediately after takeoff, the crew received a fire warning for the left engine. Following standard procedures, they activated the fire suppression system, shut down the engine, and declared a emergency. The aircraft, carrying 189 passengers, dumped fuel to reduce weight before returning for a single-engine landing. Fire vehicles inspected the plane on the runway; no actual fire was found. The incident was later determined to be a false warning caused by a faulty sensor in the engine exhaust nozzle. This event demonstrated effective crew resource management and adherence to emergency checklists.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月11日，Lufthansa的一架Airbus 321neo从Athens International Airport起飞爬升时出现发动机火警指示。起飞后不久，机组收到左侧发动机火警。机组按照标准程序启动灭火系统、关闭发动机并宣布紧急情况。飞机载有189名乘客，在返回实施单发着陆前放油以减轻重量。消防车辆在跑道上检查飞机，没有发现实际火情。该事件后来被确定为一起虚假警告，原因是发动机排气喷口内的一个传感器出现故障。该事件体现了有效的机组资源管理以及对紧急检查单的遵守。

cards.audioText: On April 27, 2026, a serious near-miss occurred over Southern California involving a United Airlines Boeing 7 87 and a U.S. Army Black Hawk helicopter. The airliner, descending into Los Angeles International Airport, came within 150 meters vertically of the military helicopter. The incident happened in restricted airspace near San Bernardino. The 7 87's TCAS alerted the crew, prompting an immediate climb maneuver. The helicopter pilot also took evasive action. No collision occurred, and both aircraft landed safely. The F A A investigation revealed the helicopter had strayed from its assigned route due to a navigational error. This close call underscored the risks of mixed airspace usage and the critical importance of TCAS in preventing mid-air collisions.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年4月27日，Southern California上空发生了一起严重的危险接近事件，涉及United Airlines的一架Boeing 787和U.S. Army的一架Black Hawk直升机。客机正在向Los Angeles International Airport下降时，与军用直升机之间的垂直间隔一度仅有150米。该事件发生在San Bernardino附近的限制空域内。Boeing 787的TCAS向机组发出警报，促使机组立即实施爬升机动。直升机飞行员也采取了规避动作。两机没有相撞，随后均安全着陆。FAA调查发现，直升机因导航错误偏离了指定航线。这次危险接近凸显了混合使用空域的风险，以及TCAS在防止空中相撞方面的关键重要性。

cards.audioText: In early January 2026, a regional Embraer 190 flight with 98 passengers and four crew departed Bangkok for Chiang Mai. While cruising at FL3 1 0, the aircraft suddenly suffered severe turbulence without prior ATC weather alerts. Unfastened passengers and cabin crew were thrown violently inside the cabin; seven people sustained minor bruises and sprains. The captain promptly requested immediate descent and deviation around the storm cell. After stabilizing the aircraft, the crew decided to divert to Lampang Airport for medical checks. Ground medical teams waited at the terminal to assist injured passengers. Aviation authorities later reviewed real-time weather sharing loopholes between regional airports and en route control centers, urging upgraded turbulence early warning systems for all commercial fleets.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年1月初，一架载有98名乘客和4名机组人员的支线Embraer 190航班从Bangkok起飞前往Chiang Mai。飞机在FL310巡航时，在空中交通管制此前未提供天气警报的情况下突然遭遇严重湍流。未系安全带的乘客和客舱机组人员在客舱内被猛烈抛起，7人受到轻微挫伤和扭伤。机长立即请求马上下降并绕飞雷暴单体。飞机状态稳定后，机组决定备降Lampang Airport，以便进行医疗检查。地面医疗团队在航站楼等候，为受伤乘客提供协助。航空主管部门随后审查了支线机场与航路管制中心之间实时天气信息共享存在的漏洞，并敦促所有商业机队升级湍流预警系统。

cards.audioText: On February 14, 2026, a private Piper P A 28 training aircraft crashed shortly after takeoff from a small general aviation airfield in southern Australia. The plane carried one flight instructor and one student pilot practicing circuit training. Witnesses saw the engine sputter repeatedly before the aircraft banked sharply and crashed into a grassy field nearby. Both occupants survived with non-life-threatening injuries. Investigators found contaminated aviation fuel caused engine power loss during climb.
