The local aviation authority ordered all nearby airfields to conduct full fuel tank inspections and strengthen fuel quality supervision for flight schools. All similar single-engine training aircraft were required to complete extra engine system checks within one week.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年2月14日，一架私人Piper PA-28训练飞机从Australia南部一座小型通用航空机场起飞后不久坠毁。机上有一名飞行教员和一名正在进行起落航线训练的学员飞行员。目击者看到发动机反复运转不稳，随后飞机突然大坡度转弯并坠落在附近一片草地上。机上两人均幸存，所受伤势不危及生命。调查人员发现，受污染的航空燃油导致发动机在爬升期间失去动力。当地航空主管部门要求附近所有机场对油箱进行全面检查，并加强对航校的燃油质量监管。所有同类单发训练飞机都必须在一周内完成额外的发动机系统检查。

cards.audioText: On March 5, 2026, a large cargo Boeing 7 47 freighter experienced a nose gear malfunction while taxiing for departure at Dubai International Airport. The nose wheel failed to steer normally, leaving the aircraft stranded on the taxiway and blocking ground traffic. Airport staff towed the jet back to the maintenance apron after all cargo crew disembarked safely. No injuries were reported, but the incident delayed six departing flights. Maintenance teams confirmed a broken hydraulic valve caused the steering failure. Aviation regulators issued a service bulletin for all Boeing 7 47 operators to inspect nose gear hydraulic components regularly. The airport also adjusted taxiway emergency response procedures to reduce traffic disruption during similar ground incidents.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年3月5日，一架大型Boeing 747货机在Dubai International Airport滑行准备离场时发生前起落架故障。前轮无法正常转向，导致飞机滞留在滑行道上并阻塞地面交通。所有货机机组人员安全下机后，机场工作人员将飞机拖回维修机坪。无人受伤，但该事件造成6个离场航班延误。维修团队确认，一个损坏的液压活门导致转向失效。航空监管机构向所有Boeing 747运营人发布服务通告，要求定期检查前起落架液压部件。机场还调整了滑行道应急响应程序，以减少类似地面事件对交通的影响。

cards.audioText: On March 28, 2026, an Airbus 3 20 passenger flight encountered a bird strike during takeoff roll at a European coastal airport. A flock of large seabirds hit the right engine, causing loud abnormal noise and visible smoke. The captain followed standard procedures to reject takeoff immediately and evacuated all 167 passengers via emergency slides. Three passengers suffered minor injuries during evacuation. Fire crews inspected the engine and confirmed internal blade damage. Aviation investigators suggested adjusting runway bird deterrent schedules to match seasonal migration patterns. The airport added more radar bird monitoring equipment and increased patrols along the runway perimeter to prevent future bird strike accidents.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年3月28日，一架Airbus 320客机在欧洲一座沿海机场滑跑起飞时遭遇鸟击。一群大型海鸟撞击右侧发动机，导致巨大的异常噪声和可见烟雾。机长按照标准程序立即中断起飞，并通过应急滑梯撤离全部167名乘客。3名乘客在撤离期间受轻伤。消防人员检查发动机并确认内部叶片受损。航空调查人员建议根据季节性迁徙规律调整跑道驱鸟作业时间。机场增设了雷达鸟情监测设备，并加强跑道周界巡逻，以防止今后发生鸟击事故。

cards.audioText: On April 12, 2026, a low-cost airline Boeing 7 37 MAX flight made an emergency landing due to sudden cabin pressure failure halfway across a continental route. At cruising altitude, cabin pressure dropped rapidly, triggering oxygen mask deployment automatically. The crew initiated an emergency descent to a safe low altitude and contacted ATC for priority landing at the nearest alternate airport. All 174 passengers remained calm following crew instructions, with no fatalities or serious injuries. Technical inspection revealed a faulty seal on the rear pressure bulkhead caused slow air leakage. Civil aviation authorities ordered all same-model aircraft to undergo urgent pressure system inspections and revised routine maintenance checklists for cabin pressurization parts.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年4月12日，一家低成本航空公司的一架Boeing 737 MAX在飞越一条大陆航线的中途因客舱压力突然失效而紧急着陆。飞机在巡航高度时客舱压力迅速下降，氧气面罩自动释放。机组开始紧急下降至安全低高度，并联系空中交通管制，请求优先降落在最近的备降机场。全部174名乘客按照机组指示保持镇定，没有人员死亡或严重受伤。技术检查发现，后压力舱壁上的一个密封件发生故障，导致空气缓慢泄漏。民航主管部门要求所有同型号飞机紧急检查增压系统，并修订涉及客舱增压部件的例行维修检查单。

cards.audioText: On May 6, 2026, an international wide-body Airbus 3 30 flight suffered a minor runway excursion after landing at a South American airport. Heavy seasonal rain made the runway surface slippery, and the aircraft could not stop within the normal distance, sliding off the runway edge onto soft grass. The fuselage remained intact, and all 286 passengers and 11 crew evacuated safely without injuries. Airport investigators confirmed insufficient runway friction treatment after heavy rain was the main cause. The airport upgraded runway drainage systems and added anti-slip pavement layers. Regulators also reminded pilots to adjust landing speed and use full reverse thrust timely when landing on wet runways in rainy weather.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月6日，一架执行国际航班的Airbus 330宽体飞机在South America一座机场着陆后轻微冲出跑道。季节性大雨使跑道表面湿滑，飞机未能在正常距离内停下，滑出跑道边缘并进入松软草地。机身保持完整，全部286名乘客和11名机组人员均安全撤离，无人受伤。机场调查人员确认，大雨过后跑道摩擦力处置不足是主要原因。机场升级了跑道排水系统并增设防滑路面层。监管机构还提醒飞行员，在雨天湿跑道着陆时应调整着陆速度，并及时使用全反推。

cards.audioText: On June 2, 2026, a cargo turboprop aircraft overshot the runway during landing at a remote island airport in the Pacific. The pilot encountered sudden crosswind during final approach and failed to stabilize the landing path. The aircraft ran past the runway end and stopped on sandy coastal ground, avoiding falling into the sea. The two pilots on board were uninjured, but the aircraft sustained minor fuselage and landing gear damage. Investigators pointed to inadequate crosswind landing training and late adjustment of flight attitude. Local aviation training centers added more simulated crosswind landing sessions and updated operational guidelines for small island airports with complex wind conditions.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年6月2日，一架涡轮螺旋桨货机在Pacific一座偏远岛屿机场着陆时冲出跑道。飞行员在最后进近期间突遇侧风，未能稳定着陆航迹。飞机越过跑道末端并停在沿海沙地上，避免了坠入海中。机上2名飞行员均未受伤，但飞机机身和起落架轻微受损。调查人员指出，侧风着陆训练不足以及对飞行姿态调整过晚是相关因素。当地航空训练中心增加了更多模拟侧风着陆训练，并更新了针对风况复杂的小型岛屿机场的运行指南。

cards.audioText: On June 12, 2025, Air India Flight 1 7 1, a Boeing 7 87 8, departed Ahmedabad for London. Moments after liftoff, both engines lost power abruptly. The crew radioed "Mayday, Mayday, Mayday" reporting total thrust loss and inability to maintain altitude. Investigations later revealed both engine fuel switches had closed simultaneously for unknown reasons. The aircraft stalled and crashed into a residential area. All 241 people on board and 38 on the ground perished. It marked the first fatal crash of a Boeing 7 87. Cockpit voice recordings showed crew confusion: "Why did you shut off fuel? " "I didn't touch anything." The final report pointed to uncommanded fuel valve closure, with no mechanical defects found.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年6月12日，Air India 171航班使用一架Boeing 787-8执飞，从Ahmedabad起飞前往London。飞机离地片刻后，两台发动机突然同时失去动力。机组通过无线电呼叫“Mayday，Mayday，Mayday”，报告推力完全丧失且无法保持高度。后续调查显示，两台发动机的燃油开关因未知原因同时关闭。飞机失速并坠入一处居民区。机上全部241人和地面38人遇难。这是Boeing 787发生的首起致命坠机事故。驾驶舱语音记录显示机组感到困惑：“你为什么关闭燃油？”“我什么都没有碰。”最终报告指出，燃油活门未经指令关闭，且没有发现机械故障。

cards.audioText: On August, 28, 2025, a Delta Airlines Airbus 3 20-200, performing flight Delta 7 3 7 from Atlanta to Washington (USA) with 162 passengers and 6 crew, was nearing Washington when the crew requested a descent from FL2 9 0 in preparation for descending towards Washington. ATC cleared the flight to FL2 8 0 advising there was traffic below. While descending at about 1000 feet per minute, the crew received a TCAS resolution advisory to level off. The captain disengaged the autopilot, and stopped the descent at about FL2 8 5. At that time cabin crew were preparing the cabin for landing, a flight attendant in the aft galley was thrown to the floor and received fractures of both her kneecaps. Two other flight attendants received minor injuries. The aircraft continued for a safe landing at Washington National airport. The seriously injured flight attendant was taken to a hospital. The probable cause of the accident was the abrupt maneuver required to comply with a traffic alert and collision avoidance system resolution advisory during descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 2025年8月28日，Delta Airlines的一架Airbus 320-200执行Delta 737航班，从Atlanta飞往Washington（USA），机上有162名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机接近Washington时，机组为准备向Washington下降而请求从FL290下降。空中交通管制许可该航班下降至FL280，并提示下方有其他航空器。飞机正以约每分钟1,000英尺的下降率下降时，机组收到TCAS要求改平的决断咨询。机长断开自动驾驶，并在约FL285停止下降。此时客舱机组正在为着陆做准备，后厨房内的一名乘务员被抛到地板上，双侧膝盖骨骨折。另外2名乘务员受轻伤。飞机继续飞行并安全降落在Washington National Airport。重伤乘务员被送往医院。该事故的可能原因是飞机在下降过程中为遵从空中交通警戒与防撞系统决断咨询而必须实施的突然机动。

cards.audioText: On May 30, 2026, a Virgin Atlantic Airbus 3 30 900, performing flight Virgin 1 6 5 from London Heathrow (UK) to Montego Bay (Jamaica) with 246 passengers and 13 crew, was enroute at FL3 6 0 over the Atlantic Ocean about 440 nautical miles west of Shannon (Ireland), when the crew needed to reduce their right hand engine to idle thrust following an engine stall. The aircraft turned around, drifted down to FL2 0 0 and diverted to Shannon for a safe landing on Runway 24. The aircraft stopped briefly on the runway for an inspection by emergency services before taxiing to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年5月30日，Virgin Atlantic的一架Airbus 330-900执行Virgin 165航班，从London Heathrow（UK）飞往Montego Bay（Jamaica），机上有246名乘客和13名机组人员。飞机在Atlantic Ocean上空、Shannon（Ireland）以西约440海里处以FL360飞行时，右侧发动机发生失速，机组需要将该发动机减至慢车推力。飞机掉头，逐渐下降至FL200并备降Shannon，安全降落在24号跑道。飞机在跑道上短暂停留，接受紧急服务人员检查后滑行至停机坪。

cards.audioText: On June 5, 2026, a Swiss International Airlines Airbus 330-300, performing flight LX-155 from Mumbai (India) to Zurich (Switzerland) with 231 people on board, was enroute at FL340 about 510nm north of Mumbai when the crew decided to return to Mumbai due to electrical problems, descended initially to FL330 and later entered a hold at FL130 to burn off fuel. The aircraft landed safely on Mumbai's Runway 27 about 3 hours after turning around. The airline reported a technical problem affecting electrical systems including lighting, toilets, inflight entertainment and seats. A reset of the systems was not successful prompting the return. The aircraft needed to burn off about 20 tons of fuel before landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年6月5日，Swiss International Airlines的一架Airbus 330-300执行LX-155航班，从Mumbai（India）飞往Zurich（Switzerland），机上共有231人。飞机在Mumbai以北约510海里处以FL340飞行时，机组因电气问题决定返回Mumbai，最初下降至FL330，随后在FL130进入等待以消耗燃油。飞机在掉头约3小时后安全降落在Mumbai机场27号跑道。航空公司报告称，一个技术问题影响了包括照明、卫生间、机上娱乐系统和座椅在内的电气系统。系统重置未能成功，因此飞机返航。飞机在着陆前需要消耗约20吨燃油。

cards.audioText: On June 4, 2026, an Air Canada Boeing 7 37 8 MAX was taxiing for departure when the aircraft, in contact with Ground frequency, received taxi clearance via Bravo 5, backtrack Runway 05L and vacate via Bravo 2 due to taxiway Bravo being blocked. The aircraft turned off taxiway Bravo onto Bravo 5, entered Runway 05L and backtracked the runway. Just before that an Aeromexico Boeing 7 37 800 had been cleared for takeoff from Runway 05L, commenced takeoff and rejected takeoff at about 55 knots over ground on ATC instruction due to the runway incursion. The aircraft stopped on the runway just before the displaced runway threshold, just past Bravo 2 and about 640 meters short of Bravo 5. The aircraft subsequently turned right onto taxiway Bravo 3 and departed from Runway 05R.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年6月4日，Air Canada的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX正在滑行准备离场。该机与地面频率保持联系时收到滑行许可：经Bravo 5进入05L跑道反向滑行，再经Bravo 2脱离，因为Bravo滑行道受阻。飞机从Bravo滑行道转入Bravo 5，进入05L跑道并沿跑道反向滑行。就在此前，Aeromexico的一架Boeing 737-800已获准从05L跑道起飞并开始滑跑；由于发生跑道侵入，该机按照空中交通管制指令在地速约55节时中断起飞。飞机在移位跑道入口前方停下，刚刚越过Bravo 2，距Bravo 5约640米。该机随后右转进入Bravo 3滑行道，并从05R跑道起飞。

cards.audioText: On June 13, 2026, a KLM Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight KLM 1 1 6 4 from Bergen (Norway) to Amsterdam (Netherlands), was climbing through about FL3 8 0 out of Bergen when the right hand engine needed to be shut down due to a low oil pressure indication. The aircraft diverted to Billund (Denmark) for a safe landing on Runway 09 about 35 minutes after stopping the climb. Passengers reported the departure had been delayed by about one hour, the captain announced a starter for one of the engines was not working. The problem was fixed and they departed. Two loud bangs occurred, smoke entered the cabin and a burning smell developed. The captain announced, that they had received indication of low oil pressure on their right hand engine, they shut the engine down after the bangs. The airline reported the crew shut one of the engines down and diverted to Billund.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年6月13日，KLM的一架Boeing 737-800执行KLM 1164航班，从Bergen（Norway）飞往Amsterdam（Netherlands）。飞机从Bergen起飞爬升并通过约FL380时，因出现低滑油压力指示而需要关闭右侧发动机。飞机备降Billund（Denmark），并在停止爬升约35分钟后安全降落在09号跑道。乘客报告称，该航班离场已延误约一小时，机长宣布其中一台发动机的起动机无法工作。问题修复后，飞机起飞。随后出现两声巨响，烟雾进入客舱，并产生烧焦气味。机长宣布，他们收到右侧发动机滑油压力低的指示，并在巨响后关闭该发动机。航空公司报告称，机组关闭了一台发动机并备降Billund。

cards.audioText: main gear did not retract On June 16, 2026, a Delta Airlines Boeing 7 67 400, performing flight Delta 53 from Zurich (Switzerland) to New York JFK (USA), was climbing out of Zurich's Runway 16 when tower queried the crew "just to confirm, are you aware your gear is still out? " The crew advised they had a malfunction and needed to return. Tower added that only the nose gear had retracted, both main gear struts were still out. The aircraft stopped the climb at 6000 feet and returned to Zurich for a safe landing on Runway 14 about 25 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 主起落架未收起。2026年6月16日，Delta Airlines的一架Boeing 767-400执行Delta 53航班，从Zurich（Switzerland）飞往New York JFK（USA）。飞机从Zurich机场16号跑道起飞爬升时，塔台询问机组：“只是确认一下，你们是否知道起落架仍然放着？”机组告知发生故障，需要返航。塔台补充称，只有前起落架已经收起，两侧主起落架支柱仍处于放下状态。飞机在6,000英尺停止爬升，并在起飞约25分钟后安全返回Zurich，降落在14号跑道。

cards.audioText: engine fire indication A Virgin Australia Boeing 7 37 800, performing flight Virgin 6 9 7 from Melbourne to Perth (Australia), was climbing out of Melbourne's Runway 34 when the crew stopped the climb at 5000 feet due to a left hand engine fire indication, requested emergency services to meet them on the runway to check engine #1 and decided to return to Melbourne for a safe landing on Runway 34 about 25 minutes after departure. The aircraft stopped on the runway for about 8 minutes for an inspection by emergency services, no evidence of fire was spotted. The aircraft subsequently taxied to the apron. The airline reported an engine issue.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机火警指示。Virgin Australia的一架Boeing 737-800执行Virgin 697航班，从Melbourne飞往Perth（Australia）。飞机从Melbourne机场34号跑道起飞爬升时，机组因左侧发动机火警指示而在5,000英尺停止爬升，请求紧急服务人员在跑道上接应并检查1号发动机，同时决定返回Melbourne。飞机在起飞约25分钟后安全降落在34号跑道，并在跑道上停留约8分钟，接受紧急服务人员检查；未发现起火迹象。飞机随后滑行至停机坪。航空公司报告称，飞机出现发动机问题。

cards.audioText: pilot incapacitated On June 20, 2026, an Easyjet Airbus 3 20, performing flight Easyjet 3 3 1 5 from Edinburgh (UK) to Keflavik (Iceland) with 168 passengers and 6 crew, was on approach to Keflavik's Runway 01 when one of the pilots became briefly unconscious. The other pilot continued for a safe landing on Runway 01a few minutes later. By that time the ill pilot had already regained consciousness. The airport reported one of the pilots fainted (unclear whether captain or first officer), the aircraft landed a few minutes later. The fainted pilot was awake again at that time.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员失能。2026年6月20日，Easyjet的一架Airbus 320执行Easyjet 3315航班，从Edinburgh（UK）飞往Keflavik（Iceland），机上有168名乘客和6名机组人员。飞机正在进近Keflavik机场01号跑道时，其中一名飞行员短暂失去意识。另一名飞行员继续操纵飞机，并在几分钟后安全降落在01号跑道。此时身体不适的飞行员已经恢复意识。机场报告称，其中一名飞行员昏厥，无法确定是机长还是副驾驶；飞机几分钟后着陆，昏厥的飞行员当时已经苏醒。

cards.audioText: runway excursion on landing On June 20, 2026, a Mehr Airways Avro RJ 100, performing flight MEH 4 1 6 9 from Shiraz to Tehran Mehrabad (Iran), landed on Mehrabad's Runway 29R at 1 0 1 8 Local time (0 6 4 8 Zulu) but veered right off the runway center line and came to a stop at the runway edge. Iran's C A A reported the aircraft "suffered damage to one of its landing gear wheels while landing at Mehrabad Airport at 1 0 2 4 a.m., and subsequently, after traveling a distance and reducing speed, it left the runway and stopped next to the runway edge for reasons that are under investigation." There were no injuries. An investigation team was dispatched to the airport. ADS-B data suggest, the aircraft on final approach was left of the runway centerline, touched down onto the centerline, slowed, veered right and exited the right runway edge at about 70 knots over ground and came to a stop on the parallel taxiway. Local media report the aircraft bounced on landing and suffered a tail strike, and damaged some runway signs. There were no injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆时冲出跑道。2026年6月20日，Mehr Airways的一架Avro RJ 100执行MEH 4169航班，从Shiraz飞往Tehran Mehrabad（Iran）。飞机于当地时间10:18，即Zulu时间06:48，降落在Mehrabad机场29R跑道，但随后向右偏离跑道中线，并停在跑道边缘。Iran民航局报告称，该机“于上午10:24在Mehrabad Airport着陆时一个起落架机轮受损，随后在滑行一段距离并减速后，因仍在调查的原因离开跑道并停在跑道边缘旁。”无人受伤。一个调查小组已被派往机场。ADS-B数据显示，飞机在最后进近时位于跑道中线左侧，在中线上接地，减速后向右偏转，以约70节地速越过跑道右侧边缘，并停在平行滑行道上。当地媒体报告称，飞机着陆时发生弹跳并擦尾，还损坏了一些跑道标志。无人受伤。

cards.audioText: Bird strike On June 23, 2026, a LATAM Chile Airbus A320-200, performing flight LA-311 from Puerto Montt to Punta Arenas (Chile), was climbing out of Puerto Montt's Runway 35 when a vulture was ingested by the left engine causing the engine to emit streaks of flames and bangs and produce vibrations. The crew levelled off at about 3000 feet, shut the engine down and entered a hold. The aircraft returned to Puerto Montt for a safe landing on Runway 35 about 90 minutes after departure. Passengers reported the left engine emitted sparks, streaks of flames and bang. The captain subsequently announced, the vulture had impacted the left engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 鸟击。2026年6月23日，LATAM Chile的一架Airbus A320-200执行LA-311航班，从Puerto Montt飞往Punta Arenas（Chile）。飞机从Puerto Montt机场35号跑道起飞爬升时，一只秃鹫被吸入左侧发动机，导致发动机喷出条状火焰、发出爆响并产生振动。机组在约3,000英尺改平，关闭发动机并进入等待。飞机在起飞约90分钟后安全返回Puerto Montt，降落在35号跑道。乘客报告称，左侧发动机喷出火花和条状火焰，并发出爆响。机长随后宣布，秃鹫撞击了左侧发动机。

cards.audioText: fumes affect all flight attendants and 2 passengers On June 13, 2026, a Westjet Airlines Boeing 737-8 MAX, performing flight Westjet 6 5 from Glasgow (UK) to Toronto (Canada) with 153 people on board, was enroute at FL3 2 0 about 110 nautical miles northwest of Goose Bay (Canada) when the crew contacted Medilink and subsequently decided to divert to Goose Bay after all 4 flights attendants and two passengers experienced shortness of breath due to fumes in the aft cabin. The aircraft landed safely in Goose Bay about 30 minutes later. The Canadian TSB reported: "The flight attendants maintained their safety related duties and the aircraft landed without incident where ATC had deployed emergency services to meet the aircraft. The crew and passengers were assessed by paramedics and released. Fire crews inspected the aircraft for the source of the fumes and tested the air quality in the aircraft. Maintenance personnel identified the source of the fumes as a faulty aft galley oven."
cards.audioTextZh: 烟雾影响全部乘务员和2名乘客。2026年6月13日，Westjet Airlines的一架Boeing 737-8 MAX执行Westjet 65航班，从Glasgow（UK）飞往Toronto（Canada），机上共有153人。飞机在Goose Bay（Canada）西北约110海里处以FL320飞行时，机组联系Medilink。后客舱的烟雾导致全部4名乘务员和2名乘客呼吸困难，机组随后决定备降Goose Bay。飞机约30分钟后安全降落在Goose Bay。Canada运输安全委员会报告称：“乘务员继续履行与安全相关的职责，飞机顺利着陆，空中交通管制已安排紧急服务人员接应。医护人员对机组和乘客进行了评估，随后允许他们离开。消防人员检查飞机以查找烟雾来源，并检测飞机内的空气质量。维修人员确认烟雾来自后厨房内一台故障的烤箱。”

cards.audioText: rejected takeoff due to runway incursion On June 26, 2026, an American Airlines Airbus 3 1 9, performing flight American 3 0 8 from Miami (USA) to Bermuda (Bermuda), was cleared for takeoff from Miami's Runway 08R and was accelerating for takeoff when the crew rejected takeoff at low speed after spotting a business jet crossing the runway about 880 meters (2880 feet) down the runway. The Airbus 3 1 9 vacated the runway at the first right exit about 370 meters (1200 feet) down the runway. Ground Control subsequently told the crew of the Netjets business jet that they had just crossed an active runway, the crew claimed they had been cleared to cross which tower denied telling them he had cleared another aircraft with different callsign and numbers.
cards.audioTextZh: 因跑道侵入中断起飞。2026年6月26日，American Airlines的一架Airbus 319执行American 308航班，从Miami（USA）飞往Bermuda（Bermuda）。飞机获准从Miami机场08R跑道起飞并正在加速时，机组看到一架公务机在跑道前方约880米，即2,880英尺处穿越跑道，于是低速中断起飞。Airbus 319在跑道前方约370米，即1,200英尺处经第一个右侧出口脱离跑道。地面管制随后告诉Netjets公务机机组，他们刚刚穿越了一条正在使用的跑道。该机组声称已获准穿越，塔台予以否认，并告知他们，塔台许可的是另一架具有不同呼号和数字的航空器。

cards.audioText: hydraulic failure and fuel dump problem On June 28, 2026, an Air Atlanta Europe Malta Boeing 747-400 freighter on behalf of Saudi Arabian Airlines, performing flight SV-3902 from Liege (Belgium) to Riyadh (Saudi Arabia), was climbing out of Liege's Runway 22L when the crew stopped the climb at FL100 due to the loss of hydraulic system #4, the crew decided to return to Liege and dump fuel, however, only the right hand fuel dump valve opened, no fuel was dumped from the right hand wing. The aircraft entered a hold at FL100 to dump and landed safely on Runway 22L about 85 minutes after departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 液压系统故障及放油问题。2026年6月28日，Air Atlanta Europe Malta的一架Boeing 747-400货机代表Saudi Arabian Airlines运营，执行SV-3902航班，从Liege（Belgium）飞往Riyadh（Saudi Arabia）。飞机从Liege机场22L跑道起飞爬升时，因4号液压系统失效而在FL100停止爬升。机组决定返回Liege并放油；然而，只有右侧放油活门打开，右侧机翼没有放出燃油。飞机在FL100进入等待以便放油，并在起飞约85分钟后安全降落在22L跑道。

cards.audioText: On June 29, 2026, a Jetblue Airbus 3 2 1, performing flight Jetblue 9 4 8 from Las Vegas to New York JFK (USA), was on approach to JFK's Runway 13L maintaining 3000 feet when the crew reported a drone hit the aircraft just above the windshield. The aircraft continued for a safe landing on Runway 13L. The F A A reported: "The pilot of JetBlue Airlines Flight 948 reported striking a drone at approximately 3,000 feet altitude while on final approach to John F. Kennedy International Airport around 07: 15 a.m. local time on Monday, June 29. A post-flight inspection did not reveal any damage to the aircraft. The FAA will investigate." About 40 minutes later a police helicopter advised tower they had the drone in sight at 2000 feet and proceeded to take a closer look at it.
cards.audioTextZh: 2026年6月29日，Jetblue的一架Airbus 321执行Jetblue 948航班，从Las Vegas飞往New York JFK（USA）。飞机正在保持3,000英尺进近JFK机场13L跑道时，机组报告称一架无人机撞击了飞机风挡上方。飞机继续进近并安全降落在13L跑道。FAA报告称：“JetBlue Airlines 948航班的飞行员报告称，6月29日星期一当地时间约07:15，飞机正在对John F. Kennedy International Airport实施最后进近时，在约3,000英尺高度撞到一架无人机。飞行后检查未发现飞机有任何损伤。FAA将对此展开调查。”约40分钟后，一架警用直升机告知塔台，他们在2,000英尺高度看到该无人机，并继续靠近查看。
